ScalarIndexPluginRegistry, TrainingCriteria, TrainingOrdering,\\n    VALUE_COLUMN_NAME,\\n};\\nuse lance_index::scalar::IndexStore;\\nuse lance_index::scalar::{\\n    bitmap::BITMAP_LOOKUP_NAME, inverted::INVERT_LIST_FILE, lance_format::LanceIndexStore,\\n    ScalarIndex, ScalarIndexParams,\\n};\\nuse lance_index::scalar::{CreatedIndex, InvertedIndexParams};\\nuse lance_index::{DatasetIndexExt, IndexType, ScalarIndexCriteria, VECTOR_INDEX_VERSION};\\nuse lance_table::format::{Fragment, IndexMetadata};\\nuse log::info;\\nuse snafu::location;\\nuse tracing::instrument;\\n\\n// Log an update every TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ million rows processed\\nconst TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ: usize = 1000000;\\n\\npub(crate) struct TrainingRequest {\\n    pub fragment_ids: Option&amp;lt;Vec&amp;lt;u32&amp;gt;&amp;gt;,\\n}\\n\\nimpl TrainingRequest {\\n    pub fn with_fragment_ids(\\n        _dataset: Arc&amp;lt;Dataset&amp;gt;,\\n        _column: String,\\n        fragment_ids: Vec&amp;lt;u32&amp;gt;,\\n    ) -&amp;gt; Self {\\n        Self {\\n            fragment_ids: Some(fragment_ids),\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    async fn create_empty_stream(\\n        dataset: &amp;amp;Dataset,\\n        column: &amp;amp;str,\\n        criteria: &amp;amp;TrainingCriteria,\\n    ) -&amp;gt; Result&amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;gt; {\\n        let column_field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\n            source: format!(\\\"No column with name {}\\\", column).into(),\\n            location: location!(),\\n        })?;\\n\\n        let mut fields = Vec::with_capacity(3);\\n        fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\n            VALUE_COLUMN_NAME,\\n            column_field.data_type(),\\n            true,\\n        ));\\n        if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\n            fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\n                ROW_ID,\\n                arrow_schema::DataType::UInt64,\\n                false,\\n            ));\\n        }\\n        if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\n            fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\n                ROW_ADDR,\\n                arrow_schema::DataType::UInt64,\\n                false,\\n            ));\\n        }\\n\\n        // Create schema with the column and row_id field (matching scan_chunks behavior)\\n        let schema = Arc::new(arrow_schema::Schema::new(fields));\\n\\n        // Create empty stream\\n        let empty_stream = futures::stream::empty();\\n        Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(\\n            schema,\\n            empty_stream,\\n        )))\\n    }\\n}\\n\\npub(crate) async fn scan_training_data(\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;Dataset,\\n    column: &amp;amp;str,\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;TrainingCriteria,\\n    fragments: Option&amp;lt;Vec&amp;lt;Fragment&amp;gt;&amp;gt;,\\n) -&amp;gt; Result&amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;gt; {\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\n\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\n\\n    // Fragment filtering is now handled in load_training_data function\\n    // This function just processes the fragments passed to it\\n\\n    let column_field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\n        source: format!(\\\"No column with name {}\\\", column).into(),\\n        location: location!(),\\n    })?;\\n\\n    // Datafusion currently has bugs with spilling on string columns\\n    // See https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/10073\\n    //\\n    // One we upgrade we can remove this\\n    let use_spilling = !matches!(\\n        column_field.data_type(),\\n        DataType::Utf8 | DataType::LargeUtf8\\n    );\\n\\n    // Note: we don't need to sort for TrainingOrdering::Addresses because\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\n        scan.order_by(Some(vec![ColumnOrdering::asc_nulls_first(\\n            column.to_string(),\\n        )]))?;\\n    }\\n\\n    if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\n        scan.with_row_id();\\n    }\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\n    }\\n\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\n\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\n    }\\n\\n    let batches = scan\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\n            use_spilling,\\n            ..Default::default()\\n        })\\n        .await?;\\n\\n    let schema = batches.schema();\\n    let mut rows_processed = 0;\\n    let mut next_update = TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\n    let training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\n    info!(\\n        \\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\",\\n        training_uuid, column\\n    );\\n    info!(\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\n        rows_processed += batch.num_rows();\\n        if rows_processed &amp;gt;= next_update {\\n            next_update += TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\n            info!(\\n                \\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\",\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\n            );\\n        }\\n        batch\\n    });\\n\\n    Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(schema, batches)))\\n}\\n\\npub(crate) async fn load_training_data(\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;Dataset,\\n    column: &amp;amp;str,\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;TrainingCriteria,\\n    fragments: Option&amp;lt;Vec&amp;lt;Fragment&amp;gt;&amp;gt;,\\n    train: bool,\\n    fragment_ids: Option&amp;lt;Vec&amp;lt;u32&amp;gt;&amp;gt;,\\n) -&amp;gt; Result&amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;gt; {\\n    // Create training request with fragment_ids if provided\\n    let training_request = Box::new(match fragment_ids.clone() {\\n        Some(fragment_ids) =&amp;gt; TrainingRequest::with_fragment_ids(\\n            Arc::new(dataset.clone()),\\n            column.to_string(),\\n            fragment_ids,\\n        ),\\n        None =&amp;gt; TrainingRequest { fragment_ids: None },\\n    });\\n\\n    if train {\\n        // Use the training request to scan data with fragment filtering\\n        if let Some(ref fragment_ids) = training_request.fragment_ids {\\n            let fragment_ids = fragment_ids\\n                .clone()\\n                .into_iter()\\n                .sorted()\\n                .dedup()\\n                .collect_vec();\\n            let frags = dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\n            let frags: Result&amp;lt;Vec&amp;lt;_&amp;gt;&amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\n                .iter()\\n                .zip(frags)\\n                .map(|(id, frag)| {\\n                    let Some(frag) = frag else {\\n                        return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\n                            source: format!(\\\"No fragment with id {}\\\", id).into(),\\n                            location: location!(),\\n                        });\\n                    };\\n                    Ok(frag.metadata().clone())\\n                })\\n                .collect();\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, Some(frags?)).await\\n        } else {\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\n        }\\n    } else {\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n// TODO: Allow users to register their own plugins\\nstatic SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY: LazyLock&amp;lt;Arc&amp;lt;ScalarIndexPluginRegistry&amp;gt;&amp;gt; =\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\n\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;gt;);\\n\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\n    /// Returns true if the index is a vector index\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;self) -&amp;gt; bool {\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\"VectorIndexDetails\\\")\\n    }\\n\\n    /// Returns true if the index supports FTS\\n    pub fn supports_fts(&amp;amp;self) -&amp;gt; bool {\\n        // In the future this may need to change if we want FTS indices to be pluggable\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\"InvertedIndexDetails\\\")\\n    }\\n\\n    /// Returns the plugin for the index\\n    pub fn get_plugin(&amp;amp;self) -&amp;gt; Result&amp;lt;&amp;amp;dyn ScalarIndexPlugin&amp;gt; {\\n        SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(self.0.as_ref())\\n    }\\n\\n    /// Returns the index version\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;self) -&amp;gt; Result&amp;lt;u32&amp;gt; {\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\n            Ok(VECTOR_INDEX_VERSION)\\n        } else {\\n            self.get_plugin().map(|p| p.version())\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n/// Build a Scalar Index (returns details to store in the manifest)\\n#[instrument(level = \\\"debug\\\", skip_all)]\\npub(super) async fn build_scalar_index(\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;Dataset,\\n    column: &amp;amp;str,\\n    uuid: &amp;amp;str,\\n    params: &amp;amp;ScalarIndexParams,\\n    train: bool,\\n    fragment_ids: Option&amp;lt;Vec&amp;lt;u32&amp;gt;&amp;gt;,\\n) -&amp;gt; Result&amp;lt;CreatedIndex&amp;gt; {\\n    let field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\n        source: format!(\\\"No column with name {}\\\", column).into(),\\n        location: location!(),\\n    })?;\\n    let field: arrow_schema::Field = field.into();\\n\\n    let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_new(dataset, uuid)?;\\n\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_name(&amp;amp;params.index_type)?;\\n    let training_request =\\n        plugin.new_training_request(params.params.as_deref().unwrap_or(\\\"{}\\\"), &amp;amp;field)?;\\n\\n    let training_data = load_training_data(\\n        dataset,\\n        column,\\n        training_request.criteria(),\\n        None,\\n        train,\\n        fragment_ids.clone(),\\n    )\\n    .await?;\\n\\n    plugin\\n        .train_index(training_data, &amp;amp;index_store, training_request, fragment_ids)\\n        .await\\n}\\n\\n/// Fetches the scalar index plugin for a given index metadata\\n///\\n/// The fast path, on newer datasets, is just a plugin lookup by the type URL of the index details.\\n///\\n/// If the index details are missing (older dataset) then we need to look at the files present in the\\n/// index directory to guess the index type.\\npub async fn fetch_index_details(\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;Dataset,\\n    column: &amp;amp;str,\\n    index: &amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\n) -&amp;gt; Result&amp;lt;Arc&amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    let index_details = match index.index_details.as_ref() {\\n        Some(details) =&amp;gt; details.clone(),\\n        None =&amp;gt; infer_scalar_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?,\\n    };\\n\\n    Ok(index_details)\\n}\\n\\npub async fn open_scalar_index(\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;Dataset,\\n    column: &amp;amp;str,\\n    index: &amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\n    metrics: &amp;amp;dyn MetricsCollector,\\n) -&amp;gt; Result&amp;lt;Arc&amp;lt;dyn ScalarIndex&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    let uuid_str = index.uuid.to_string();\\n    let index_store = Arc::new(LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index)?);\\n\\n    let index_details = fetch_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?;\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(index_details.as_ref())?;\\n\\n    let frag_reuse_index = dataset.open_frag_reuse_index(metrics).await?;\\n\\n    let index_cache = dataset\\n        .index_cache\\n        .for_index(&amp;amp;uuid_str, frag_reuse_index.as_ref().map(|f| &amp;amp;f.uuid));\\n\\n    plugin\\n        .load_index(index_store, &amp;amp;index_details, frag_reuse_index, &amp;amp;index_cache)\\n        .await\\n}\\n\\npub(crate) async fn infer_scalar_index_details(\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;Dataset,\\n    column: &amp;amp;str,\\n    index: &amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\n) -&amp;gt; Result&amp;lt;Arc&amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    let uuid = index.uuid.to_string();\\n    let type_key = crate::session::index_caches::ScalarIndexDetailsKey { uuid: &amp;amp;uuid };\\n    if let Some(index_details) = dataset.index_cache.get_with_key(&amp;amp;type_key).await {\\n        return Ok(index_details.0.clone());\\n    }\\n\\n    let index_dir = dataset.indice_files_dir(index)?.child(uuid.clone());\\n    let col = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::Internal {\\n        message: format!(\\n            \\\"Index refers to column {} which does not exist in dataset schema\\\",\\n            column\\n        ),\\n        location: location!(),\\n    })?;\\n\\n    let bitmap_page_lookup = index_dir.child(BITMAP_LOOKUP_NAME);\\n    let inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(METADATA_FILE);\\n    let legacy_inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(INVERT_LIST_FILE);\\n    let index_details = if let DataType::List(_) = col.data_type() {\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;LabelListIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;bitmap_page_lookup).await? {\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;BitmapIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;inverted_list_lookup).await? {\\n        // Try to infer inverted index details from metadata file to capture with_position and other params\\n        // Fall back to defaults if anything goes wrong\\n        let default_details = prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap();\\n        let parse_params = async || {\\n            let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index).ok()?;\\n            let reader = index_store.open_index_file(METADATA_FILE).await.ok()?;\\n            let params_str = reader.schema().metadata.get(\\\"params\\\")?;\\n            let params = ::serde_json::from_str::&amp;lt;InvertedIndexParams&amp;gt;(params_str).ok()?;\\n            let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\n        };\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\n    } else if dataset\\n        .object_store\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\n        .await?\\n    {\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\n    } else {\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;BTreeIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\n    };\\n\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\n\\n    dataset\\n        .index_cache\\n        .insert_with_key(&amp;amp;type_key, prost_any)\\n        .await;\\n    Ok(index_details)\\n}\\n\\npub fn index_matches_criteria(\\n    index: &amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;ScalarIndexCriteria,\\n    field: &amp;amp;Field,\\n    has_multiple_indices: bool,\\n    schema: &amp;amp;lance_core::datatypes::Schema,\\n) -&amp;gt; Result&amp;lt;bool&amp;gt; {\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\n        if &amp;amp;index.name != name {\\n            return Ok(false);\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    if let Some(for_column) = criteria.for_column {\\n        if index.fields.len() != 1 {\\n            return Ok(false);\\n        }\\n        // Build the full field path for nested fields\\n        let field_path = if let Some(ancestors) = schema.field_ancestry_by_id(field.id) {\\n            let field_refs: Vec&amp;lt;&amp;amp;str&amp;gt; = ancestors.iter().map(|f| f.name.as_str()).collect();\\n            lance_core::datatypes::format_field_path(&amp;amp;field_refs)\\n        } else {\\n            field.name.clone()\\n        };\\n        if for_column != field_path {\\n            return Ok(false);\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    let index_details = index.index_details.clone().map(IndexDetails);\\n    let Some(index_details) = index_details else {\\n        if has_multiple_indices {\\n            return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\n                                source: format!(\\n                                    \\\"An index {} on the field with id {} co-exists with other indices on the same column but was written with an older Lance version, and this is not supported.  Please retrain this index.\\\",\\n                                    index.name,\\n                                    index.fields.first().unwrap_or(&amp;amp;0),\\n                                ).into(),\\n                                location: location!(),\\n                            });\\n        }\\n\\n        // If we don't have details then allow it for backwards compatibility\\n        return Ok(true);\\n    };\\n\\n    if index_details.is_vector() {\\n        // This method is only for finding matching scalar indexes today so reject any vector indexes\\n        return Ok(false);\\n    }\\n\\n    if criteria.must_support_fts &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !index_details.supports_fts() {\\n        return Ok(false);\\n    }\\n\\n    // We should not use FTS / NGram indices for exact equality queries\\n    // (i.e. merge insert with a join on the indexed column)\\n    if criteria.must_support_exact_equality {\\n        let plugin = index_details.get_plugin()?;\\n        if !plugin.provides_exact_answer() {\\n            return Ok(false);\\n        }\\n    }\\n    Ok(true)\\n}\\n\\n/// Initialize a scalar index from a source dataset\\npub async fn initialize_scalar_index(\\n    target_dataset: &amp;amp;mut Dataset,\\n    source_dataset: &amp;amp;Dataset,\\n    source_index: &amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\n    field_names: &amp;amp;[&amp;amp;str],\\n) -&amp;gt; Result&amp;lt;()&amp;gt; {\\n    if field_names.is_empty() || field_names.len() &amp;gt; 1 {\\n        return Err(Error::Index {\\n            message: format!(\\\"Unsupported fields for scalar index: {:?}\\\", field_names),\\n            location: location!(),\\n        });\\n    }\\n\\n    // Scalar indices currently support only single fields, use the first one\\n    let column_name = field_names[0];\\n\\n    let source_scalar_index = source_dataset\\n        .open_scalar_index(\\n            column_name,\\n            &amp;amp;source_index.uuid.to_string(),\\n            &amp;amp;NoOpMetricsCollector,\\n        )\\n        .await?;\\n\\n    let params = source_scalar_index.derive_index_params()?;\\n    let index_type = source_scalar_index.index_type();\\n\\n    // For Inverted index, we need to parse the params JSON and create InvertedIndexParams\\n    if index_type == IndexType::Inverted {\\n        // Extract the JSON string from ScalarIndexParams\\n })?;\\n\\n        // Parse the JSON into InvertedIndexParams\\n        let inverted_params: InvertedIndexParams = serde_json::from_str(params_json)?;\\n\\n        target_dataset\\n            .create_index(\\n                &amp;amp;[column_name],\\n                index_type,\\n                Some(source_index.name.clone()),\\n                &amp;amp;inverted_params,\\n                false,\\n            )\\n            .await?;\\n    } else {\\n        target_dataset\\n            .create_index(\\n                &amp;amp;[column_name],\\n                index_type,\\n                Some(source_index.name.clone()),\\n                &amp;amp;params,\\n                false,\\n            )\\n            .await?;\\n    }\\n\\n    Ok(())\\n}\\n\\n#[cfg(test)]\\nmod tests {\\n ---


No. A single Lance file (DataFile) cannot contain multiple fragments. The relationship is:

**Dataset → Fragments → Data Files**

From the code:

```280:310:rust/lance-table/src/format/fragment.rs
/// A fragment is a set of files which represent the different columns of the same rows.
/// If column exists in the schema, but the related file does not exist, treat this column as `nulls`.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, DeepSizeOf)]
pub struct Fragment {
    /// Fragment ID
    pub id: u64,

    /// Files within the fragment.
    pub files: Vec<DataFile>,
```

- A Fragment can contain multiple DataFiles (Lance files), e.g., when adding columns.
- A single DataFile belongs to exactly one Fragment.
- A Dataset contains multiple Fragments.

So:
- One Fragment → multiple Lance files (DataFiles)
- One Lance file → one Fragment
- One Dataset → multiple Fragments

Fragments are logical groupings tracked in the manifest, not physical files. Each `.lance` data file belongs to a single fragment.

**Not always correct.** In the typical case, yes, but fragments can contain multiple `.lance` files.

From the code and documentation:

1. **Fragment structure** (from `fragment.rs`):
   ```rust
   pub struct Fragment {
       pub id: u64,
       pub files: Vec<DataFile>,  // Can contain multiple files!
   }
   ```

2. **Documentation** (from `LanceInfo.md` line 293):
   > "Each fragment can have any number of data files"

3. **When multiple files occur**:
   - When adding columns to an existing dataset (schema evolution)
   - When columns are written separately

4. **In your dataset**: The 50+ `.lance` files in `data/` likely correspond to 50+ fragments, with each fragment typically having one file. This is the common case, but not guaranteed.

**Correct statement**: "In the typical case, each fragment maps to one physical `.lance` file, but a fragment can contain multiple `.lance` files when columns are added separately."

To verify for your dataset, check the manifest — it lists which files belong to each fragment.

\\\\\\\"Should have 0 rows with value='banana' after deletion\\\\\\\"\\\\n        );\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\"\""

-&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\n\\\\n    // Fragment dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n    // Datafusion currently has bugs with spilling on string columns\\\\n    // See https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/10073\\\\n    //\\\\n    // One we upgrade we can remove this\\\\n    let because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n   }\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\n dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"VectorIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\n -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\n\\\\n    // Fragment dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n ---


**A physical `.lance` file does not contain fragment information.** Fragments are tracked in the manifest at the dataset level, not inside the files.

From the code and documentation:

1. **Fragments are metadata, not stored in files** (from `LanceInfo.md` line 295):
   > "Fragments are not real files, lists in the manifest!!!"

2. **Fragment structure** (from `fragment.rs`):
   ```rust
   pub struct Fragment {
       pub id: u64,
       pub files: Vec<DataFile>,  // Fragment contains references to files
   }
   ```
   The fragment references files, not the other way around.

3. **File structure**: A `.lance` file contains:
   - Data pages (various numbers)
   - Schema information
   - Column metadata
   - Encoding information
   - No fragment ID or fragment metadata

4. **The relationship**:
   - **Fragment** (logical, in manifest) → references → **DataFiles** (physical `.lance` files)
   - **DataFile** (physical `.lance` file) → belongs to → **exactly ONE fragment** (tracked in manifest)

**Answer**: A `.lance` file can have many data pages, but it does not contain fragment information. Each `.lance` file belongs to exactly one fragment, and that relationship is stored in the manifest, not in the file itself.

**Summary**:
- ✅ A `.lance` file can have various numbers of data pages
- ✅ A `.lance` file belongs to exactly 1 fragment (tracked in manifest)
- ❌ A `.lance` file does not "contain" fragment information internally

-&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\n\\\\n    // Fragment dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n use_spilling = !matches!(\\\\n        column_field.data_type(),\\\\n        DataType::Utf8 | DataType::LargeUtf8\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // Note: we don't need to sort for TrainingOrdering::Addresses because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n        scan.order_by(Some(vec![ColumnOrdering::asc_nulls_first(\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n        )]))?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n        scan.with_row_id();\\\\n Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\n \\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\\\\\",\\\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\\\n            );\\\\n        }\\\\n        batch\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n =\\\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\\\n\\\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;);\\\\n\\\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\\\n    /// Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(\\\\n            schema,\\\\n            empty_stream,\\\\n        )))\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn scan_training_data(\\\\n    dataset: because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n        scan.order_by(Some(vec![ColumnOrdering::asc_nulls_first(\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n        )]))?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n        scan.with_row_id();\\\\n Option&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // Create training request with fragment_ids if dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n {\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\n        }\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// TODO: Allow users to register their own plugins\\\\nstatic SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY: LazyLock&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;ScalarIndexPluginRegistry&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; =\\\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\\\n\\\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;);\\\\n\\\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\\\n    /// }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\n uuid)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_name(&amp;amp;amp;params.index_type)?;\\\\n    let training_request =\\\\n         let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\n        };\\\\n filtering is now handled in load_training_data function\\\\n    // This function just processes the fragments passed to it\\\\n\\\\n    let column_field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n use_spilling = !matches!(\\\\n        column_field.data_type(),\\\\n        DataType::Utf8 | DataType::LargeUtf8\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // Note: we don't need to sort for TrainingOrdering::Addresses because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n        scan.order_by(Some(vec![ColumnOrdering::asc_nulls_first(\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n        )]))?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n        scan.with_row_id();\\\\n    }\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\n TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n    let training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\\\n    info!(\\\\n        \\\\\\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\\\\\",\\\\n        training_uuid, column\\\\n    );\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\n        rows_processed += batch.num_rows();\\\\n        if rows_processed &amp;amp;gt;= next_update {\\\\n            next_update += TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n            info!(\\\\n                \\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\\\\\",\\\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\\\n            );\\\\n        }\\\\n        batch\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n Option&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // Create training request with fragment_ids if provided\\\\n    let training_request = Box::new(match fragment_ids.clone() {\\\\n        Some(fragment_ids) =&amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest::with_fragment_ids(\\\\n            Arc::new(dataset.clone()),\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n            fragment_ids,\\\\n        ),\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest { fragment_ids: None },\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n = fragment_ids\\\\n                .clone()\\\\n                .into_iter()\\\\n                .sorted()\\\\n                .dedup()\\\\n                .collect_vec();\\\\n            let frags = dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n                .zip(frags)\\\\n                .map(|(id, frag)| {\\\\n                    let Some(frag) = frag else {\\\\n                        return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n                            source: format!(\\\\\\\"No fragment with id {}\\\\\\\", id).into(),\\\\n                            location: location!(),\\\\n                        });\\\\n                    };\\\\n                    Ok(frag.metadata().clone())\\\\n                })\\\\n                .collect();\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, Some(frags?)).await\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\n        }\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\n Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"VectorIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index supports FTS\\\\n    pub fn supports_fts(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        // In the future this may need to change if we want FTS indices to be pluggable\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"InvertedIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the plugin for the index\\\\n    pub fn get_plugin(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;dyn ScalarIndexPlugin&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(self.0.as_ref())\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\n &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    params: &amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexParams,\\\\n    train: bool,\\\\n    fragment_ids: Option&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;CreatedIndex&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", uuid)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_name(&amp;amp;amp;params.index_type)?;\\\\n    let training_request =\\\\n        plugin.new_training_request(params.params.as_deref().unwrap_or(\\\\\\\"{}\\\\\\\"), &amp;amp;amp;field)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let training_data = load_training_data(\\\\n        dataset,\\\\n        column,\\\\n        training_request.criteria(),\\\\n        None,\\\\n        train,\\\\n        fragment_ids.clone(),\\\\n    )\\\\n    .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    plugin\\\\n        .train_index(training_data, &amp;amp;amp;index_store, training_request, fragment_ids)\\\\n        .await\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n/// Fetches the scalar index plugin for a given index metadata\\\\n///\\\\n/// present in the\\\\n/// index directory to guess the index type.\\\\npub async fn fetch_index_details(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let index_details = match index.index_details.as_ref() {\\\\n        Some(details) =&amp;amp;gt; details.clone(),\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;gt; infer_scalar_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?,\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub async fn open_scalar_index(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\n    metrics: &amp;amp;amp;dyn MetricsCollector,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;dyn ScalarIndex&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let uuid_str = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\n    let index_store = Arc::new(LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index)?);\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = fetch_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?;\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(index_details.as_ref())?;\\\\n\\\\n    let frag_reuse_index = dataset.open_frag_reuse_index(metrics).await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let index_cache = dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n        .for_index(&amp;amp;amp;uuid_str, frag_reuse_index.as_ref().map(|f| &amp;amp;amp;f.uuid));\\\\n\\\\n    plugin\\\\n        .load_index(index_store, &amp;amp;amp;index_details, frag_reuse_index, &amp;amp;amp;index_cache)\\\\n        .await\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn infer_scalar_index_details(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let uuid = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\n    let type_key = crate::session::index_caches::ScalarIndexDetailsKey { uuid: &amp;amp;amp;uuid };\\\\n    if let Some(index_details) = dataset.index_cache.get_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;type_key).await {\\\\n        return Ok(index_details.0.clone());\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let index_dir = dataset.indice_files_dir(index)?.child(uuid.clone());\\\\n    let col = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::Internal {\\\\n        message: format!(\\\\n            \\\\\\\"Index refers to column {} which does not exist in dataset schema\\\\\\\",\\\\n            column\\\\n        ),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n    let bitmap_page_lookup = index_dir.child(BITMAP_LOOKUP_NAME);\\\\n    let inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(METADATA_FILE);\\\\n    let legacy_inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(INVERT_LIST_FILE);\\\\n    let index_details = if let DataType::List(_) = col.data_type() {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;LabelListIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;bitmap_page_lookup).await? {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;BitmapIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;inverted_list_lookup).await? {\\\\n        // Try to infer inverted index details from metadata file to capture with_position and other params\\\\n        // Fall back to defaults if anything goes wrong\\\\n        let default_details = prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap();\\\\n        let parse_params = async || {\\\\n            let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index).ok()?;\\\\n            let reader = index_store.open_index_file(METADATA_FILE).await.ok()?;\\\\n            let params_str = reader.schema().metadata.get(\\\\\\\"params\\\\\\\")?;\\\\n            let params = ::serde_json::from_str::&amp;amp;lt;InvertedIndexParams&amp;amp;gt;(params_str).ok()?;\\\\n            let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\n        };\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\n        .object_store\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\n        .await?\\\\n    {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;BTreeIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\n\\\\n    dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n        .insert_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;type_key, prost_any)\\\\n        .await;\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub fn index_matches_criteria(\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexCriteria,\\\\n    field: &amp;amp;amp;Field,\\\\n    has_multiple_indices: bool,\\\\n    schema: &amp;amp;amp;lance_core::datatypes::Schema,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(for_column) = criteria.for_column {\\\\n        if index.fields.len() != 1 {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n        // Build the full field path for nested fields\\\\n        let field_path = if let Some(ancestors) = schema.field_ancestry_by_id(field.id) {\\\\n            let field_refs: Vec&amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;str&amp;amp;gt; = ancestors.iter().map(|f| f.name.as_str()).collect();\\\\n            lance_core::datatypes::format_field_path(&amp;amp;amp;field_refs)\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            field.name.clone()\\\\n        };\\\\n        if for_column != field_path {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = index.index_details.clone().map(IndexDetails);\\\\n    let Some(index_details) = index_details else {\\\\n        if has_multiple_indices {\\\\n            return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n                                source: format!(\\\\n &amp;amp;amp;params,\\\\n                false,\\\\n            )\\\\n            .await?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(())\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\nmod tests {\\\\n    use if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n            fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n                ROW_ADDR,\\\\n                arrow_schema::DataType::UInt64,\\\\n                false,\\\\n -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\n\\\\n    // Fragment filtering is now handled in load_training_data function\\\\n    // This function just processes the fragments passed to it\\\\n\\\\n    let column_field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n    // Datafusion currently has bugs with spilling on string columns\\\\n    // See https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/10073\\\\n    //\\\\n    // One we upgrade we can remove this\\\\n    let use_spilling = !matches!(\\\\n        column_field.data_type(),\\\\n        DataType::Utf8 | DataType::LargeUtf8\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // Note: we don't need to sort for TrainingOrdering::Addresses because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n        scan.order_by(Some(vec![ColumnOrdering::asc_nulls_first(\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n        )]))?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n        scan.with_row_id();\\\\n    }\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\n TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n    let training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\\\n    info!(\\\\n        \\\\\\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\\\\\",\\\\n        training_uuid, column\\\\n    );\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\n        rows_processed += batch.num_rows();\\\\n        if rows_processed &amp;amp;gt;= next_update {\\\\n            next_update += TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n            info!(\\\\n                \\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\\\\\",\\\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\\\n            );\\\\n        }\\\\n        batch\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n provided\\\\n    let training_request = Box::new(match fragment_ids.clone() {\\\\n        Some(fragment_ids) =&amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest::with_fragment_ids(\\\\n            Arc::new(dataset.clone()),\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n            fragment_ids,\\\\n        ),\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest { fragment_ids: None },\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    if train {\\\\n        // Use the training request to scan data with fragment filtering\\\\n        if let Some(ref fragment_ids) = training_request.fragment_ids {\\\\n            let fragment_ids = fragment_ids\\\\n                .clone()\\\\n                .into_iter()\\\\n                .sorted()\\\\n                .dedup()\\\\n                .collect_vec();\\\\n            let frags = dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n                .zip(frags)\\\\n                .map(|(id, frag)| {\\\\n                    let Some(frag) = frag else {\\\\n                        return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n                            source: format!(\\\\\\\"No fragment with id {}\\\\\\\", id).into(),\\\\n                            location: location!(),\\\\n                        });\\\\n                    };\\\\n                    Ok(frag.metadata().clone())\\\\n                })\\\\n                .collect();\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, Some(frags?)).await\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\n        }\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// TODO: Allow users to register their own plugins\\\\nstatic SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY: LazyLock&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;ScalarIndexPluginRegistry&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; =\\\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\\\n\\\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;);\\\\n\\\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"VectorIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index supports FTS\\\\n    pub fn supports_fts(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        // In the future this may need to change if we want FTS indices to be pluggable\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"InvertedIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the plugin for the index\\\\n    pub fn get_plugin(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;dyn ScalarIndexPlugin&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(self.0.as_ref())\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\n            Ok(VECTOR_INDEX_VERSION)\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            self.get_plugin().map(|p| p.version())\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n/// Build a Scalar Index (returns details to store in the &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    params: &amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexParams,\\\\n    train: bool,\\\\n    fragment_ids: Option&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;CreatedIndex&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n    let field: arrow_schema::Field = field.into();\\\\n\\\\n    let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_new(dataset, uuid)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_name(&amp;amp;amp;params.index_type)?;\\\\n    let training_request =\\\\n        plugin.new_training_request(params.params.as_deref().unwrap_or(\\\\\\\"{}\\\\\\\"), &amp;amp;amp;field)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let training_data = load_training_data(\\\\n        dataset,\\\\n        column,\\\\n        training_request.criteria(),\\\\n        None,\\\\n        train,\\\\n        fragment_ids.clone(),\\\\n    )\\\\n    .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    plugin\\\\n Some(details) =&amp;amp;gt; details.clone(),\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;gt; infer_scalar_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?,\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub index_dir.child(BITMAP_LOOKUP_NAME);\\\\n    let inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(METADATA_FILE);\\\\n    let legacy_inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(INVERT_LIST_FILE);\\\\n    let index_details = if let DataType::List(_) = col.data_type() {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;LabelListIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;bitmap_page_lookup).await? {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;BitmapIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;inverted_list_lookup).await? {\\\\n        // Try to infer inverted index details from metadata file to capture with_position and other params\\\\n        //         let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\n        };\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\n        .object_store\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\n        .await?\\\\n    {\\\\n };\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\n\\\\n    dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n Result&amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n &amp;amp;amp;params,\\\\n                false,\\\\n            )\\\\n            .await?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(())\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\nmod tests {\\\\n    use }\\\\n\\\\n    async fn create_empty_stream(\\\\n        dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n        column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n        criteria: &amp;amp;amp;TrainingCriteria,\\\\n    ) if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n            fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n                ROW_ADDR,\\\\n                arrow_schema::DataType::UInt64,\\\\n                false,\\\\n            ));\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        // Create schema with the column and row_id field (matching scan_chunks behavior)\\\\n        let schema = -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\n\\\\n    // Fragment filtering is now handled in load_training_data function\\\\n    // This function just processes the fragments passed to it\\\\n\\\\n    let column_field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n    // Datafusion currently has bugs with spilling on string columns\\\\n    // See https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/10073\\\\n    //\\\\n    // One we upgrade we can remove this\\\\n    let use_spilling = !matches!(\\\\n        column_field.data_type(),\\\\n        DataType::Utf8 | DataType::LargeUtf8\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // Note: we don't need to sort for TrainingOrdering::Addresses because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n        scan.order_by(Some(vec![ColumnOrdering::asc_nulls_first(\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n        )]))?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n        scan.with_row_id();\\\\n    }\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\n rows_processed += batch.num_rows();\\\\n        if rows_processed &amp;amp;gt;= next_update {\\\\n            next_update += TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n            info!(\\\\n                \\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\\\\\",\\\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\\\n            );\\\\n        }\\\\n        batch\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n provided\\\\n    let training_request = Box::new(match fragment_ids.clone() {\\\\n        Some(fragment_ids) =&amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest::with_fragment_ids(\\\\n = fragment_ids\\\\n                .clone()\\\\n                .into_iter()\\\\n                .sorted()\\\\n                .dedup()\\\\n                .collect_vec();\\\\n            let frags = dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n {\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\n        }\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// TODO: Allow users to register their own plugins\\\\nstatic SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY: LazyLock&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;ScalarIndexPluginRegistry&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; =\\\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\\\n\\\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;);\\\\n\\\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"VectorIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index supports FTS\\\\n    pub fn supports_fts(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        // In the future this may need to change if we want FTS indices to be pluggable\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"InvertedIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the plugin for the index\\\\n    pub fn get_plugin(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;dyn ScalarIndexPlugin&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(self.0.as_ref())\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\n column,\\\\n        training_request.criteria(),\\\\n        None,\\\\n        train,\\\\n        fragment_ids.clone(),\\\\n    )\\\\n    .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    plugin\\\\n Some(details) =&amp;amp;gt; details.clone(),\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;gt; infer_scalar_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?,\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub MetricsCollector,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;dyn ScalarIndex&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let uuid_str = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\n    let index_store = &amp;amp;amp;index_details, frag_reuse_index, &amp;amp;amp;index_cache)\\\\n        .await\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn infer_scalar_index_details(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n Fall back to defaults if anything goes wrong\\\\n        let default_details = prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap();\\\\n        let parse_params = async || {\\\\n            let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index).ok()?;\\\\n            let reader = index_store.open_index_file(METADATA_FILE).await.ok()?;\\\\n            let params_str = reader.schema().metadata.get(\\\\\\\"params\\\\\\\")?;\\\\n            let params = ::serde_json::from_str::&amp;amp;lt;InvertedIndexParams&amp;amp;gt;(params_str).ok()?;\\\\n            let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\n        };\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\n        .object_store\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\n        .await?\\\\n    {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;BTreeIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\n\\\\n    dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n Result&amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n ds.create_index(&amp;amp;amp;[\\\\\\\"value\\\\\\\"], IndexType::Scalar, None, &amp;amp;amp;params, false)\\\\n            .await\\\\n            .unwrap();\\\\n\\\\n        // Query with index before deletion - should return all 5 rows with value=\\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\"\\\\n        let before_deletion = ds\\\\n            .scan()\\\\n            .filter(\\\\\\\"value = 'apple'\\\\\\\")\\\\n before_deletion_ids,\\\\n            &amp;amp;amp;[0, 2, 4, 6, 8],\\\\n            \\\\\\\"Before deletion: should return 5 rows with value='apple'\\\\\\\"\\\\n        );\\\\n\\\\n        // NOW DELETE rows where value=\\\\\\\"banana\\\\\\\" (rows 1, 3, 5, 7, 9)\\\\n        ds.delete(\\\\\\\"value = 'banana'\\\\\\\").await.unwrap();\\\\n\\\\n        // Query after deletion - should still return 5 rows with value=\\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\"\\\\n        let after_deletion = ds\\\\n            .scan()\\\\n            .filter(\\\\\\\"value = 'apple'\\\\\\\")\\\\n            .unwrap()\\\\n assert_eq!(\\\\n            after_deletion_ids.len(),\\\\n            5,\\\\n            \\\\\\\"After deletion: Expected 5 rows, got {}\\\\\\\",\\\\n            after_deletion_ids.len()\\\\n        );\\\\n        assert_eq!(\\\\n            after_deletion_ids,\\\\n            &amp;amp;amp;[0, 2, 4, 6, 8],\\\\n            \\\\\\\"After deletion: Should return rows [0, 2, 4, 6, 8] with            .flatten()\\\\n            .collect();\\\\n\\\\n        assert_eq!(\\\\n            after_deletion_values,\\\\n            vec![\\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\"],\\\\n            \\\\\\\"All returned rows should have value='apple'\\\\\\\"\\\\n        );\\\\n\\\\n        // Count rows matching \\\\\\\"value = 'apple'\\\\\\\"\\\\n        let count_apple: Vec&amp;amp;lt;arrow_array::RecordBatch&amp;amp;gt; = ds\\\\n            .scan()\\\\n            .filter(\\\\\\\"value = 'apple'\\\\\\\")\\\\n            .unwrap()\\\\n            .try_into_stream()\\\\n            .await\\\\n            .unwrap()\\\\n            .try_collect()\\\\n            .await\\\\n            .unwrap();\\\\n        let count_apple_rows: usize = count_apple.iter().map(|b| b.num_rows()).sum();\\\\n\\\\n        // Count rows matching \\\\\\\"value = 'banana'\\\\\\\" (should be 0 after count_apple_rows, 5,\\\\n            \\\\\\\"Should have exactly 5 rows with value='apple'\\\\\\\"\\\\n        );\\\\n        assert_eq!(\\\\n            count_banana_rows, 0,\\\\n            \\\\\\\"Should have 0 rows with value='banana' after deletion\\\\\\\"\\\\n        );\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\"\""

-&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\n\\\\n    // Fragment    // Datafusion currently has bugs with spilling on string columns\\\\n    // See https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/10073\\\\n    //\\\\n    // One we upgrade we can remove this\\\\n    let because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n   }\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\n         let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\n        };\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\n        .object_store\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\n        .await?\\\\n    {\\\\n };\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\n\\\\n    dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\n\\\\n    // Fragment   }\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\n dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"VectorIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\n Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(schema, batches)))\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn load_training_data(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n }\\\\n\\\\n    async fn create_empty_stream(\\\\n        dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n        column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n        criteria: &amp;amp;amp;TrainingCriteria,\\\\n    ) fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n            VALUE_COLUMN_NAME,\\\\n            column_field.data_type(),\\\\n            true,\\\\n        ));\\\\n        if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n            fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n                ROW_ADDR,\\\\n                arrow_schema::DataType::UInt64,\\\\n                false,\\\\n            ));\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        // Create schema with the column and row_id field (matching scan_chunks behavior)\\\\n        let schema = Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(\\\\n            schema,\\\\n            empty_stream,\\\\n        )))\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn scan_training_data(\\\\n    dataset: -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\n\\\\n    // Fragment filtering is now handled in load_training_data function\\\\n    // This function just processes the fragments passed to it\\\\n\\\\n    let column_field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n use_spilling = !matches!(\\\\n        column_field.data_type(),\\\\n        DataType::Utf8 | DataType::LargeUtf8\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // Note: we don't need to sort for TrainingOrdering::Addresses because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n        scan.order_by(Some(vec![ColumnOrdering::asc_nulls_first(\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n        )]))?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n        scan.with_row_id();\\\\n    }\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\n            use_spilling,\\\\n            ..Default::default()\\\\n        })\\\\n        .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let schema = batches.schema();\\\\n    let mut rows_processed = 0;\\\\n    let mut next_update = TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n    let training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\\\n    info!(\\\\n        \\\\\\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\\\\\",\\\\n        training_uuid, column\\\\n    );\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\n        rows_processed += batch.num_rows();\\\\n        if rows_processed &amp;amp;gt;= next_update {\\\\n            next_update += TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n            info!(\\\\n                \\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\\\\\",\\\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\\\n            );\\\\n        }\\\\n        batch\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n  }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// TODO: Allow users to register their own plugins\\\\nstatic SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY: LazyLock&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;ScalarIndexPluginRegistry&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; =\\\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\\\n\\\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;);\\\\n\\\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"VectorIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\n uuid)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_name(&amp;amp;amp;params.index_type)?;\\\\n    let training_request =\\\\n        plugin.new_training_request(params.params.as_deref().unwrap_or(\\\\\\\"{}\\\\\\\"), &amp;amp;amp;field)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let training_data = load_training_data(\\\\n        dataset,\\\\n async fn open_scalar_index(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\n    metrics: &amp;amp;amp;dyn         let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\n        };\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\n        .object_store\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\n        .await?\\\\n    {\\\\n };\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\n\\\\n    dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n            VALUE_COLUMN_NAME,\\\\n            column_field.data_type(),\\\\n            true,\\\\n        ));\\\\n        if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n            fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n                ROW_ADDR,\\\\n                arrow_schema::DataType::UInt64,\\\\n                false,\\\\n            ));\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        // Create schema with the column and row_id field (matching scan_chunks behavior)\\\\n        let schema = Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(\\\\n            schema,\\\\n            empty_stream,\\\\n        )))\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn scan_training_data(\\\\n    dataset: -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\n\\\\n    // Fragment filtering is now handled in load_training_data function\\\\n    // This function just processes the fragments passed to it\\\\n\\\\n    let column_field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n    // Datafusion currently has bugs with spilling on string columns\\\\n    // See https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/10073\\\\n    //\\\\n    // One we upgrade we can remove this\\\\n    let use_spilling = !matches!(\\\\n        column_field.data_type(),\\\\n        DataType::Utf8 | DataType::LargeUtf8\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // Note: we don't need to sort for TrainingOrdering::Addresses because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n        scan.order_by(Some(vec![ColumnOrdering::asc_nulls_first(\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n        )]))?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n        scan.with_row_id();\\\\n    }\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\n            use_spilling,\\\\n            ..Default::default()\\\\n        })\\\\n        .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let schema = batches.schema();\\\\n    let mut rows_processed = 0;\\\\n    let mut next_update = TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n    let training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\\\n    info!(\\\\n        \\\\\\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\\\\\",\\\\n        training_uuid, column\\\\n    );\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\n        rows_processed += batch.num_rows();\\\\n        if rows_processed &amp;amp;gt;= next_update {\\\\n            next_update += TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n            info!(\\\\n                \\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\\\\\",\\\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\\\n            );\\\\n        }\\\\n        batch\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(schema, batches)))\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn load_training_data(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;TrainingCriteria,\\\\n    fragments: Option&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;Fragment&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n    train: bool,\\\\n    fragment_ids: Option&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // Create training request with fragment_ids if provided\\\\n    let training_request = Box::new(match fragment_ids.clone() {\\\\n        Some(fragment_ids) =&amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest::with_fragment_ids(\\\\n            Arc::new(dataset.clone()),\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n            fragment_ids,\\\\n        ),\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest { fragment_ids: None },\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n = fragment_ids\\\\n                .clone()\\\\n                .into_iter()\\\\n                .sorted()\\\\n                .dedup()\\\\n                .collect_vec();\\\\n            let frags = dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n                .zip(frags)\\\\n                .map(|(id, frag)| {\\\\n                    let Some(frag) = frag else {\\\\n                        return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n                            source: format!(\\\\\\\"No fragment with id {}\\\\\\\", id).into(),\\\\n                            location: location!(),\\\\n                        });\\\\n                    };\\\\n                    Ok(frag.metadata().clone())\\\\n                })\\\\n                .collect();\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, Some(frags?)).await\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\n        }\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\n Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"VectorIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index supports FTS\\\\n    pub fn supports_fts(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        // In the future this may need to change if we want FTS indices to be pluggable\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"InvertedIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the plugin for the index\\\\n    pub fn uuid)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_name(&amp;amp;amp;params.index_type)?;\\\\n    let training_request =\\\\n };\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\n\\\\n    dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n }\\\\n\\\\n    async fn create_empty_stream(\\\\n        dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n        column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n        criteria: &amp;amp;amp;TrainingCriteria,\\\\n    ) fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n            VALUE_COLUMN_NAME,\\\\n            column_field.data_type(),\\\\n            true,\\\\n        ));\\\\n        if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n            fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n                ROW_ID,\\\\n                arrow_schema::DataType::UInt64,\\\\n                false,\\\\n            ));\\\\n        }\\\\n        if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n            fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n                ROW_ADDR,\\\\n                arrow_schema::DataType::UInt64,\\\\n                false,\\\\n            ));\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        // Create schema with the column and row_id field (matching scan_chunks behavior)\\\\n        let schema = Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(\\\\n            schema,\\\\n            empty_stream,\\\\n        )))\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn scan_training_data(\\\\n    dataset:
