= fragment_ids\\\\n                .clone()\\\\n                .into_iter()\\\\n                .sorted()\\\\n                .dedup()\\\\n                .collect_vec();\\\\n            let frags = dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n                .zip(frags)\\\\n                .map(|(id, frag)| {\\\\n                    let Some(frag) = frag else {\\\\n                        return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n                            source: format!(\\\\\\\"No fragment with id {}\\\\\\\", id).into(),\\\\n                            location: location!(),\\\\n                        });\\\\n                    };\\\\n                    Ok(frag.metadata().clone())\\\\n                })\\\\n                .collect();\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, Some(frags?)).await\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\n        }\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\n Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"VectorIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index supports FTS\\\\n    pub fn supports_fts(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        // In the future this may need to change if we want FTS indices to be pluggable\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"InvertedIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the plugin for the index\\\\n    pub fn get_plugin(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;dyn ScalarIndexPlugin&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(self.0.as_ref())\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\n Result&amp;amp;lt;CreatedIndex&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", uuid)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_name(&amp;amp;amp;params.index_type)?;\\\\n    let training_request =\\\\n        plugin.new_training_request(params.params.as_deref().unwrap_or(\\\\\\\"{}\\\\\\\"), &amp;amp;amp;field)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let training_data = load_training_data(\\\\n        dataset,\\\\n        column,\\\\n        training_request.criteria(),\\\\n        None,\\\\n        train,\\\\n        fragment_ids.clone(),\\\\n    )\\\\n    .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    plugin\\\\n        .train_index(training_data, &amp;amp;amp;index_store, training_request, fragment_ids)\\\\n        .await\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n/// Fetches the scalar index plugin for a given index metadata\\\\n///\\\\n/// present in the\\\\n/// index directory to guess the index type.\\\\npub async fn fetch_index_details(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let index_details = match index.index_details.as_ref() {\\\\n        Some(details) =&amp;amp;gt; details.clone(),\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;gt; infer_scalar_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?,\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub async fn open_scalar_index(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\n    metrics: &amp;amp;amp;dyn MetricsCollector,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;dyn ScalarIndex&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let uuid_str = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\n    let index_store = Arc::new(LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index)?);\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = fetch_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?;\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(index_details.as_ref())?;\\\\n\\\\n    let frag_reuse_index = dataset.open_frag_reuse_index(metrics).await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let index_cache = dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n        .for_index(&amp;amp;amp;uuid_str, frag_reuse_index.as_ref().map(|f| &amp;amp;amp;f.uuid));\\\\n\\\\n    plugin\\\\n        .load_index(index_store, &amp;amp;amp;index_details, frag_reuse_index, &amp;amp;amp;index_cache)\\\\n        .await\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn infer_scalar_index_details(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let uuid = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\n    let type_key = crate::session::index_caches::ScalarIndexDetailsKey { uuid: &amp;amp;amp;uuid };\\\\n    if let Some(index_details) = dataset.index_cache.get_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;type_key).await {\\\\n        return Ok(index_details.0.clone());\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let index_dir = dataset.indice_files_dir(index)?.child(uuid.clone());\\\\n    let col = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::Internal {\\\\n        message: format!(\\\\n            \\\\\\\"Index refers to column {} which does not exist in dataset schema\\\\\\\",\\\\n            column\\\\n        ),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n    let bitmap_page_lookup = index_dir.child(BITMAP_LOOKUP_NAME);\\\\n    let inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(METADATA_FILE);\\\\n    let legacy_inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(INVERT_LIST_FILE);\\\\n    let index_details = if let DataType::List(_) = col.data_type() {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;LabelListIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;bitmap_page_lookup).await? {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;BitmapIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;inverted_list_lookup).await? {\\\\n        // Try to infer inverted index details from metadata file to capture with_position and other params\\\\n        // Fall back to defaults if anything goes wrong\\\\n        let default_details = prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap();\\\\n        let parse_params = async || {\\\\n            let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index).ok()?;\\\\n            let reader = index_store.open_index_file(METADATA_FILE).await.ok()?;\\\\n            let params_str = reader.schema().metadata.get(\\\\\\\"params\\\\\\\")?;\\\\n            let params = ::serde_json::from_str::&amp;amp;lt;InvertedIndexParams&amp;amp;gt;(params_str).ok()?;\\\\n            let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\n        };\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\n        .object_store\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\n        .await?\\\\n    {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;BTreeIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\n\\\\n    dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n        .insert_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;type_key, prost_any)\\\\n        .await;\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub fn index_matches_criteria(\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexCriteria,\\\\n    field: &amp;amp;amp;Field,\\\\n    has_multiple_indices: bool,\\\\n    schema: &amp;amp;amp;lance_core::datatypes::Schema,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n nested fields\\\\n        let field_path = if let Some(ancestors) = schema.field_ancestry_by_id(field.id) {\\\\n            let field_refs: Vec&amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;str&amp;amp;gt; = ancestors.iter().map(|f| f.name.as_str()).collect();\\\\n            lance_core::datatypes::format_field_path(&amp;amp;amp;field_refs)\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            field.name.clone()\\\\n        };\\\\n        if for_column != field_path {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = index.index_details.clone().map(IndexDetails);\\\\n    let Some(index_details) = index_details else {\\\\n        if has_multiple_indices {\\\\n            return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n                                source: format!(\\\\n filtering is now handled in load_training_data function\\\\n    // This function just processes the fragments passed to it\\\\n\\\\n    let column_field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n    // Datafusion currently has bugs with spilling on string columns\\\\n    // See https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/10073\\\\n    //\\\\n    // One we upgrade we can remove this\\\\n    let use_spilling = !matches!(\\\\n        column_field.data_type(),\\\\n        DataType::Utf8 | DataType::LargeUtf8\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // Note: we don't need to sort for TrainingOrdering::Addresses because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n        scan.order_by(Some(vec![ColumnOrdering::asc_nulls_first(\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n        )]))?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n        scan.with_row_id();\\\\n    }\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\n rows_processed += batch.num_rows();\\\\n        if rows_processed &amp;amp;gt;= next_update {\\\\n            next_update += TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n            info!(\\\\n                \\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\\\\\",\\\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\\\n            );\\\\n        }\\\\n        batch\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n provided\\\\n    let training_request = Box::new(match fragment_ids.clone() {\\\\n        Some(fragment_ids) =&amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest::with_fragment_ids(\\\\n = fragment_ids\\\\n                .clone()\\\\n                .into_iter()\\\\n                .sorted()\\\\n                .dedup()\\\\n                .collect_vec();\\\\n            let frags = dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n                .zip(frags)\\\\n                .map(|(id, frag)| {\\\\n                    let Some(frag) = frag else {\\\\n                        return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n                            source: format!(\\\\\\\"No fragment with id {}\\\\\\\", id).into(),\\\\n                            location: location!(),\\\\n                        });\\\\n                    };\\\\n                    Ok(frag.metadata().clone())\\\\n                })\\\\n                .collect();\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, Some(frags?)).await\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\n        }\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\n =\\\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\\\n\\\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;);\\\\n\\\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"VectorIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index supports FTS\\\\n    pub fn supports_fts(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        // In the future this may need to change if we want FTS indices to be pluggable\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"InvertedIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the plugin for the index\\\\n    pub fn get_plugin(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;dyn ScalarIndexPlugin&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(self.0.as_ref())\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\n Result&amp;amp;lt;CreatedIndex&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", plugin.new_training_request(params.params.as_deref().unwrap_or(\\\\\\\"{}\\\\\\\"), &amp;amp;amp;field)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let training_data = load_training_data(\\\\n        dataset,\\\\n        column,\\\\n        training_request.criteria(),\\\\n        None,\\\\n        train,\\\\n        fragment_ids.clone(),\\\\n    )\\\\n    .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    plugin\\\\n Some(details) =&amp;amp;gt; details.clone(),\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;gt; infer_scalar_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?,\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub index_dir.child(BITMAP_LOOKUP_NAME);\\\\n    let inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(METADATA_FILE);\\\\n    let legacy_inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(INVERT_LIST_FILE);\\\\n    let index_details = if let DataType::List(_) = col.data_type() {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;LabelListIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;bitmap_page_lookup).await? {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;BitmapIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;inverted_list_lookup).await? {\\\\n        // Try to infer inverted index details from metadata file to capture with_position and other params\\\\n        // || {\\\\n            let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index).ok()?;\\\\n            let reader = index_store.open_index_file(METADATA_FILE).await.ok()?;\\\\n         let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\n        };\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\n        .object_store\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\n        .await?\\\\n    {\\\\n };\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\n\\\\n    dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n Result&amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n &amp;amp;amp;NoOpMetricsCollector,\\\\n        )\\\\n        .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let params = source_scalar_index.derive_index_params()?;\\\\n    let index_type = &amp;amp;amp;params,\\\\n                false,\\\\n            )\\\\n            .await?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(())\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\nmod tests {\\\\n    use if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n            fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n                ROW_ADDR,\\\\n                arrow_schema::DataType::UInt64,\\\\n                false,\\\\n            ));\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        // Create schema with the column and row_id field (matching scan_chunks behavior)\\\\n        let schema = -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\n\\\\n    // Fragment filtering is now handled in load_training_data function\\\\n    // This function just processes the fragments passed to it\\\\n\\\\n    let column_field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n    // Datafusion currently has bugs with spilling on string columns\\\\n    // See https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/10073\\\\n    //\\\\n    // One we upgrade we can remove this\\\\n    let use_spilling = !matches!(\\\\n        column_field.data_type(),\\\\n        DataType::Utf8 | DataType::LargeUtf8\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // Note: we don't need to sort for TrainingOrdering::Addresses because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n   }\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\n = fragment_ids\\\\n                .clone()\\\\n                .into_iter()\\\\n                .sorted()\\\\n                .dedup()\\\\n                .collect_vec();\\\\n            let frags = dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n {\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\n        }\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\n =\\\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\\\n\\\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;);\\\\n\\\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\\\n    /// }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index supports FTS\\\\n    pub fn supports_fts(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        // In the future this may need to change if we want FTS get_plugin(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;dyn ScalarIndexPlugin&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(self.0.as_ref())\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\n Some(details) =&amp;amp;gt; details.clone(),\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;gt; infer_scalar_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?,\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub || {\\\\n            let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index).ok()?;\\\\n            let reader = index_store.open_index_file(METADATA_FILE).await.ok()?;\\\\n         let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\n        };\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\n        .object_store\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\n        .await?\\\\n    {\\\\n return 5 rows with value=\\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\"\\\\n        let after_deletion = ds\\\\n            .scan()\\\\n            .filter(\\\\\\\"value = 'apple'\\\\\\\")\\\\n            .unwrap()\\\\n    // Datafusion currently has bugs with spilling on string columns\\\\n    // See https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/10073\\\\n    //\\\\n    // One we upgrade we can remove this\\\\n    let because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n   }\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\n         let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\n        };\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\n        .object_store\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\n        .await?\\\\n    {\\\\n };\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\n\\\\n    dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n \\\\\\\"Should have 0 rows with value='banana' after deletion\\\\\\\"\\\\n        );\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\"\""

-&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\n\\\\n    // Fragment dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n   }\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\n\\\\n    if let dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\n };\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\n\\\\n    dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\n\\\\n    // Fragment dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n    // Datafusion currently has bugs with spilling on string columns\\\\n    // See https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/10073\\\\n    //\\\\n    // One we upgrade we can remove this\\\\n    let use_spilling = !matches!(\\\\n        column_field.data_type(),\\\\n        DataType::Utf8 | DataType::LargeUtf8\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // Note: we don't need to sort for TrainingOrdering::Addresses because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n        scan.order_by(Some(vec![ColumnOrdering::asc_nulls_first(\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n        )]))?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n        scan.with_row_id();\\\\n    }\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\n            use_spilling,\\\\n            ..Default::default()\\\\n        })\\\\n        .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let schema = batches.schema();\\\\n    let mut rows_processed = 0;\\\\n    let mut next_update = TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n    let training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\\\n    info!(\\\\n        \\\\\\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\\\\\",\\\\n        training_uuid, column\\\\n    );\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\n        rows_processed += batch.num_rows();\\\\n        if rows_processed &amp;amp;gt;= next_update {\\\\n            next_update += TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n            info!(\\\\n                \\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\\\\\",\\\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\\\n            );\\\\n        }\\\\n        batch\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(schema, batches)))\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn load_training_data(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;TrainingCriteria,\\\\n    fragments: Option&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;Fragment&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n    train: bool,\\\\n    fragment_ids: Option&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // Create training request with fragment_ids if    if train {\\\\n        // Use the training request to scan data with fragment filtering\\\\n        if let Some(ref fragment_ids) = training_request.fragment_ids {\\\\n            let fragment_ids = fragment_ids\\\\n                .clone()\\\\n                .into_iter()\\\\n                .sorted()\\\\n                .dedup()\\\\n                .collect_vec();\\\\n            let frags = dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n                .zip(frags)\\\\n                .map(|(id, frag)| {\\\\n                    let Some(frag) = frag else {\\\\n                        return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n {\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\n        }\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\n =\\\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\\\n\\\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;);\\\\n\\\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\\\n    /// uuid)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_name(&amp;amp;amp;params.index_type)?;\\\\n    let training_request =\\\\n if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n            fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n                ROW_ADDR,\\\\n                arrow_schema::DataType::UInt64,\\\\n                false,\\\\n            ));\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        // Create schema with the column and row_id field (matching scan_chunks behavior)\\\\n        let schema = Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(\\\\n            schema,\\\\n            empty_stream,\\\\n        )))\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn scan_training_data(\\\\n    dataset: dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n use_spilling = !matches!(\\\\n        column_field.data_type(),\\\\n        DataType::Utf8 | DataType::LargeUtf8\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // Note: we don't need to sort for TrainingOrdering::Addresses because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n        scan.order_by(Some(vec![ColumnOrdering::asc_nulls_first(\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n        )]))?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n        scan.with_row_id();\\\\n Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\n            use_spilling,\\\\n            ..Default::default()\\\\n        })\\\\n        .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let schema = batches.schema();\\\\n    let mut rows_processed = 0;\\\\n    let mut next_update = TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n    let training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\\\n    info!(\\\\n        \\\\\\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\\\\\",\\\\n        training_uuid, column\\\\n    );\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\n        rows_processed += batch.num_rows();\\\\n        if rows_processed &amp;amp;gt;= next_update {\\\\n            next_update += TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n            info!(\\\\n                \\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\\\\\",\\\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\\\n            );\\\\n        }\\\\n        batch\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(schema, batches)))\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn load_training_data(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n {\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\n        }\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// TODO: Allow users to register their own plugins\\\\nstatic SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY: LazyLock&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;ScalarIndexPluginRegistry&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; =\\\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\\\n\\\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;);\\\\n\\\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\\\n    /// }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\n uuid)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_name(&amp;amp;amp;params.index_type)?;\\\\n    let training_request =\\\\n        plugin.new_training_request(params.params.as_deref().unwrap_or(\\\\\\\"{}\\\\\\\"), &amp;amp;amp;field)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let training_data = load_training_data(\\\\n        dataset,\\\\n         let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\n        };\\\\n fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n            VALUE_COLUMN_NAME,\\\\n            column_field.data_type(),\\\\n            true,\\\\n        ));\\\\n        if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n            fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n                ROW_ID,\\\\n                arrow_schema::DataType::UInt64,\\\\n                false,\\\\n            ));\\\\n        }\\\\n        if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n            fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n                ROW_ADDR,\\\\n                arrow_schema::DataType::UInt64,\\\\n                false,\\\\n            ));\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        // Create schema with the column and row_id field (matching scan_chunks behavior)\\\\n        let schema = Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(\\\\n            schema,\\\\n            empty_stream,\\\\n        )))\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn scan_training_data(\\\\n    dataset: -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\n\\\\n    // Fragment filtering is now handled in load_training_data function\\\\n    // This function just processes the fragments passed to it\\\\n\\\\n    let column_field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n    // Datafusion currently has bugs with spilling on string columns\\\\n    // See https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/10073\\\\n    //\\\\n    // One we upgrade we can remove this\\\\n    let use_spilling = !matches!(\\\\n        column_field.data_type(),\\\\n        DataType::Utf8 | DataType::LargeUtf8\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // Note: we don't need to sort for TrainingOrdering::Addresses because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n        scan.order_by(Some(vec![ColumnOrdering::asc_nulls_first(\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n        )]))?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n        scan.with_row_id();\\\\n    }\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\n            use_spilling,\\\\n            ..Default::default()\\\\n        })\\\\n        .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let schema = batches.schema();\\\\n    let mut rows_processed = 0;\\\\n    let mut next_update = TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n    let training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\\\n    info!(\\\\n        \\\\\\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\\\\\",\\\\n        training_uuid, column\\\\n    );\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\n        rows_processed += batch.num_rows();\\\\n        if rows_processed &amp;amp;gt;= next_update {\\\\n            next_update += TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n            info!(\\\\n                \\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\\\\\",\\\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\\\n            );\\\\n        }\\\\n        batch\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(schema, batches)))\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn load_training_data(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;TrainingCriteria,\\\\n    fragments: Option&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;Fragment&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n    train: bool,\\\\n    fragment_ids: Option&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // Create training request with fragment_ids if provided\\\\n    let training_request = Box::new(match fragment_ids.clone() {\\\\n        Some(fragment_ids) =&amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest::with_fragment_ids(\\\\n            Arc::new(dataset.clone()),\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n            fragment_ids,\\\\n        ),\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest { fragment_ids: None },\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    if train {\\\\n        // Use the training request to scan data with fragment filtering\\\\n        if let Some(ref fragment_ids) = training_request.fragment_ids {\\\\n            let fragment_ids = fragment_ids\\\\n                .clone()\\\\n                .into_iter()\\\\n                .sorted()\\\\n                .dedup()\\\\n                .collect_vec();\\\\n            let frags = dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n                .zip(frags)\\\\n                .map(|(id, frag)| {\\\\n                    let Some(frag) = frag else {\\\\n                        return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n                            source: format!(\\\\\\\"No fragment with id {}\\\\\\\", id).into(),\\\\n                            location: location!(),\\\\n                        });\\\\n                    };\\\\n                    Ok(frag.metadata().clone())\\\\n                })\\\\n                .collect();\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, Some(frags?)).await\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\n        }\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\n Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"VectorIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n            fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n                ROW_ADDR,\\\\n                arrow_schema::DataType::UInt64,\\\\n                false,\\\\n -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\n\\\\n    // Fragment filtering is now handled in load_training_data function\\\\n    // This function just processes the fragments passed to it\\\\n\\\\n    let column_field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n    // Datafusion currently has bugs with spilling on string columns\\\\n    // See https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/10073\\\\n    //\\\\n    // One we upgrade we can remove this\\\\n    let use_spilling = !matches!(\\\\n        column_field.data_type(),\\\\n        DataType::Utf8 | DataType::LargeUtf8\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // Note: we don't need to sort for TrainingOrdering::Addresses because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n        scan.order_by(Some(vec![ColumnOrdering::asc_nulls_first(\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n        )]))?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n        scan.with_row_id();\\\\n    }\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\n TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n    let training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\\\n    info!(\\\\n        \\\\\\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\\\\\",\\\\n        training_uuid, column\\\\n    );\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\n        rows_processed += batch.num_rows();\\\\n        if rows_processed &amp;amp;gt;= next_update {\\\\n            next_update += TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n            info!(\\\\n                \\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\\\\\",\\\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\\\n            );\\\\n        }\\\\n        batch\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n provided\\\\n    let training_request = Box::new(match fragment_ids.clone() {\\\\n        Some(fragment_ids) =&amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest::with_fragment_ids(\\\\n            Arc::new(dataset.clone()),\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n            fragment_ids,\\\\n        ),\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest { fragment_ids: None },\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    if train {\\\\n        // Use the training request to scan data with fragment filtering\\\\n        if let Some(ref fragment_ids) = training_request.fragment_ids {\\\\n            let fragment_ids = fragment_ids\\\\n                .clone()\\\\n                .into_iter()\\\\n                .sorted()\\\\n                .dedup()\\\\n                .collect_vec();\\\\n            let frags = dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n                .zip(frags)\\\\n                .map(|(id, frag)| {\\\\n                    let Some(frag) = frag else {\\\\n                        return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n                            source: format!(\\\\\\\"No fragment with id {}\\\\\\\", id).into(),\\\\n                            location: location!(),\\\\n                        });\\\\n                    };\\\\n                    Ok(frag.metadata().clone())\\\\n                })\\\\n                .collect();\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, Some(frags?)).await\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\n        }\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// TODO: Allow users to register their own plugins\\\\nstatic SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY: LazyLock&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;ScalarIndexPluginRegistry&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; =\\\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\\\n\\\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;);\\\\n\\\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"VectorIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index supports FTS\\\\n    pub fn supports_fts(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        // In the future this may need to change if we want FTS indices to be pluggable\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"InvertedIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the plugin for the index\\\\n    pub fn get_plugin(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;dyn ScalarIndexPlugin&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(self.0.as_ref())\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\n            Ok(VECTOR_INDEX_VERSION)\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            self.get_plugin().map(|p| p.version())\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n/// Build a Scalar Index (returns details to store in the manifest)\\\\n#[instrument(level = \\\\\\\"debug\\\\\\\", skip_all)]\\\\npub(super) async fn build_scalar_index(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    uuid: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    params: &amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexParams,\\\\n    train: bool,\\\\n    fragment_ids: Option&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;CreatedIndex&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n    let field: arrow_schema::Field = field.into();\\\\n\\\\n    let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_new(dataset, uuid)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_name(&amp;amp;amp;params.index_type)?;\\\\n    let training_request =\\\\n        plugin.new_training_request(params.params.as_deref().unwrap_or(\\\\\\\"{}\\\\\\\"), &amp;amp;amp;field)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let training_data = load_training_data(\\\\n        dataset,\\\\n        column,\\\\n        training_request.criteria(),\\\\n        None,\\\\n        train,\\\\n        fragment_ids.clone(),\\\\n    )\\\\n    .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    plugin\\\\n &amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let index_details = match index.index_details.as_ref() {\\\\n        Some(details) =&amp;amp;gt; details.clone(),\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;gt; infer_scalar_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?,\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub index_dir.child(BITMAP_LOOKUP_NAME);\\\\n    let inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(METADATA_FILE);\\\\n    let legacy_inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(INVERT_LIST_FILE);\\\\n    let index_details = if let DataType::List(_) = col.data_type() {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;LabelListIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;bitmap_page_lookup).await? {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;BitmapIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;inverted_list_lookup).await? {\\\\n        // Try to infer inverted index details from metadata file to capture with_position and other params\\\\n        // || {\\\\n            let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index).ok()?;\\\\n            let reader = index_store.open_index_file(METADATA_FILE).await.ok()?;\\\\n         let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\n        };\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\n        .object_store\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\n        .await?\\\\n    {\\\\n };\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\n\\\\n    dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n Result&amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n &amp;amp;amp;NoOpMetricsCollector,\\\\n        )\\\\n        .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let params = source_scalar_index.derive_index_params()?;\\\\n    let index_type = &amp;amp;amp;params,\\\\n                false,\\\\n            )\\\\n            .await?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(())\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\nmod tests {\\\\n    use number_of_items: u64,\\\\n            probability: f64,\\\\n        }\\\\n        let params = ScalarIndexParams::for_builtin(BuiltinIndexType::BloomFilter).with_params(\\\\n Self {\\n        Self {\\n            path: path.into(),\\n            fields,\\n            column_indices,\\n            file_major_version,\\n            file_minor_version,\\n            file_size_bytes: file_size_bytes.into(),\\n            base_id,\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    /// Create a new &amp;#96;DataFile&amp;#96; with the expectation that fields and column_indices will be set later\\n    pub fn new_unstarted(\\n        path: impl Into&amp;lt;String&amp;gt;,\\n        file_major_version: u32,\\n        file_minor_version: u32,\\n    ) -&amp;gt; Self {\\n        Self {\\n            path: path.into(),\\n            fields: vec![],\\n            column_indices: vec![],\\n            file_major_version,\\n            file_minor_version,\\n            file_size_bytes: Default::default(),\\n            base_id: None,\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    pub fn new_legacy_from_fields(\\n        path: impl Into&amp;lt;String&amp;gt;,\\n        fields: Vec&amp;lt;i32&amp;gt;,\\n        base_id: Option&amp;lt;u32&amp;gt;,\\n    ) -&amp;gt; Self {\\n        Self::new(\\n            path,\\n            fields,\\n            vec![],\\n            MAJOR_VERSION as u32,\\n            MINOR_VERSION as u32,\\n            None,\\n            base_id,\\n        )\\n    }\\n\\n    pub fn new_legacy(\\n        path: impl Into&amp;lt;String&amp;gt;,\\n        schema: &amp;amp;Schema,\\n        file_size_bytes: Option&amp;lt;NonZero&amp;lt;u64&amp;gt;&amp;gt;,\\n        base_id: Option&amp;lt;u32&amp;gt;,\\n    ) -&amp;gt; self.file_minor_version &amp;lt; 3\\n    }\\n\\n    pub fn validate(&amp;amp;self, base_path: &amp;amp;Path) -&amp;gt; Result&amp;lt;()&amp;gt; {\\n        if self.is_legacy_file() {\\n            if !self.fields.windows(2).all(|w| w[0] &amp;lt; Ok(Self::Inline(data)),\\n            pb::data_fragment::RowIdSequence::ExternalRowIds(file) =&amp;gt; {\\n                Ok(Self::External(ExternalFile {\\n                    path: file.path.clone(),\\n                    offset: file.offset,\\n                    size: file.size,\\n                }))\\n            }\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n/// Data fragment.\\n///\\n/// A fragment is a set of files which represent the different columns of the same rows.\\n/// If column exists in the schema, but the related file does not exist, treat this column as &amp;#96;nulls&amp;#96;.\\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, DeepSizeOf)]\\npub struct Fragment {\\n    /// Fragment ID\\n    pub id: u64,\\n\\n    /// Files within the fragment.\\n    pub files: Vec&amp;lt;DataFile&amp;gt;,\\n\\n    /// Optional file with deleted local row offsets.\\n    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = \\\"Option::is_none\\\")]\\n    pub deletion_file: Option&amp;lt;DeletionFile&amp;gt;,\\n\\n    /// RowIndex\\n    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = \\\"Option::is_none\\\")]\\n    pub row_id_meta: Option&amp;lt;RowIdMeta&amp;gt;,\\n\\n    /// Original number of rows in the fragment. ::serde_json::from_str::&amp;amp;amp;lt;InvertedIndexParams&amp;amp;amp;gt;(params_str).ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\\\\\n        .object_store\\\\\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\\\\\n        .await?\\\\\\\\n    {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;BTreeIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    dataset\\\\\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\\\\\n        .insert_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;amp;type_key, prost_any)\\\\\\\\n        .await;\\\\\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub fn index_matches_criteria(\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexCriteria,\\\\\\\\n    field: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Field,\\\\\\\\n    has_multiple_indices: bool,\\\\\\\\n    schema: &amp;amp;amp;amp;lance_core::datatypes::Schema,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(for_column) = criteria.for_column {\\\\\\\\n        if index.fields.len() != 1 {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        // Build the full field path for nested fields\\\\\\\\n        let field_path = if let Some(ancestors) = schema.field_ancestry_by_id(field.id) {\\\\\\\\n lance_core::datatypes::format_field_path(&amp;amp;amp;amp;field_refs)\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            field.name.clone()\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n        if for_column != field_path {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = index.index_details.clone().map(IndexDetails);\\\\\\\\n    let Some(index_details) = index_details else {\\\\\\\\n        if has_multiple_indices {\\\\\\\\n            return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\\\\\n                                source: format!(\\\\\\\\n index.fields.first().unwrap_or(&amp;amp;amp;amp;0),\\\\\\\\n                                ).into(),\\\\\\\\n                                location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n                            });\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n        // If we don't have details then allow it for backwards compatibility\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(true);\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if index_details.is_vector() {\\\\\\\\n        // This method is only for finding matching scalar indexes today so reject any vector indexes\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_fts &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; !index_details.supports_fts() {\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // We should not use FTS / NGram indices for exact equality queries\\\\\\\\n    // (i.e. merge insert with a join on the indexed column)\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_exact_equality {\\\\\\\\n        let &amp;amp;amp;amp;[column_name],\\\\\\\\n                index_type,\\\\\\\\n                Some(source_index.name.clone()),\\\\\\\\n                &amp;amp;amp;amp;params,\\\\\\\\n                false,\\\\\\\\n            )\\\\\\\\n            .await?;\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(())\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod tests {\\\\\\\\n    use Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\\\\\n scan.with_row_id();\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\\\\\n            use_spilling,\\\\\\\\n            ..Default::default()\\\\\\\\n        })\\\\\\\\n        .await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let schema = batches.schema();\\\\\\\\n    let mut rows_processed = 0;\\\\\\\\n    let mut next_update = TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\\\\\n    let training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\\\\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\\n        \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n        training_uuid, column\\\\\\\\n    );\\\\\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\\\\\n batch\\\\\\\\n    });\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(schema, batches)))\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub(crate) async fn load_training_data(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: Option&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt;,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    // Create supports_fts(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\\\\\n        // In the future this may need to change if we want FTS indices to be pluggable\\\\\\\\n get_plugin(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;dyn ScalarIndexPlugin&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\\\\\n            Ok(VECTOR_INDEX_VERSION)\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            self.get_plugin().map(|p| p.version())\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Build a Scalar Index (returns details to store in the manifest)\\\\\\\\n#[instrument(level = location!(),\\\\\\\\n    })?;\\\\\\\\n    let field: arrow_schema::Field = field.into();\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_new(dataset, uuid)?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n plugin.new_training_request(params.params.as_deref().unwrap_or(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"), &amp;amp;amp;amp;field)?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let training_data = load_training_data(\\\\\\\\n        dataset,\\\\\\\\n        column,\\\\\\\\n        training_request.criteria(),\\\\\\\\n        None,\\\\\\\\n        train,\\\\\\\\n        fragment_ids.clone(),\\\\\\\\n    )\\\\\\\\n    .await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    plugin\\\\\\\\n        .train_index(training_data, &amp;amp;amp;amp;index_store, training_request, fragment_ids)\\\\\\\\n        .await\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Fetches the scalar index plugin for a given index metadata\\\\\\\\n///\\\\\\\\n/// The fast path, on newer datasets, is just a plugin lookup by the type URL of the index details.\\\\\\\\n///\\\\\\\\n/// If the index details are missing (older dataset) then we need to look at the files present in the\\\\\\\\n/// index directory to guess the index type.\\\\\\\\npub async fn fetch_index_details(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = match index.index_details.as_ref() {\\\\\\\\n        Some(details) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; details.clone(),\\\\\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;amp;gt; infer_scalar_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?,\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub async fn open_scalar_index(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    index: index)?);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = fetch_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?;\\\\\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(index_details.as_ref())?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let frag_reuse_index = dataset.open_frag_reuse_index(metrics).await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_cache = dataset\\\\\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\\\\\n        .for_index(&amp;amp;amp;amp;uuid_str, frag_reuse_index.as_ref().map(|f| &amp;amp;amp;amp;f.uuid));\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    plugin\\\\\\\\n        .load_index(index_store, &amp;amp;amp;amp;index_details, frag_reuse_index, &amp;amp;amp;amp;index_cache)\\\\\\\\n        .await\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub(crate) async fn infer_scalar_index_details(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let uuid = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\\\\\n    let type_key = crate::session::index_caches::ScalarIndexDetailsKey { uuid: &amp;amp;amp;amp;uuid };\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(index_details) = dataset.index_cache.get_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;amp;type_key).await {\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(index_details.0.clone());\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_dir = dataset.indice_files_dir(index)?.child(uuid.clone());\\\\\\\\n    let col = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::Internal {\\\\\\\\n        message: format!(\\\\\\\\n            \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Index refers to column {} which does not exist in dataset schema\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n            column\\\\\\\\n        ),\\\\\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n    })?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let bitmap_page_lookup = index_dir.child(BITMAP_LOOKUP_NAME);\\\\\\\\n    let inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(METADATA_FILE);\\\\\\\\n    let legacy_inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(INVERT_LIST_FILE);\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = if let DataType::List(_) = col.data_type() {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;LabelListIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;amp;bitmap_page_lookup).await? {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;BitmapIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;amp;inverted_list_lookup).await? {\\\\\\\\n        // Try to infer inverted index details from metadata file to capture with_position and other params\\\\\\\\n        // Fall back to defaults if anything goes wrong\\\\\\\\n        let default_details = prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap();\\\\\\\\n        let parse_params = async || {\\\\\\\\n            let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index).ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            let reader = index_store.open_index_file(METADATA_FILE).await.ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            let params_str = reader.schema().metadata.get(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"params\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n            let params = ::serde_json::from_str::&amp;amp;amp;lt;InvertedIndexParams&amp;amp;amp;gt;(params_str).ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\\\\\n        .object_store\\\\\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\\\\\n        .await?\\\\\\\\n    {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;BTreeIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    dataset\\\\\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\\\\\n        .insert_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;amp;type_key, prost_any)\\\\\\\\n        .await;\\\\\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub fn index_matches_criteria(\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexCriteria,\\\\\\\\n    field: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Field,\\\\\\\\n    has_multiple_indices: bool,\\\\\\\\n    schema: &amp;amp;amp;amp;lance_core::datatypes::Schema,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(for_column) = criteria.for_column {\\\\\\\\n        if index.fields.len() != 1 {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        // Build the full field path for nested fields\\\\\\\\n        let field_path = if let Some(ancestors) = schema.field_ancestry_by_id(field.id) {\\\\\\\\n {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = index.index_details.clone().map(IndexDetails);\\\\\\\\n    let Some(index_details) = index.fields.first().unwrap_or(&amp;amp;amp;amp;0),\\\\\\\\n                                ).into(),\\\\\\\\n                                location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n index_details.is_vector() {\\\\\\\\n        // This method is only for finding matching scalar indexes today so reject any vector indexes\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_fts &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; !index_details.supports_fts() {\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // We should not use FTS / NGram indices for exact equality queries\\\\\\\\n    // (i.e. merge insert with a join on the indexed column)\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_exact_equality {\\\\\\\\n        let &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;amp;TrainingCriteria,\\\\\\\\n    fragments: Option&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;Fragment&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt;,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // Fragment filtering is now handled in load_training_data function\\\\\\\\n    // This function just processes the fragments passed to it\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n    })?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // Datafusion currently has bugs with spilling on string columns\\\\\\\\n    // See https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/10073\\\\\\\\n    //\\\\\\\\n    // One we upgrade we can remove this\\\\\\\\n    let use_spilling = !matches!(\\\\\\\\n Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\\\\\n scan.with_row_id();\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\\\\\n            use_spilling,\\\\\\\\n            ..Default::default()\\\\\\\\n        })\\\\\\\\n        .await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let schema = batches.schema();\\\\\\\\n    let mut rows_processed = 0;\\\\\\\\n    let mut next_update = TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\\\\\n    let training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\\\\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\\n        \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n        training_uuid, column\\\\\\\\n    );\\\\\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\\\\\n batch\\\\\\\\n    });\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(schema, batches)))\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub(crate) async fn load_training_data(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;amp;TrainingCriteria,\\\\\\\\n    fragments: Option&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt;,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    // Create training request with fragment_ids if provided\\\\\\\\n    let training_request = Box::new(match fragment_ids.clone() {\\\\\\\\n        Some(fragment_ids) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest::with_fragment_ids(\\\\\\\\n            Arc::new(dataset.clone()),\\\\\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\\\\\n            fragment_ids,\\\\\\\\n        ),\\\\\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest { fragment_ids: None },\\\\\\\\n    });\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if train {\\\\\\\\n        // Use the training request to scan data with fragment filtering\\\\\\\\n dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\\\\\n                .iter()\\\\\\\\n                .zip(frags)\\\\\\\\n                .map(|(id, frag)| {\\\\\\\\n                    let Some(frag) = frag else {\\\\\\\\n                        return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\\\\\n                            source: format!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"No fragment with id {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", id).into(),\\\\\\\\n                            location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n                        });\\\\\\\\n                    };\\\\\\\\n                    Ok(frag.metadata().clone())\\\\\\\\n                })\\\\\\\\n                .collect();\\\\\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, Some(frags?)).await\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    } else {\\\\\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n// TODO: Allow users to register their own plugins\\\\\\\\nstatic SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY: LazyLock&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;ScalarIndexPluginRegistry&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; =\\\\\\\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"VectorIndexDetails\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index supports FTS\\\\\\\\n    pub fn -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\\\\\n            Ok(VECTOR_INDEX_VERSION)\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            self.get_plugin().map(|p| p.version())\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Build a Scalar Index (returns details to store in the manifest)\\\\\\\\n#[instrument(level = \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"debug\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", skip_all)]\\\\\\\\npub(super) async fn build_scalar_index(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n location!(),\\\\\\\\n    })?;\\\\\\\\n    let field: arrow_schema::Field = field.into();\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_new(dataset, uuid)?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n plugin.new_training_request(params.params.as_deref().unwrap_or(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"), &amp;amp;amp;amp;field)?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let training_data = load_training_data(\\\\\\\\n .await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    plugin\\\\\\\\n        .train_index(training_data, &amp;amp;amp;amp;index_store, training_request, fragment_ids)\\\\\\\\n        .await\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Fetches the scalar index plugin for a given index metadata\\\\\\\\n///\\\\\\\\n/// The fast path, on newer datasets, is just a plugin lookup by the type URL of the index Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = match index.index_details.as_ref() {\\\\\\\\n        Some(details) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; details.clone(),\\\\\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;amp;gt; infer_scalar_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?,\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n .await;\\\\\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub fn index_matches_criteria(\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n    criteria: -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\\\\\n -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let mut scan = location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n    })?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // Datafusion currently has bugs with spilling on string columns\\\\\\\\n    // See Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\\\\\n        scan.order_by(Some(vec![ColumnOrdering::asc_nulls_first(\\\\\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\\\\\n        )]))?;\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_row_id();\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\\\\\n            use_spilling,\\\\\\\\n            ..Default::default()\\\\\\\\n        })\\\\\\\\n        .await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let schema = batches.schema();\\\\\\\\n    let mut rows_processed = 0;\\\\\\\\n    let mut next_update = TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\\\\\n    let training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\\\\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\\n        \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n        training_uuid, column\\\\\\\\n    );\\\\\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\\\\\n             \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\\\\\\\n            );\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        batch\\\\\\\\n    });\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(schema, batches)))\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub(crate) async fn load_training_data(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;amp;TrainingCriteria,\\\\\\\\n    fragments: Option&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;Fragment&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt;,\\\\\\\\n    train: bool,\\\\\\\\n    fragment_ids: Option&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt;,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    // Create training request with fragment_ids if provided\\\\\\\\n    let training_request = Box::new(match fragment_ids.clone() {\\\\\\\\n        Some(fragment_ids) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest::with_fragment_ids(\\\\\\\\n            Arc::new(dataset.clone()),\\\\\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\\\\\n            fragment_ids,\\\\\\\\n        ),\\\\\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest { fragment_ids: None },\\\\\\\\n    });\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if train {\\\\\\\\n        // Use the training request to scan data with fragment filtering\\\\\\\\n        if let Some(ref fragment_ids) = training_request.fragment_ids {\\\\\\\\n            let fragment_ids = fragment_ids\\\\\\\\n                .clone()\\\\\\\\n                .into_iter()\\\\\\\\n                .sorted()\\\\\\\\n                .dedup()\\\\\\\\n                .collect_vec();\\\\\\\\n            let frags = dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\\\\\n                .iter()\\\\\\\\n                .zip(frags)\\\\\\\\n                .map(|(id, frag)| {\\\\\\\\n                    let Some(frag) = frag else {\\\\\\\\n                        return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\\\\\n                            source: format!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"No fragment with id {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", id).into(),\\\\\\\\n                            location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n                        });\\\\\\\\n                    };\\\\\\\\n                    Ok(frag.metadata().clone())\\\\\\\\n                })\\\\\\\\n                .collect();\\\\\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, Some(frags?)).await\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    } else {\\\\\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n// TODO: Allow users to register their own plugins\\\\\\\\nstatic SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY: LazyLock&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;ScalarIndexPluginRegistry&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; =\\\\\\\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"VectorIndexDetails\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index supports FTS\\\\\\\\n    pub fn supports_fts(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\\\\\n        // In the future this may need to change if we want FTS indices to be pluggable\\\\\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"InvertedIndexDetails\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns the plugin for the index\\\\\\\\n    pub fn get_plugin(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;dyn ScalarIndexPlugin&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n        SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(self.0.as_ref())\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\\\\\n            Ok(VECTOR_INDEX_VERSION)\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            self.get_plugin().map(|p| p.version())\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Build a Scalar Index (returns details to store in the manifest)\\\\\\\\n#[instrument(level = \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"debug\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", skip_all)]\\\\\\\\npub(super) async fn build_scalar_index(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n
