self.get_plugin().map(|p| p.version())\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Build a Scalar Index (returns details to store in the manifest)\\\\\\\\n#[instrument(level = \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"debug\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", skip_all)]\\\\\\\\npub(super) async fn build_scalar_index(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    uuid: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    params: &amp;amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexParams,\\\\\\\\n    train: bool,\\\\\\\\n    fragment_ids: Option&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt;,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;CreatedIndex&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n    })?;\\\\\\\\n    let field: arrow_schema::Field = field.into();\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_new(dataset, uuid)?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_name(&amp;amp;amp;amp;params.index_type)?;\\\\\\\\n    let training_request =\\\\\\\\n        plugin.new_training_request(params.params.as_deref().unwrap_or(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"), &amp;amp;amp;amp;field)?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let training_data = load_training_data(\\\\\\\\n        dataset,\\\\\\\\n        column,\\\\\\\\n        training_request.criteria(),\\\\\\\\n        None,\\\\\\\\n        train,\\\\\\\\n        fragment_ids.clone(),\\\\\\\\n    )\\\\\\\\n    .await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    plugin\\\\\\\\n        .train_index(training_data, &amp;amp;amp;amp;index_store, training_request, fragment_ids)\\\\\\\\n        .await\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Fetches the scalar index plugin for a given index metadata\\\\\\\\n///\\\\\\\\n/// The fast path, on newer datasets, is just a plugin lookup by the type URL of the index details.\\\\\\\\n///\\\\\\\\n/// If the index details are missing (older dataset) then we need to look at the files present in the\\\\\\\\n/// index directory to guess the index type.\\\\\\\\npub async fn fetch_index_details(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = match index.index_details.as_ref() {\\\\\\\\n        Some(details) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; details.clone(),\\\\\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;amp;gt; infer_scalar_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?,\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub async fn open_scalar_index(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n    metrics: &amp;amp;amp;amp;dyn MetricsCollector,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;dyn ScalarIndex&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let uuid_str = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\\\\\n    let index_store = Arc::new(LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index)?);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = fetch_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?;\\\\\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(index_details.as_ref())?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let frag_reuse_index = dataset.open_frag_reuse_index(metrics).await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_cache = dataset\\\\\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\\\\\n        .for_index(&amp;amp;amp;amp;uuid_str, frag_reuse_index.as_ref().map(|f| &amp;amp;amp;amp;f.uuid));\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    plugin\\\\\\\\n        .load_index(index_store, &amp;amp;amp;amp;index_details, frag_reuse_index, &amp;amp;amp;amp;index_cache)\\\\\\\\n        .await\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub(crate) async fn infer_scalar_index_details(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let uuid = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\\\\\n    let type_key = crate::session::index_caches::ScalarIndexDetailsKey { uuid: &amp;amp;amp;amp;uuid };\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(index_details) = dataset.index_cache.get_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;amp;type_key).await {\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(index_details.0.clone());\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_dir = dataset.indice_files_dir(index)?.child(uuid.clone());\\\\\\\\n    let col = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::Internal {\\\\\\\\n        message: format!(\\\\\\\\n            \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Index refers to column {} which does not exist in dataset schema\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n            column\\\\\\\\n        ),\\\\\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n    })?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let bitmap_page_lookup = index_dir.child(BITMAP_LOOKUP_NAME);\\\\\\\\n    let inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(METADATA_FILE);\\\\\\\\n    let legacy_inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(INVERT_LIST_FILE);\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = if let DataType::List(_) = col.data_type() {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;LabelListIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;amp;bitmap_page_lookup).await? {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;BitmapIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;amp;inverted_list_lookup).await? {\\\\\\\\n        // Try to infer inverted index details from metadata file to capture with_position and other params\\\\\\\\n        // Fall back to defaults if anything goes wrong\\\\\\\\n        let default_details = prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap();\\\\\\\\n        let parse_params = async || {\\\\\\\\n            let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index).ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            let reader = index_store.open_index_file(METADATA_FILE).await.ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            let params_str = reader.schema().metadata.get(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"params\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n            let params = ::serde_json::from_str::&amp;amp;amp;lt;InvertedIndexParams&amp;amp;amp;gt;(params_str).ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\\\\\n        .object_store\\\\\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\\\\\n        .await?\\\\\\\\n    {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;BTreeIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    dataset\\\\\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\\\\\n        .insert_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;amp;type_key, prost_any)\\\\\\\\n        .await;\\\\\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub fn index_matches_criteria(\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexCriteria,\\\\\\\\n    field: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Field,\\\\\\\\n    has_multiple_indices: bool,\\\\\\\\n    schema: &amp;amp;amp;amp;lance_core::datatypes::Schema,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(for_column) = criteria.for_column {\\\\\\\\n        if index.fields.len() != 1 {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        // Build the full field path for nested fields\\\\\\\\n        let field_path = if let Some(ancestors) = schema.field_ancestry_by_id(field.id) {\\\\\\\\n            let field_refs: Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;str&amp;amp;amp;gt; = ancestors.iter().map(|f| f.name.as_str()).collect();\\\\\\\\n            lance_core::datatypes::format_field_path(&amp;amp;amp;amp;field_refs)\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            field.name.clone()\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n        if for_column != field_path {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = index.index_details.clone().map(IndexDetails);\\\\\\\\n    let Some(index_details) = index_details else {\\\\\\\\n        if has_multiple_indices {\\\\\\\\n            return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\\\\\n                                source: format!(\\\\\\\\n                                    \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"An index {} on the field with id {} co-exists with other indices on the same column but was written with an older Lance version, and this is not supported.  Please retrain this index.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n                                    index.name,\\\\\\\\n                                    index.fields.first().unwrap_or(&amp;amp;amp;amp;0),\\\\\\\\n                                ).into(),\\\\\\\\n                                location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n                            });\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n        // If we don't have details then allow it for backwards compatibility\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(true);\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if index_details.is_vector() {\\\\\\\\n        // This method is only for finding matching scalar indexes today so reject any vector indexes\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_fts &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; !index_details.supports_fts() {\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // We should not use FTS / NGram indices for exact equality queries\\\\\\\\n    // (i.e. merge insert with a join on the indexed column)\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_exact_equality {\\\\\\\\n        let plugin = index_details.get_plugin()?;\\\\\\\\n        if !plugin.provides_exact_answer() {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;()&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if field_names.is_empty() || field_names.len() &amp;amp;amp;gt; 1 {\\\\\\\\n        return Err(Error::Index {\\\\\\\\n            message: format!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Unsupported fields for scalar index: {:?}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", field_names),\\\\\\\\n            location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n        });\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // Scalar indices currently support only single fields, use the first one\\\\\\\\n    let column_name = field_names[0];\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let source_scalar_index = source_dataset\\\\\\\\n &amp;amp;amp;amp;[column_name],\\\\\\\\n                index_type,\\\\\\\\n                Some(source_index.name.clone()),\\\\\\\\n                &amp;amp;amp;amp;inverted_params,\\\\\\\\n                false,\\\\\\\\n            )\\\\\\\\n            .await?;\\\\\\\\n    } else {\\\\\\\\n        target_dataset\\\\\\\\n            .create_index(\\\\\\\\n                &amp;amp;amp;amp;[column_name],\\\\\\\\n                index_type,\\\\\\\\n                Some(source_index.name.clone()),\\\\\\\\n                &amp;amp;amp;amp;params,\\\\\\\\n                false,\\\\\\\\n            )\\\\\\\\n            .await?;\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(())\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod tests {\\\\\\\\n    use scan.order_by(Some(vec![ColumnOrdering::asc_nulls_first(\\\\\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\\\\\n        )]))?;\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_row_id();\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\\\\\n            use_spilling,\\\\\\\\n            ..Default::default()\\\\\\\\n        })\\\\\\\\n        .await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let schema = batches.schema();\\\\\\\\n    let mut rows_processed = 0;\\\\\\\\n    let mut next_update = TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\\\\\n    let training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\\\\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\\n        \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n        training_uuid, column\\\\\\\\n    );\\\\\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\\\\\n        rows_processed += batch.num_rows();\\\\\\\\n        if rows_processed &amp;amp;amp;gt;= next_update {\\\\\\\\n            next_update += TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\\\\\n            info!(\\\\\\\\n                \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\\\\\\\n            );\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        batch\\\\\\\\n    });\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(schema, batches)))\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub(crate) async fn load_training_data(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;amp;TrainingCriteria,\\\\\\\\n    fragments: Option&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;Fragment&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt;,\\\\\\\\n    train: bool,\\\\\\\\n    fragment_ids: Option&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt;,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    // Create training request with fragment_ids if provided\\\\\\\\n    let training_request = Box::new(match fragment_ids.clone() {\\\\\\\\n        Some(fragment_ids) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest::with_fragment_ids(\\\\\\\\n            Arc::new(dataset.clone()),\\\\\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\\\\\n            fragment_ids,\\\\\\\\n        ),\\\\\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest { fragment_ids: None },\\\\\\\\n    });\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if train {\\\\\\\\n        // Use the training request to scan data with fragment filtering\\\\\\\\n        if let Some(ref fragment_ids) = training_request.fragment_ids {\\\\\\\\n            let fragment_ids = fragment_ids\\\\\\\\n                .clone()\\\\\\\\n                .into_iter()\\\\\\\\n                .sorted()\\\\\\\\n                .dedup()\\\\\\\\n                .collect_vec();\\\\\\\\n            let frags = dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\\\\\n                .iter()\\\\\\\\n                .zip(frags)\\\\\\\\n                .map(|(id, frag)| {\\\\\\\\n                    let Some(frag) = frag else {\\\\\\\\n                        return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\\\\\n                            source: format!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"No fragment with id {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", id).into(),\\\\\\\\n                            location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n                        });\\\\\\\\n                    };\\\\\\\\n                    Ok(frag.metadata().clone())\\\\\\\\n                })\\\\\\\\n                .collect();\\\\\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, Some(frags?)).await\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    } else {\\\\\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n// TODO: Allow users to register their own plugins\\\\\\\\nstatic SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY: LazyLock&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;ScalarIndexPluginRegistry&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; =\\\\\\\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"VectorIndexDetails\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index supports FTS\\\\\\\\n    pub fn supports_fts(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\\\\\n        // In the future this may need to change if we want FTS indices to be pluggable\\\\\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"InvertedIndexDetails\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns the plugin for the index\\\\\\\\n    pub fn get_plugin(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;dyn ScalarIndexPlugin&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\\\\\n            Ok(VECTOR_INDEX_VERSION)\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            self.get_plugin().map(|p| p.version())\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Build a Scalar Index (returns details to store in the manifest)\\\\\\\\n#[instrument(level = \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"debug\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", skip_all)]\\\\\\\\npub(super) async fn build_scalar_index(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n Option&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt;,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;CreatedIndex&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n    })?;\\\\\\\\n    let field: arrow_schema::Field = field.into();\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_new(dataset, uuid)?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_name(&amp;amp;amp;amp;params.index_type)?;\\\\\\\\n    let training_request =\\\\\\\\n        plugin.new_training_request(params.params.as_deref().unwrap_or(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"), &amp;amp;amp;amp;field)?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let training_data = load_training_data(\\\\\\\\n        dataset,\\\\\\\\n        column,\\\\\\\\n        training_request.criteria(),\\\\\\\\n        None,\\\\\\\\n        train,\\\\\\\\n        fragment_ids.clone(),\\\\\\\\n    )\\\\\\\\n    .await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    plugin\\\\\\\\n        .train_index(training_data, &amp;amp;amp;amp;index_store, training_request, fragment_ids)\\\\\\\\n        .await\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Fetches the scalar index plugin for a given index metadata\\\\\\\\n///\\\\\\\\n/// The fast path, on newer datasets, is just a plugin lookup by the type URL of the index details.\\\\\\\\n///\\\\\\\\n/// If the index details are missing (older dataset) then we need to look at the files present in the\\\\\\\\n/// index directory to guess the index type.\\\\\\\\npub async fn fetch_index_details(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = match index.index_details.as_ref() {\\\\\\\\n        Some(details) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; details.clone(),\\\\\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;amp;gt; infer_scalar_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?,\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub async fn open_scalar_index(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    index: ScalarIndex&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let uuid_str = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\\\\\n    let index_store = Arc::new(LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index_cache = dataset\\\\\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\\\\\n        .for_index(&amp;amp;amp;amp;uuid_str, frag_reuse_index.as_ref().map(|f| &amp;amp;amp;amp;f.uuid));\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let uuid = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\\\\\n    let type_key = crate::session::index_caches::ScalarIndexDetailsKey { uuid: &amp;amp;amp;amp;uuid };\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(index_details) = dataset.index_cache.get_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;amp;type_key).await let index_details = if let DataType::List(_) = col.data_type() {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;LabelListIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else if prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;BTreeIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\\\\\n    let prost_any = .await;\\\\\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub fn index_matches_criteria(\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexCriteria,\\\\\\\\n    field: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Field,\\\\\\\\n    has_multiple_indices: bool,\\\\\\\\n    schema: &amp;amp;amp;amp;lance_core::datatypes::Schema,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(for_column) = criteria.for_column {\\\\\\\\n        if index.fields.len() != 1 {\\\\\\\\n            return not use FTS / NGram indices for exact equality queries\\\\\\\\n    // (i.e. merge insert with a join on the indexed column)\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_exact_equality {\\\\\\\\n        let false,\\\\\\\\n            )\\\\\\\\n            .await?;\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(())\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod tests {\\\\\\\\n    use Result&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n    let mut scan = supports FTS\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n    pub fn supports_fts(&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n        // In the future this may need to change if we want FTS indices to    let uuid = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n    let type_key = crate::session::index_caches::ScalarIndexDetailsKey { uuid: &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;uuid };\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(index_details) = dataset.index_cache.get_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;type_key).await {\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(index_details.0.clone());\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n    let index_dir = dataset.indice_files_dir(index)?.child(uuid.clone());\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n    let col = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::Internal })?;\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n    let bitmap_page_lookup = index_dir.child(BITMAP_LOOKUP_NAME);\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n    let inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(METADATA_FILE);\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n ::serde_json::from_str::&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;InvertedIndexParams&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;(params_str).ok()?;\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n            let details = Ok(index_details)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\npub fn index_matches_criteria(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(for_column) = criteria.for_column {\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n        if index.fields.len() != 1 {\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n            return f.name.as_str()).collect();\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n            lance_core::datatypes::format_field_path(&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;field_refs)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n Created a document explaining DELETE and UPDATE operations in Lance. Summary:

## DELETE Operation

1. **Identify rows** — Scan with filter predicate
2. **Extend deletion vector** — Add deletions to existing ones (if any)
3. **Write deletion file** — Create `_deletions/{fragment-id}.{id}.arrow_bin`
4. **Update fragment metadata** — Add deletion_file reference
5. **Commit** — Write new manifest version

**Key point**: Data files are not rewritten; only deletion files are created/updated.

## UPDATE Operation

1. **Identify rows** — Scan with filter predicate
2. **Apply updates** — Modify data in memory
3. **Write new fragments** — Create new data files with updated rows
4. **Mark old rows as deleted** — Create deletion files for original fragments
5. **Commit** — Write new manifest version

**Key point**: Uses copy-on-write — original data unchanged, updated rows written to new fragments.

The document includes:
- Step-by-step process flows
- Before/after examples
- File structure changes
- Fragment metadata changes
- Performance considerations
- Visual diagrams

Saved as `DELETE_UPDATE_OPERATIONS.md`. Want more detail on any part?

Added a section explaining where deletion files live. Summary:

## Answer: Where Do Deletion Files Live?

**Deletion files are logically part of the fragment, but stored separately.**

### Physical Storage
- Location: `_deletions/` directory (separate from `data/`)
- Naming: `{fragment_id}-{read_version}-{id}.{suffix}`
  - Example: `0-2-12345.arrow` (Fragment 0, version 2, ID 12345, Array format)
  - Suffix: `.arrow` (Array) or `.bin` (Bitmap)

### Logical Association
- The Fragment struct has a `deletion_file: Option<DeletionFile>` field
- This contains metadata (id, read_version, file_type, num_deleted_rows), not the file path
- The path is constructed dynamically when needed

### Structure
```
Fragment (in manifest):
  ├── files: [DataFile]              ← Data files in data/
  └── deletion_file: DeletionFile     ← Metadata reference
                                         (points to file in _deletions/)
```

**Key points:**
- ✅ Physically separate: stored in `_deletions/`, not inside `.lance` data files
- ✅ Logically part of fragment: fragment metadata references it
- ✅ Referenced in manifest: fragment entry includes deletion_file metadata

The document has been updated with this information and corrected file naming examples.

{\\n                            Ok(FragmentChange::Modified(Box::new(new_fragment.metadata)))\\n                        }\\n                        Ok(None) =&amp;gt; Ok(FragmentChange::Removed(fragment_id as u64)),\\n                        Err(e) =&amp;gt; Err(e),\\n                    }\\n                } else {\\n                    Ok(FragmentChange::Unchanged)\\n                }\\n            }\\n        })\\n        .buffer_unordered(dataset.object_store.io_parallelism());\\n\\n    while let Some(res) = stream.next().await.transpose()? {\\n        match res {\\n            FragmentChange::Unchanged =&amp;gt; {}\\n            FragmentChange::Modified(fragment) =&amp;gt; updated_fragments.push(*fragment),\\n            FragmentChange::Removed(fragment_id) =&amp;gt; removed_fragments.push(fragment_id),\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    Ok((updated_fragments, removed_fragments))\\n}\\n\\n/// Builder for configuring delete operations with retry support\\n///\\n/// This operation is similar to SQL's DELETE statement. It allows you to remove\\n/// rows from a dataset based on a filter predicate with automatic retry support\\n/// for handling concurrent write conflicts.\\n///\\n/// Use the [DeleteBuilder] to construct a delete operation. For example:\\n///\\n/// &amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n/// # use lance::{Dataset, Result};\\n/// # use lance::dataset::DeleteBuilder;\\n/// # use std::sync::Arc;\\n/// # async fn example(dataset: Arc&amp;lt;Dataset&amp;gt;) -&amp;gt; Result&amp;lt;()&amp;gt; {\\n/// let new_dataset = DeleteBuilder::new(dataset, \\\"age &amp;gt; 65\\\")\\n///     .conflict_retries(5)\\n///     .execute()\\n///     .await?;\\n/// # Ok(())\\n/// # }\\n/// &amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n///\\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\\npub struct DeleteBuilder {\\n    dataset: Arc&amp;lt;Dataset&amp;gt;,\\n    predicate: String,\\n    conflict_retries: u32,\\n    retry_timeout: Duration,\\n}\\n\\nimpl DeleteBuilder {\\n    /// Create a new DeleteBuilder\\n    pub fn new(dataset: Arc&amp;lt;Dataset&amp;gt;, predicate: impl Into&amp;lt;String&amp;gt;) -&amp;gt; Self {\\n        Self {\\n            dataset,\\n            predicate: predicate.into(),\\n            conflict_retries: 10,\\n            retry_timeout: Duration::from_secs(30),\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    /// Set the number of retries for conflict resolution\\n    pub fn conflict_retries(mut self, retries: u32) -&amp;gt; Self {\\n        self.conflict_retries = retries;\\n        self\\n    }\\n\\n    /// Set the timeout for retry operations\\n    pub fn retry_timeout(mut self, timeout: Duration) -&amp;gt; Self {\\n        self.retry_timeout = timeout;\\n        self\\n    }\\n\\n    /// Execute the delete operation\\n    pub async fn execute(self) -&amp;gt; Result&amp;lt;Arc&amp;lt;Dataset&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n        let job = DeleteJob {\\n            dataset: self.dataset.clone(),\\n            predicate: self.predicate,\\n        };\\n\\n        let config = RetryConfig {\\n            max_retries: self.conflict_retries,\\n            retry_timeout: self.retry_timeout,\\n        };\\n\\n        execute_with_retry(job, self.dataset, config).await\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n/// Job that executes the delete operation\\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\\nstruct DeleteJob {\\n    dataset: Arc&amp;lt;Dataset&amp;gt;,\\n    predicate: String,\\n}\\n\\n/// Data returned by delete operation\\nstruct DeleteData {\\n    updated_fragments: Vec&amp;lt;Fragment&amp;gt;,\\n    deleted_fragment_ids: Vec&amp;lt;u64&amp;gt;,\\n    affected_rows: Option&amp;lt;RowAddrTreeMap&amp;gt;,\\n}\\n\\nimpl RetryExecutor for DeleteJob {\\n    type Data = DeleteData;\\n    type Result = Arc&amp;lt;Dataset&amp;gt;;\\n\\n    async fn execute_impl(&amp;amp;self) -&amp;gt; Result&amp;lt;Self::Data&amp;gt; {\\n        // Create a single scanner for the entire dataset\\n        let mut scanner = self.dataset.scan();\\n        scanner\\n            .with_row_id()\\n            .project(&amp;amp;[ROW_ID])?\\n            .filter(&amp;amp;self.predicate)?;\\n\\n        // Check if the filter optimized to true (delete everything) or false (delete nothing)\\n        let (updated_fragments, deleted_fragment_ids, affected_rows) = if let Some(filter_expr) =\\n            scanner.get_filter()?\\n        {\\n            if matches!(\\n                filter_expr,\\n                Expr::Literal(ScalarValue::Boolean(Some(false)), _)\\n            ) {\\n                // Predicate evaluated to false - no deletions\\n                (Vec::new(), Vec::new(), Some(RowAddrTreeMap::new()))\\n            } else if matches!(\\n                filter_expr,\\n                Expr::Literal(ScalarValue::Boolean(Some(true)), _)\\n            ) {\\n                // Predicate evaluated to true - delete all fragments\\n                let deleted_fragment_ids = self\\n                    .dataset\\n                    .get_fragments()\\n                    .iter()\\n                    .map(|f| f.id() as u64)\\n                    .collect();\\n\\n                // When deleting everything, we don't have specific row addresses,\\n                // so better not to emit affected rows.\\n                (Vec::new(), deleted_fragment_ids, None)\\n            } else {\\n                // Regular predicate - scan and collect row addresses to delete\\n                let stream = scanner.try_into_stream().await?.into();\\n                let (stream, row_id_rx) =\\n                    make_rowid_capture_stream(stream, self.dataset.manifest.uses_stable_row_ids())?;\\n\\n                // Process the stream to capture row addresses\\n                // We need to consume the stream to trigger the capture\\n                futures::pin_mut!(stream);\\n                while let Some(_batch) = stream.try_next().await? {\\n                    // The row addresses are captured automatically by make_rowid_capture_stream\\n                }\\n\\n                // Extract the row addresses from the receiver\\n                let removed_row_ids = row_id_rx.try_recv().map_err(|err| Error::Internal {\\n                    message: format!(\\\"Failed to receive row ids: {}\\\", err),\\n                    location: location!(),\\n                })?;\\n                let row_id_index = get_row_id_index(&amp;amp;self.dataset).await?;\\n                let removed_row_addrs = removed_row_ids.row_addrs(row_id_index.as_deref());\\n\\n                let (fragments, deleted_ids) =\\n                    apply_deletions(&amp;amp;self.dataset, &amp;amp;removed_row_addrs).await?;\\n                let affected_rows = RowAddrTreeMap::from(removed_row_addrs.as_ref().clone());\\n                (fragments, deleted_ids, Some(affected_rows))\\n            }\\n        } else {\\n            // No filter was applied - this shouldn't happen but treat as delete nothing\\n            (Vec::new(), Vec::new(), Some(RowAddrTreeMap::new()))\\n        };\\n\\n        Ok(DeleteData {\\n            updated_fragments,\\n            deleted_fragment_ids,\\n            affected_rows,\\n        })\\n    }\\n\\n    async fn commit(&amp;amp;self, dataset: Arc&amp;lt;Dataset&amp;gt;, data: Self::Data) -&amp;gt; Result&amp;lt;Self::Result&amp;gt; {\\n        let operation = Operation::Delete {\\n            updated_fragments: data.updated_fragments,\\n            deleted_fragment_ids: data.deleted_fragment_ids,\\n            predicate: self.predicate.clone(),\\n        };\\n        let transaction = Transaction::new(dataset.manifest.version, operation, None);\\n\\n        let mut builder = CommitBuilder::new(dataset);\\n\\n        if let Some(affected_rows) = data.affected_rows {\\n            builder = builder.with_affected_rows(affected_rows);\\n        }\\n\\n        builder.execute(transaction).await.map(Arc::new)\\n    }\\n\\n    fn update_dataset(&amp;amp;mut self, dataset: Arc&amp;lt;Dataset&amp;gt;) {\\n        self.dataset = dataset;\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n/// Legacy delete function - uses DeleteBuilder with no retries for backwards compatibility\\npub async fn delete(ds: &amp;amp;mut Dataset, predicate: &amp;amp;str) -&amp;gt; Result&amp;lt;()&amp;gt; {\\n    // Use DeleteBuilder with 0 retries to maintain backwards compatibility\\n    let dataset = Arc::new(ds.clone());\\n    let new_dataset = DeleteBuilder::new(dataset, predicate).execute().await?;\\n\\n    // Update the dataset in place\\n    *ds = Arc::try_unwrap(new_dataset).unwrap_or_else(|arc| (*arc).clone());\\n    Ok(())\\n}\\n\\n#[cfg(test)]\\nmod tests {\\n It allows you to change\\n/// the values of all or a subset of columns with SQL expressions.\\n///\\n/// Use the [UpdateBuilder] to construct an update job. If None, all rows are updated.\\n    condition: Option&amp;lt;Expr&amp;gt;,\\n    /// The updates to apply to matching rows.\\n    updates: HashMap&amp;lt;String, Expr&amp;gt;,\\n    /// Number of times to retry on commit conflicts.\\n    conflict_retries: u32,\\n    /// Total timeout for retries.\\n    retry_timeout: Duration,\\n}\\n\\nimpl UpdateBuilder {\\n    pub fn new(dataset: Arc&amp;lt;Dataset&amp;gt;) -&amp;gt; Self {\\n        Self {\\n            dataset,\\n            condition: None,\\n            updates: HashMap::new(),\\n            conflict_retries: 10,\\n            retry_timeout: Duration::from_secs(30),\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    pub fn update_where(mut self, filter: &amp;amp;str) -&amp;gt; Result&amp;lt;Self&amp;gt; {\\n        let planner = Planner::new(Arc::new(self.dataset.schema().into()));\\n        let expr = planner\\n            .parse_filter(filter)\\n            .map_err(box_error)\\n            .context(InvalidInputSnafu {\\n                location: location!(),\\n            })?;\\n        self.condition = Some(planner.optimize_expr(expr).map_err(box_error).context(\\n            InvalidInputSnafu {\\n                location: location!(),\\n            },\\n        )?);\\n        Ok(self)\\n    }\\n\\n    pub fn set(mut self, column: impl AsRef&amp;lt;str&amp;gt;, value: &amp;amp;str) -&amp;gt; Result&amp;lt;Self&amp;gt; {\\n        let field = self\\n            .dataset\\n            .schema()\\n            .field(column.as_ref())\\n            .ok_or_else(|| {\\n                Error::invalid_input(\\n                    format!(\\n                        \\\"Column '{}' does not exist in dataset schema: {:?}\\\",\\n                        column.as_ref(),\\n                        self.dataset.schema()\\n                    ),\\n                    location!(),\\n                )\\n            })?;\\n\\n        // TODO: support nested column references. This is mostly blocked on the\\n        // ability to insert them into the RecordBatch properly.\\n        if column.as_ref().contains('.') {\\n            return Err(Error::NotSupported {\\n                source: format!(\\n                    \\\"Nested column references are not yet supported. Referenced: {}\\\",\\n                    column.as_ref(),\\n                )\\n                .into(),\\n                location: location!(),\\n            });\\n        }\\n\\n        let schema: Arc&amp;lt;ArrowSchema&amp;gt; = Arc::new(self.dataset.schema().into());\\n        let planner = Planner::new(schema.clone());\\n        let mut expr = planner\\n            .parse_expr(value)\\n            .map_err(box_error)\\n            .context(InvalidInputSnafu {\\n                location: location!(),\\n            })?;\\n\\n        // Cast expression to the column's data type if necessary.\\n        let dest_type = field.data_type();\\n        let df_schema = DFSchema::try_from(schema.as_ref().clone())?;\\n        let src_type = expr\\n            .get_type(&amp;amp;df_schema)\\n            .map_err(box_error)\\n            .context(InvalidInputSnafu {\\n                location: location!(),\\n            })?;\\n        if dest_type != src_type {\\n            expr = match expr {\\n                // TODO: remove this branch once DataFusion supports casting List to FSL\\n                // This should happen in Arrow 51.0.0\\n                Expr::Literal(value @ ScalarValue::List(_), metadata)\\n                    if matches!(dest_type, DataType::FixedSizeList(_, _)) =&amp;gt;\\n                {\\n                    Expr::Literal(\\n                        safe_coerce_scalar(&amp;amp;value, &amp;amp;dest_type).ok_or_else(|| {\\n                            ArrowError::CastError(format!(\\n                                \\\"Failed to cast {} to {} during planning\\\",\\n                                value.data_type(),\\n                                dest_type\\n                            ))\\n                        })?,\\n                        metadata,\\n                    )\\n                }\\n                _ =&amp;gt; expr\\n                    .cast_to(&amp;amp;dest_type, &amp;amp;df_schema)\\n                    .map_err(box_error)\\n                    .context(InvalidInputSnafu {\\n                        location: location!(),\\n                    })?,\\n            };\\n        }\\n\\n        // Optimize the expression. For example, this might apply the cast on\\n        // literals. (Expr.cast_to() only wraps the expression in a Cast node,\\n        // it doesn't actually apply the cast to the literals.)\\n        let expr = planner\\n            .optimize_expr(expr)\\n            .map_err(box_error)\\n            .context(InvalidInputSnafu {\\n                location: location!(),\\n            })?;\\n\\n        self.updates.insert(column.as_ref().to_string(), expr);\\n        Ok(self)\\n    }\\n\\n    /// Set the number of times to retry on commit conflicts.\\n    ///\\n    /// Default is 10.\\n    pub fn conflict_retries(mut self, retries: u32) -&amp;gt; Self {\\n        self.conflict_retries = retries;\\n        self\\n    }\\n\\n    /// Set the total timeout for all retries.\\n    ///\\n    /// Default is 30 seconds.\\n    pub fn retry_timeout(mut self, timeout: Duration) -&amp;gt; Self {\\n        self.retry_timeout = timeout;\\n        self\\n    }\","

 async fn execute_impl(self) -&amp;gt; Result&amp;lt;UpdateData&amp;gt; {\\n        let mut scanner = self.dataset.scan();\\n        scanner.with_row_id();\\n\\n        if let Some(expr) = so we can delete them from the existing\\n        // fragments and then set the row id segments in the new fragments.\\n        let (stream, row_id_rx) =\\n if schema.as_ref() != &amp;amp;expected_schema {\\n            return Err(Error::Internal {\\n                message: format!(\\\"Expected schema {:?} but got {:?}\\\", expected_schema, schema),\\n let updates = updates_ref.clone();\\n                tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || Self::apply_updates(batch?, updates))\\n            })\\n            .buffered(get_num_compute_intensive_cpus())\\n            .map(|res| match res {\\n                Ok(Ok(batch)) =&amp;gt; Ok(batch),\\n                Ok(Err(err)) =&amp;gt; Err(err),\\n Some(&amp;amp;self.dataset),\\n            self.dataset.object_store.clone(),\\n            &amp;amp;self.dataset.base,\\n            self.dataset.schema().clone(),\\n            Box::pin(stream),\\n Added a section explaining how Lance determines which fragment contains the latest data after updates.

## Summary

Lance doesn't explicitly track that Fragment 0 and Fragment 2 are "related". Instead, it uses:

### 1. **Row IDs as the link**
- When rows are updated, the new fragment preserves the same row IDs via `row_id_meta`
- Example: Fragment 0 has row IDs [5, 6, 7], Fragment 2 has row IDs [5, 6]

### 2. **Row ID Index**
- Maps row IDs → row addresses (fragment_id + offset)
- Built from all fragments, excluding deleted rows

### 3. **Deletion vectors filter old rows**
- Fragment 0 marks rows 5 and 6 as deleted → excluded from index
- Fragment 2 has rows 5 and 6 active → included in index

### 4. **Reading automatically finds the latest**
- Query: "Get row_id = 5"
- Row ID Index: `5 → Fragment 2, offset 0`
- Reads from Fragment 2 (the new fragment)

### Why this works
- No explicit relationship tracking needed
- Row IDs provide the logical connection
- Deletion vectors ensure only active rows are indexed
- Works with multiple updates and concurrent operations

The document now includes this explanation with examples showing the before/after state and how the Row ID Index resolves which fragment contains each row.

Created a document mapping where dataset writes happen in Rust. Summary:

## Main Entry Points

1. **Public API**: `InsertBuilder` (`rust/lance/src/dataset/write/insert.rs`)
   - Main entry point for users
   - `execute()` - writes and commits
   - `execute_uncommitted()` - writes without committing

2. **Write Orchestration**: `write_fragments_internal()` (`rust/lance/src/dataset/write.rs`)
   - Core internal function
   - Handles schema validation and conversion
   - Orchestrates the write process

3. **Low-Level Writing**: `do_write_fragments()` (`rust/lance/src/dataset/write.rs`)
   - Writes data files
   - Creates Fragment structs
   - Manages file boundaries

4. **Fragment Writing**: `FragmentCreateBuilder` (`rust/lance/src/dataset/fragment/write.rs`)
   - Writes individual fragments
   - Generates UUID-based filenames
   - Creates FileWriter instances

5. **File Format Writing**: `FileWriter` (`rust/lance-file/src/writer.rs`)
   - Writes actual `.lance` files
   - Encodes data to pages
   - Writes metadata and footer

## Write Flow

```
InsertBuilder::execute()
    ↓
write_fragments_internal()
    ↓
do_write_fragments()
    ↓
FragmentCreateBuilder::write()
    ↓
FileWriter::write_batch()
    ↓
ObjectWriter (writes to storage)
```

The document includes:
- File locations and line numbers
- Function signatures
- What each layer does
- A complete write flow diagram
- Example code tracing

Saved as `RUST_DATASET_WRITE_LOCATIONS.md`. This should help you navigate the write code path in Rust.

Where dataset writes happen in Rust:

## Main Entry Points

### 1. **Public API: `InsertBuilder`**
**Location**: `rust/lance/src/dataset/write/insert.rs`

Main public API:
- `InsertBuilder::execute()` - writes and commits
- `InsertBuilder::execute_uncommitted()` - writes without committing
- `InsertBuilder::execute_stream()` - stream-based writes

### 2. **Write Orchestration: `write_fragments_internal()`**
**Location**: `rust/lance/src/dataset/write.rs` (~line 568)

Core internal function that:
- Validates schema compatibility
- Converts schemas if needed
- Calls `do_write_fragments()` to write data

### 3. **Low-Level Writing: `do_write_fragments()`**
**Location**: `rust/lance/src/dataset/write.rs` (~line 379)

Writes data files and creates fragments:
- Buffers/chunks the input stream
- Creates writers for each fragment
- Writes RecordBatches to `.lance` files
- Returns Fragment structs with DataFile references

### 4. **Fragment Writer: `FragmentCreateBuilder`**
**Location**: `rust/lance/src/dataset/fragment/write.rs`

Writes individual fragments:
- `FragmentCreateBuilder::write()` - writes a single fragment
- Generates UUID-based filenames
- Creates `FileWriter` instances
- Writes RecordBatches and creates Fragment metadata

### 5. **File Writer: `FileWriter`**
**Location**: `rust/lance-file/src/writer.rs`

Writes actual `.lance` files:
- `FileWriter::try_new()` - creates writer
- `FileWriter::write_batch()` - encodes and writes batches
- `FileWriter::finish()` - writes footer and returns DataFile

## Write Flow

```
User Code
    ↓
InsertBuilder::execute()           (insert.rs)
    ↓
write_fragments_internal()         (write.rs)
    ↓
do_write_fragments()               (write.rs)
    ↓
FragmentCreateBuilder::write()     (fragment/write.rs)
    ↓
FileWriter::write_batch()         (lance-file/writer.rs)
    ↓
ObjectWriter                      (writes to storage)
```

## Other Write Operations

- **UPDATE**: `rust/lance/src/dataset/write/update.rs` - `UpdateBuilder`
- **DELETE**: `rust/lance/src/dataset/write/delete.rs` - `DeleteBuilder`
- **COMMIT**: `rust/lance/src/dataset/write/commit.rs` - `CommitBuilder` (writes manifest)

## Key Files Summary

- **`rust/lance/src/dataset/write/insert.rs`** - Public API
- **`rust/lance/src/dataset/write.rs`** - Write orchestration
- **`rust/lance/src/dataset/fragment/write.rs`** - Fragment writing
- **`rust/lance-file/src/writer.rs`** - File format writing

The write path goes from high-level API → orchestration → fragment writing → file format writing → storage.

index_dir.child(BITMAP_LOOKUP_NAME);\\\\n    let inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(METADATA_FILE);\\\\n    let legacy_inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(INVERT_LIST_FILE);\\\\n    let index_details = if let DataType::List(_) = col.data_type() {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;LabelListIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else if parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\n        .object_store\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\n        .await?\\\\n    {\\\\n };\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\n\\\\n    dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n Result&amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n {\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\n        }\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\n deletion - should return all 5 rows with value=\\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\"\\\\n        let before_deletion = ds\\\\n            .scan()\\\\n            .filter(\\\\\\\"value = 'apple'\\\\\\\")\\\\n before_deletion_ids,\\\\n            &amp;amp;amp;[0, 2, 4, 6, 8],\\\\n            \\\\\\\"Before deletion: should return 5 rows with value='apple'\\\\\\\"\\\\n        );\\\\n\\\\n        // NOW DELETE rows where value=\\\\\\\"banana\\\\\\\" (rows 1, 3, 5, 7, 9)\\\\n        ds.delete(\\\\\\\"value = 'banana'\\\\\\\").await.unwrap();\\\\n\\\\n        // Query after deletion - should still return 5 rows with value=\\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\"\\\\n        let after_deletion = ds\\\\n            .scan()\\\\n            .filter(\\\\\\\"value = 'apple'\\\\\\\")\\\\n            .unwrap()\\\\n assert_eq!(\\\\n            after_deletion_ids.len(),\\\\n            5,\\\\n            \\\\\\\"After deletion: Expected 5 rows, got {}\\\\\\\",\\\\n            after_deletion_ids.len()\\\\n            .flatten()\\\\n            .collect();\\\\n\\\\n        assert_eq!(\\\\n            after_deletion_values,\\\\n            vec![\\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\"],\\\\n            \\\\\\\"All returned rows should have value='apple'\\\\\\\"\\\\n        );\\\\n\\\\n        // Count rows matching 'apple'\\\\\\\")\\\\n            .unwrap()\\\\n            .try_into_stream()\\\\n            .await\\\\n            .unwrap()\\\\n            .try_collect()\\\\n            .await\\\\n count_apple_rows, 5,\\\\n            \\\\\\\"Should have exactly 5 rows with value='apple'\\\\\\\"\\\\n        );\\\\n        assert_eq!(\\\\n            count_banana_rows, 0,\\\\n            \\\\\\\"Should have 0 rows with value='banana' after deletion\\\\\\\"\\\\n        );\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\"\""

-&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\n\\\\n    // Fragment dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n    // Datafusion currently has bugs with spilling on string columns\\\\n    // See https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/10073\\\\n    //\\\\n    // One we upgrade we can remove this\\\\n    let because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n   }\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\n         let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\n        };\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\n        .object_store\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\n        .await?\\\\n    {\\\\n };\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\n\\\\n    dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ million rows processed\\\\nconst TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ: usize = 1000000;\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) struct TrainingRequest {\\\\n    pub fragment_ids: Option&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nimpl TrainingRequest {\\\\n    pub fn with_fragment_ids(\\\\n        _dataset: Arc&amp;amp;lt;Dataset&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n        _column: String,\\\\n        fragment_ids: Vec&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n    ) -&amp;amp;gt; Self {\\\\n        Self {\\\\n            fragment_ids: Some(fragment_ids),\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    async fn create_empty_stream(\\\\n        dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n        column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n        criteria: &amp;amp;amp;TrainingCriteria,\\\\n    ) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        let column_field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n            source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n            location: location!(),\\\\n        })?;\\\\n\\\\n        let mut fields = Vec::with_capacity(3);\\\\n        fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n            VALUE_COLUMN_NAME,\\\\n            column_field.data_type(),\\\\n            true,\\\\n        ));\\\\n        if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n            fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n                ROW_ID,\\\\n                arrow_schema::DataType::UInt64,\\\\n                false,\\\\n            ));\\\\n        }\\\\n        if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n            fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n                ROW_ADDR,\\\\n                arrow_schema::DataType::UInt64,\\\\n                false,\\\\n            ));\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        // Create schema with the column and row_id field (matching scan_chunks behavior)\\\\n        let schema = Arc::new(arrow_schema::Schema::new(fields));\\\\n\\\\n        // Create empty stream\\\\n        let empty_stream = futures::stream::empty();\\\\n        Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(\\\\n            schema,\\\\n            empty_stream,\\\\n        )))\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn scan_training_data(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;TrainingCriteria,\\\\n    fragments: Option&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;Fragment&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\n\\\\n    // Fragment filtering is now handled in load_training_data function\\\\n    // This function just processes the fragments passed to it\\\\n\\\\n    let column_field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n    // Datafusion currently has bugs with spilling on string columns\\\\n    // See https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/10073\\\\n    //\\\\n    // One we upgrade we can remove this\\\\n    let use_spilling = !matches!(\\\\n        column_field.data_type(),\\\\n        DataType::Utf8 | DataType::LargeUtf8\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // Note: we don't need to sort for TrainingOrdering::Addresses because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n        scan.order_by(Some(vec![ColumnOrdering::asc_nulls_first(\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n        )]))?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n        scan.with_row_id();\\\\n    }\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\n            use_spilling,\\\\n            ..Default::default()\\\\n        })\\\\n        .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let schema = batches.schema();\\\\n    let mut rows_processed = 0;\\\\n    let mut next_update = TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n    let training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\\\n    info!(\\\\n        \\\\\\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\\\\\",\\\\n        training_uuid, column\\\\n    );\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\n        rows_processed += batch.num_rows();\\\\n        if rows_processed &amp;amp;gt;= next_update {\\\\n            next_update += TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n            info!(\\\\n                \\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\\\\\",\\\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\\\n            );\\\\n        }\\\\n        batch\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(schema, batches)))\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn load_training_data(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;TrainingCriteria,\\\\n    fragments: Option&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;Fragment&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n    train: bool,\\\\n    fragment_ids: Option&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // Create training request with fragment_ids if provided\\\\n    let training_request = Box::new(match fragment_ids.clone() {\\\\n        Some(fragment_ids) =&amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest::with_fragment_ids(\\\\n            Arc::new(dataset.clone()),\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n            fragment_ids,\\\\n        ),\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest { fragment_ids: None },\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    if train {\\\\n        // Use the training request to scan data with fragment filtering\\\\n        if let Some(ref fragment_ids) = training_request.fragment_ids {\\\\n            let fragment_ids = fragment_ids\\\\n                .clone()\\\\n                .into_iter()\\\\n                .sorted()\\\\n                .dedup()\\\\n                .collect_vec();\\\\n            let frags = dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n                .zip(frags)\\\\n                .map(|(id, frag)| {\\\\n                    let Some(frag) = frag else {\\\\n                        return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n                            source: format!(\\\\\\\"No fragment with id {}\\\\\\\", id).into(),\\\\n                            location: location!(),\\\\n                        });\\\\n                    };\\\\n                    Ok(frag.metadata().clone())\\\\n                })\\\\n                .collect();\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, Some(frags?)).await\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\n        }\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// TODO: Allow users to register their own plugins\\\\nstatic SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY: LazyLock&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;ScalarIndexPluginRegistry&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; =\\\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\\\n\\\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;);\\\\n\\\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"VectorIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index supports FTS\\\\n    pub fn supports_fts(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        // In the future this may need to change if we want FTS indices to be pluggable\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"InvertedIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the plugin for the index\\\\n    pub fn get_plugin(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;dyn ScalarIndexPlugin&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(self.0.as_ref())\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\n            Ok(VECTOR_INDEX_VERSION)\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            self.get_plugin().map(|p| p.version())\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n/// Build a Scalar Index (returns details to store in the manifest)\\\\n#[instrument(level = \\\\\\\"debug\\\\\\\", skip_all)]\\\\npub(super) async fn build_scalar_index(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    uuid: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    params: &amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexParams,\\\\n    train: bool,\\\\n    fragment_ids: Option&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;CreatedIndex&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n    let field: arrow_schema::Field = field.into();\\\\n\\\\n    let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_new(dataset, uuid)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_name(&amp;amp;amp;params.index_type)?;\\\\n    let training_request =\\\\n        plugin.new_training_request(params.params.as_deref().unwrap_or(\\\\\\\"{}\\\\\\\"), &amp;amp;amp;field)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let training_data = load_training_data(\\\\n        dataset,\\\\n        column,\\\\n        training_request.criteria(),\\\\n        None,\\\\n        train,\\\\n        fragment_ids.clone(),\\\\n    )\\\\n    .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    plugin\\\\n        .train_index(training_data, &amp;amp;amp;index_store, training_request, fragment_ids)\\\\n        .await\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n/// Fetches the scalar index plugin for a given index metadata\\\\n///\\\\n/// The fast path, on newer datasets, is just a plugin lookup by the type URL of the index details.\\\\n///\\\\n/// If the index details are missing (older dataset) then we need to look at the files present in the\\\\n/// index directory to guess the index type.\\\\npub async fn fetch_index_details(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let index_details = match index.index_details.as_ref() {\\\\n        Some(details) =&amp;amp;gt; details.clone(),\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;gt; infer_scalar_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?,\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub async fn open_scalar_index(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\n    metrics: &amp;amp;amp;dyn MetricsCollector,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;dyn ScalarIndex&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let uuid_str = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\n    let index_store = Arc::new(LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index)?);\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = fetch_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?;\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(index_details.as_ref())?;\\\\n\\\\n    let frag_reuse_index = dataset.open_frag_reuse_index(metrics).await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let index_cache = dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n        .for_index(&amp;amp;amp;uuid_str, frag_reuse_index.as_ref().map(|f| &amp;amp;amp;f.uuid));\\\\n\\\\n    plugin\\\\n        .load_index(index_store, &amp;amp;amp;index_details, frag_reuse_index, &amp;amp;amp;index_cache)\\\\n        .await\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn infer_scalar_index_details(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let uuid = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\n    let type_key = crate::session::index_caches::ScalarIndexDetailsKey { uuid: &amp;amp;amp;uuid };\\\\n    if let Some(index_details) = dataset.index_cache.get_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;type_key).await {\\\\n        return Ok(index_details.0.clone());\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let index_dir = dataset.indice_files_dir(index)?.child(uuid.clone());\\\\n    let col = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::Internal {\\\\n        message: format!(\\\\n            \\\\\\\"Index refers to column {} which does not exist in dataset schema\\\\\\\",\\\\n            column\\\\n        ),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n    let bitmap_page_lookup = index_dir.child(BITMAP_LOOKUP_NAME);\\\\n    let inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(METADATA_FILE);\\\\n    let legacy_inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(INVERT_LIST_FILE);\\\\n    let index_details = if let DataType::List(_) = col.data_type() {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;LabelListIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;bitmap_page_lookup).await? {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;BitmapIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;inverted_list_lookup).await? {\\\\n        // Try to infer inverted index details from metadata file to capture with_position and other params\\\\n        // Fall back to defaults if anything goes wrong\\\\n        let default_details = prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap();\\\\n        let parse_params = async || {\\\\n            let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index).ok()?;\\\\n            let reader = index_store.open_index_file(METADATA_FILE).await.ok()?;\\\\n            let params_str = reader.schema().metadata.get(\\\\\\\"params\\\\\\\")?;\\\\n            let params = ::serde_json::from_str::&amp;amp;lt;InvertedIndexParams&amp;amp;gt;(params_str).ok()?;\\\\n            let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\n        };\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\n        .object_store\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\n        .await?\\\\n    {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;BTreeIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\n\\\\n    dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n        .insert_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;type_key, prost_any)\\\\n        .await;\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub fn index_matches_criteria(\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexCriteria,\\\\n    field: &amp;amp;amp;Field,\\\\n    has_multiple_indices: bool,\\\\n    schema: &amp;amp;amp;lance_core::datatypes::Schema,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(for_column) = criteria.for_column {\\\\n        if index.fields.len() != 1 {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n        // Build the full field path for nested fields\\\\n        let field_path = if let Some(ancestors) = schema.field_ancestry_by_id(field.id) {\\\\n            let field_refs: Vec&amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;str&amp;amp;gt; = ancestors.iter().map(|f| f.name.as_str()).collect();\\\\n            lance_core::datatypes::format_field_path(&amp;amp;amp;field_refs)\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            field.name.clone()\\\\n        };\\\\n        if for_column != field_path {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = index.index_details.clone().map(IndexDetails);\\\\n    let Some(index_details) = index_details else {\\\\n        if has_multiple_indices {\\\\n            return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n                                source: format!(\\\\n                                    \\\\\\\"An index {} on the field with id {} co-exists with other indices on the same column but was written with an older Lance version, and this is not supported.  Please retrain this index.\\\\\\\",\\\\n                                    index.name,\\\\n                                    index.fields.first().unwrap_or(&amp;amp;amp;0),\\\\n                                ).into(),\\\\n                                location: location!(),\\\\n                            });\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        // If we don't have details then allow it for backwards compatibility\\\\n        return Ok(true);\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    if index_details.is_vector() {\\\\n        // This method is only for finding matching scalar indexes today so reject any vector indexes\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_fts &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; !index_details.supports_fts() {\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // We should not use FTS / NGram indices for exact equality queries\\\\n    // (i.e. merge insert with a join on the indexed column)\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_exact_equality {\\\\n        let plugin = index_details.get_plugin()?;\\\\n        if !plugin.provides_exact_answer() {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n    Ok(true)\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n/// Initialize a scalar index from a source dataset\\\\npub async fn initialize_scalar_index(\\\\n    target_dataset: &amp;amp;amp;mut Dataset,\\\\n    source_dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    source_index: &amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\n    field_names: &amp;amp;amp;[&amp;amp;amp;str],\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;()&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if field_names.is_empty() || field_names.len() &amp;amp;gt; 1 {\\\\n        return Err(Error::Index {\\\\n            message: format!(\\\\\\\"Unsupported fields for scalar index: {:?}\\\\\\\", field_names),\\\\n            location: location!(),\\\\n        });\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Scalar indices currently support only single fields, use the first one\\\\n    let column_name = field_names[0];\\\\n\\\\n    let source_scalar_index = source_dataset\\\\n        .open_scalar_index(\\\\n            column_name,\\\\n            &amp;amp;amp;source_index.uuid.to_string(),\\\\n            &amp;amp;amp;NoOpMetricsCollector,\\\\n        )\\\\n        .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let params = source_scalar_index.derive_index_params()?;\\\\n    let index_type = source_scalar_index.index_type();\\\\n\\\\n    // For Inverted index, we need to parse the params JSON and create InvertedIndexParams\\\\n    if index_type == IndexType::Inverted {\\\\n        // Extract the JSON string from ScalarIndexParams\\\\n        let params_json = params.params.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| Error::Index {\\\\n            message: \\\\\\\"Inverted index params missing\\\\\\\".to_string(),\\\\n            location: location!(),\\\\n        })?;\\\\n\\\\n        // Parse the JSON into InvertedIndexParams\\\\n        let inverted_params: InvertedIndexParams = serde_json::from_str(params_json)?;\\\\n\\\\n        target_dataset\\\\n            .create_index(\\\\n                &amp;amp;amp;[column_name],\\\\n                index_type,\\\\n                Some(source_index.name.clone()),\\\\n                &amp;amp;amp;inverted_params,\\\\n                false,\\\\n            )\\\\n            .await?;\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        target_dataset\\\\n            .create_index(\\\\n                &amp;amp;amp;[column_name],\\\\n                index_type,\\\\n                Some(source_index.name.clone()),\\\\n                &amp;amp;amp;params,\\\\n                false,\\\\n            )\\\\n            .await?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(())\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\nmod tests {\\\\n    use };\\\\n    use arrow_schema::DataType;\\\\n    use futures::TryStreamExt;\\\\n    use lance_core::utils::tempfile::TempStrDir;\\\\n    use lance_core::{datatypes::Field, Option&amp;amp;lt;IndexType&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n    ) -&amp;amp;gt; crate::index::IndexMetadata {\\\\n        let index_details = index_type\\\\n            .map(|index_type| match index_type {\\\\n IndexType::Inverted =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n                    prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n                }\\\\n                IndexType::NGram =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n                    prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;NGramIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n                }\\\\n                IndexType::Vector =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n                    prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;VectorIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n                }\\\\n                _ =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n                    unimplemented!(\\\\\\\"unsupported index type: {}\\\\\\\", index_type)\\\\n                }\\\\n            })\\\\n            .map(Arc::new);\\\\n        crate::index::IndexMetadata {\\\\n index_details,\\\\n            index_version: 0,\\\\n            created_at: None,\\\\n            base_id: None,\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    #[test]\\\\n    fn {\\\\n            must_support_fts: false,\\\\n            must_support_exact_equality: false,\\\\n            for_column: None,\\\\n            has_name: None,\\\\n        };\\\\n\\\\n        let field = Field::new_arrow(\\\\\\\"mycol\\\\\\\", DataType::Int32, true).unwrap();\\\\n        let schema = lance_core::datatypes::Schema {\\\\n            fields: vec![field.clone()],\\\\n -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\n\\\\n    // Fragment dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n    // Datafusion currently has bugs with spilling on string columns\\\\n    // See https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/10073\\\\n    //\\\\n    // One we upgrade we can remove this\\\\n    let use_spilling = !matches!(\\\\n        column_field.data_type(),\\\\n        DataType::Utf8 | DataType::LargeUtf8\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // Note: we don't need to sort for TrainingOrdering::Addresses because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\n TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n    let training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\\\n    info!(\\\\n        \\\\\\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\\\\\",\\\\n \\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\\\\\",\\\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\\\n            );\\\\n        }\\\\n        batch\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    if train {\\\\n        // Use the training request to scan data with fragment filtering\\\\n        if let Some(ref fragment_ids) = training_request.fragment_ids {\\\\n            let fragment_ids = fragment_ids\\\\n                .clone()\\\\n                .into_iter()\\\\n                .sorted()\\\\n                .dedup()\\\\n                .collect_vec();\\\\n            let frags = dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n {\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\n        }\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\n =\\\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\\\n\\\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;);\\\\n\\\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\\\n    /// }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\n uuid)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_name(&amp;amp;amp;params.index_type)?;\\\\n    let training_request =\\\\n Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(\\\\n            schema,\\\\n            empty_stream,\\\\n        )))\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn scan_training_data(\\\\n    dataset: because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n        scan.order_by(Some(vec![ColumnOrdering::asc_nulls_first(\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n        )]))?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n        scan.with_row_id();\\\\n training_uuid, column\\\\n    );\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\n        rows_processed += batch.num_rows();\\\\n        if rows_processed &amp;amp;gt;= next_update {\\\\n            next_update += TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n            info!(\\\\n Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(schema, batches)))\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn load_training_data(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n Option&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // Create training request with fragment_ids if dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n
