             Ok(frag.metadata().clone())\\\\n                })\\\\n                .collect();\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, Some(frags?)).await\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\n        }\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// TODO: Allow users to register their own plugins\\\\nstatic SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY: LazyLock&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;ScalarIndexPluginRegistry&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; =\\\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\\\n\\\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;);\\\\n\\\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\\\n    /// }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\n Result&amp;amp;lt;CreatedIndex&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", uuid)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_name(&amp;amp;amp;params.index_type)?;\\\\n    let training_request =\\\\n        plugin.new_training_request(params.params.as_deref().unwrap_or(\\\\\\\"{}\\\\\\\"), &amp;amp;amp;field)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let training_data = load_training_data(\\\\n        dataset,\\\\n         let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\n        };\\\\n };\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\n\\\\n    dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n            VALUE_COLUMN_NAME,\\\\n            column_field.data_type(),\\\\n            true,\\\\n        ));\\\\n        if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n            fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n                ROW_ADDR,\\\\n                arrow_schema::DataType::UInt64,\\\\n                false,\\\\n            ));\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        // Create schema with the column and row_id field (matching scan_chunks behavior)\\\\n        let schema = Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(\\\\n            schema,\\\\n            empty_stream,\\\\n        )))\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn scan_training_data(\\\\n    dataset: -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\n\\\\n    // Fragment filtering is now handled in load_training_data function\\\\n    // This function just processes the fragments passed to it\\\\n\\\\n    let column_field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n    // Datafusion currently has bugs with spilling on string columns\\\\n    // See https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/10073\\\\n    //\\\\n    // One we upgrade we can remove this\\\\n    let use_spilling = !matches!(\\\\n        column_field.data_type(),\\\\n        DataType::Utf8 | DataType::LargeUtf8\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // Note: we don't need to sort for TrainingOrdering::Addresses because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n        scan.order_by(Some(vec![ColumnOrdering::asc_nulls_first(\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n        )]))?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n        scan.with_row_id();\\\\n    }\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\n            use_spilling,\\\\n            ..Default::default()\\\\n        })\\\\n        .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let schema = batches.schema();\\\\n    let mut rows_processed = 0;\\\\n    let mut next_update = TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n    let training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\\\n    info!(\\\\n        \\\\\\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\\\\\",\\\\n        training_uuid, column\\\\n    );\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\n        rows_processed += batch.num_rows();\\\\n        if rows_processed &amp;amp;gt;= next_update {\\\\n            next_update += TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n            info!(\\\\n                \\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\\\\\",\\\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\\\n            );\\\\n        }\\\\n        batch\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(schema, batches)))\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn load_training_data(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n Option&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // Create training request with fragment_ids if provided\\\\n    let training_request = Box::new(match fragment_ids.clone() {\\\\n        Some(fragment_ids) =&amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest::with_fragment_ids(\\\\n            Arc::new(dataset.clone()),\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n            fragment_ids,\\\\n        ),\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest { fragment_ids: None },\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n = fragment_ids\\\\n                .clone()\\\\n                .into_iter()\\\\n                .sorted()\\\\n                .dedup()\\\\n                .collect_vec();\\\\n            let frags = dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n                .zip(frags)\\\\n                .map(|(id, frag)| {\\\\n                    let Some(frag) = frag else {\\\\n                        return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n                            source: format!(\\\\\\\"No fragment with id {}\\\\\\\", id).into(),\\\\n                            location: location!(),\\\\n                        });\\\\n                    };\\\\n                    Ok(frag.metadata().clone())\\\\n                })\\\\n                .collect();\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, Some(frags?)).await\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\n        }\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\n Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"VectorIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index supports FTS\\\\n    pub fn supports_fts(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        // In the future this may need to change if we want FTS indices to be pluggable\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"InvertedIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the plugin for the index\\\\n    pub fn get_plugin(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;dyn ScalarIndexPlugin&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(self.0.as_ref())\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\n uuid)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_name(&amp;amp;amp;params.index_type)?;\\\\n    let training_request =\\\\n        plugin.new_training_request(params.params.as_deref().unwrap_or(\\\\\\\"{}\\\\\\\"), &amp;amp;amp;field)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let training_data = load_training_data(\\\\n        dataset,\\\\n        column,\\\\n        training_request.criteria(),\\\\n        None,\\\\n        train,\\\\n        fragment_ids.clone(),\\\\n    )\\\\n    .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    plugin\\\\n &amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let index_details = match index.index_details.as_ref() {\\\\n        Some(details) =&amp;amp;gt; details.clone(),\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;gt; infer_scalar_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?,\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(index_details.as_ref())?;\\\\n\\\\n    let frag_reuse_index = dataset.open_frag_reuse_index(metrics).await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let index_cache = dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n        .for_index(&amp;amp;amp;uuid_str, frag_reuse_index.as_ref().map(|f| &amp;amp;amp;f.uuid));\\\\n\\\\n    plugin\\\\n        .load_index(index_store, &amp;amp;amp;index_details, frag_reuse_index, &amp;amp;amp;index_cache)\\\\n        .await\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn infer_scalar_index_details(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n dataset.indice_files_dir(index)?.child(uuid.clone());\\\\n    let col = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::Internal {\\\\n        message: format!(\\\\n            \\\\\\\"Index refers to index_dir.child(BITMAP_LOOKUP_NAME);\\\\n    let inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(METADATA_FILE);\\\\n    let legacy_inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(INVERT_LIST_FILE);\\\\n    let index_details = if let DataType::List(_) = col.data_type() {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;LabelListIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;bitmap_page_lookup).await? {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;BitmapIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;inverted_list_lookup).await? {\\\\n        // Try to infer inverted index details from metadata file to capture with_position and other params\\\\n        // || {\\\\n            let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index).ok()?;\\\\n            let reader = index_store.open_index_file(METADATA_FILE).await.ok()?;\\\\n         let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\n        };\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\n        .object_store\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\n        .await?\\\\n    {\\\\n };\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\n\\\\n    dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n Result&amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n {\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\n        }\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\n }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\n Arc::new(LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index)?);\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = fetch_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?;\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(index_details.as_ref())?;\\\\n\\\\n    let frag_reuse_index = dataset.open_frag_reuse_index(metrics).await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let index_cache = dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n        .for_index(&amp;amp;amp;uuid_str, frag_reuse_index.as_ref().map(|f| &amp;amp;amp;f.uuid));\\\\n\\\\n    plugin\\\\n        .load_index(index_store, &amp;amp;amp;index_details, frag_reuse_index, &amp;amp;amp;index_cache)\\\\n        .await\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn infer_scalar_index_details(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let uuid = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\n    let type_key = crate::session::index_caches::ScalarIndexDetailsKey { uuid: &amp;amp;amp;uuid };\\\\n    if let Some(index_details) = dataset.index_cache.get_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;type_key).await {\\\\n        return Ok(index_details.0.clone());\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let index_dir = dataset.indice_files_dir(index)?.child(uuid.clone());\\\\n    let col = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::Internal {\\\\n        message: format!(\\\\n            \\\\\\\"Index refers to column {} which does not exist in dataset schema\\\\\\\",\\\\n            column\\\\n        ),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n    let bitmap_page_lookup = index_dir.child(BITMAP_LOOKUP_NAME);\\\\n    let inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(METADATA_FILE);\\\\n    let legacy_inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(INVERT_LIST_FILE);\\\\n    let index_details = if let DataType::List(_) = col.data_type() {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;LabelListIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;bitmap_page_lookup).await? {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;BitmapIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;inverted_list_lookup).await? {\\\\n        // Try to infer inverted index details from metadata file to capture with_position and other params\\\\n        // Fall back to defaults if anything goes wrong\\\\n        let default_details = prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap();\\\\n        let parse_params = async || {\\\\n            let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index).ok()?;\\\\n            let reader = index_store.open_index_file(METADATA_FILE).await.ok()?;\\\\n            let params_str = reader.schema().metadata.get(\\\\\\\"params\\\\\\\")?;\\\\n            let params = ::serde_json::from_str::&amp;amp;lt;InvertedIndexParams&amp;amp;gt;(params_str).ok()?;\\\\n            let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\n        };\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\n        .object_store\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\n        .await?\\\\n    {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;BTreeIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\n\\\\n    dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n        .insert_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;type_key, prost_any)\\\\n        .await;\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub fn index_matches_criteria(\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexCriteria,\\\\n    field: &amp;amp;amp;Field,\\\\n    has_multiple_indices: bool,\\\\n    schema: &amp;amp;amp;lance_core::datatypes::Schema,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(for_column) = criteria.for_column {\\\\n        if index.fields.len() != 1 {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n        // Build the full field path for nested fields\\\\n        let field_path = if let Some(ancestors) = schema.field_ancestry_by_id(field.id) {\\\\n            let field_refs: Vec&amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;str&amp;amp;gt; = ancestors.iter().map(|f| f.name.as_str()).collect();\\\\n            lance_core::datatypes::format_field_path(&amp;amp;amp;field_refs)\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            field.name.clone()\\\\n        };\\\\n        if for_column != field_path {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = index.index_details.clone().map(IndexDetails);\\\\n    let Some(index_details) = index_details else {\\\\n        if has_multiple_indices {\\\\n            return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n                                source: format!(\\\\n                                    \\\\\\\"An index {} on the field with id {} co-exists with other indices on the same column but was written with an older Lance version, and this is not supported.  Please retrain this index.\\\\\\\",\\\\n                                    index.name,\\\\n                                    index.fields.first().unwrap_or(&amp;amp;amp;0),\\\\n                                ).into(),\\\\n                                location: location!(),\\\\n                            });\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        // If we don't have details then allow it for backwards compatibility\\\\n        return Ok(true);\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    if index_details.is_vector() {\\\\n        // This method is only for finding matching scalar indexes today so reject any vector indexes\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_fts &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; !index_details.supports_fts() {\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // We should not use FTS / NGram indices for exact equality queries\\\\n    // (i.e. merge insert with a join on the indexed column)\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_exact_equality {\\\\n        let plugin = index_details.get_plugin()?;\\\\n        if !plugin.provides_exact_answer() {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n    Ok(true)\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n/// source_scalar_index = source_dataset\\\\n        .open_scalar_index(\\\\n            column_name,\\\\n            &amp;amp;amp;source_index.uuid.to_string(),\\\\n            &amp;amp;amp;NoOpMetricsCollector,\\\\n        )\\\\n        .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let params = source_scalar_index.derive_index_params()?;\\\\n    let index_type = Some(source_index.name.clone()),\\\\n                &amp;amp;amp;inverted_params,\\\\n                false,\\\\n            )\\\\n            .await?;\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        target_dataset\\\\n            .create_index(\\\\n                &amp;amp;amp;[column_name],\\\\n                index_type,\\\\n                Some(source_index.name.clone()),\\\\n                &amp;amp;amp;params,\\\\n                false,\\\\n            )\\\\n            .await?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(())\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\nmod tests {\\\\n    use }\\\\n\\\\n    async fn create_empty_stream(\\\\n        dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n        column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n        criteria: &amp;amp;amp;TrainingCriteria,\\\\n    ) fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n            VALUE_COLUMN_NAME,\\\\n            column_field.data_type(),\\\\n            true,\\\\n        ));\\\\n        if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n            fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n                ROW_ID,\\\\n                arrow_schema::DataType::UInt64,\\\\n                false,\\\\n            ));\\\\n        }\\\\n        if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n            fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n                ROW_ADDR,\\\\n                arrow_schema::DataType::UInt64,\\\\n                false,\\\\n            ));\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        // Create schema with the column and row_id field (matching scan_chunks behavior)\\\\n        let schema = Arc::new(arrow_schema::Schema::new(fields));\\\\n\\\\n        // Create empty stream\\\\n        let empty_stream = futures::stream::empty();\\\\n        Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(\\\\n            schema,\\\\n            empty_stream,\\\\n        )))\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn scan_training_data(\\\\n    dataset: -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\n\\\\n    // Fragment filtering is now handled in load_training_data function\\\\n    // This function just processes the fragments passed to it\\\\n\\\\n    let column_field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n    // Datafusion currently has bugs with spilling on string columns\\\\n    // See https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/10073\\\\n    //\\\\n    // One we upgrade we can remove this\\\\n    let use_spilling = !matches!(\\\\n        column_field.data_type(),\\\\n        DataType::Utf8 | DataType::LargeUtf8\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // Note: we don't need to sort for TrainingOrdering::Addresses because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n        scan.order_by(Some(vec![ColumnOrdering::asc_nulls_first(\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n        )]))?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n        scan.with_row_id();\\\\n    }\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\n            use_spilling,\\\\n            ..Default::default()\\\\n        })\\\\n        .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let schema = batches.schema();\\\\n    let mut rows_processed = 0;\\\\n    let mut next_update = TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n    let training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\\\n    info!(\\\\n        \\\\\\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\\\\\",\\\\n        training_uuid, column\\\\n    );\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\n        rows_processed += batch.num_rows();\\\\n        if rows_processed &amp;amp;gt;= next_update {\\\\n            next_update += TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n            info!(\\\\n                \\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\\\\\",\\\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\\\n            );\\\\n        }\\\\n        batch\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n Option&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // Create training request with fragment_ids if provided\\\\n    let training_request = Box::new(match fragment_ids.clone() {\\\\n        Some(fragment_ids) =&amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest::with_fragment_ids(\\\\n            Arc::new(dataset.clone()),\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n            fragment_ids,\\\\n        ),\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest { fragment_ids: None },\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    if train {\\\\n        // Use the training request to scan data with fragment filtering\\\\n        if let Some(ref fragment_ids) = training_request.fragment_ids {\\\\n            let fragment_ids = fragment_ids\\\\n                .clone()\\\\n                .into_iter()\\\\n                .sorted()\\\\n                .dedup()\\\\n                .collect_vec();\\\\n            let frags = dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n                .zip(frags)\\\\n                .map(|(id, frag)| {\\\\n                    let Some(frag) = frag else {\\\\n                        return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n                            source: format!(\\\\\\\"No fragment with id {}\\\\\\\", id).into(),\\\\n                            location: location!(),\\\\n                        });\\\\n                    };\\\\n                    Ok(frag.metadata().clone())\\\\n                })\\\\n                .collect();\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, Some(frags?)).await\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\n        }\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// TODO: Allow users to register their own plugins\\\\nstatic SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY: LazyLock&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;ScalarIndexPluginRegistry&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; =\\\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\\\n\\\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;);\\\\n\\\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"VectorIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index supports FTS\\\\n    pub fn supports_fts(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        // In the future this may need to change if we want FTS indices to be pluggable\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"InvertedIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the plugin for the index\\\\n    pub fn get_plugin(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;dyn ScalarIndexPlugin&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(self.0.as_ref())\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\n            Ok(VECTOR_INDEX_VERSION)\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            self.get_plugin().map(|p| p.version())\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n/// Build a Scalar Index (returns details to store in the manifest)\\\\n#[instrument(level = \\\\\\\"debug\\\\\\\", skip_all)]\\\\npub(super) async fn build_scalar_index(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    uuid: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    params: &amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexParams,\\\\n    train: bool,\\\\n    fragment_ids: Option&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;CreatedIndex&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n    let field: arrow_schema::Field = field.into();\\\\n\\\\n    let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_new(dataset, uuid)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_name(&amp;amp;amp;params.index_type)?;\\\\n    let training_request =\\\\n        plugin.new_training_request(params.params.as_deref().unwrap_or(\\\\\\\"{}\\\\\\\"), &amp;amp;amp;field)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let training_data = load_training_data(\\\\n        dataset,\\\\n        column,\\\\n        training_request.criteria(),\\\\n        None,\\\\n        train,\\\\n        fragment_ids.clone(),\\\\n    )\\\\n    .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    plugin\\\\n &amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let index_details = match index.index_details.as_ref() {\\\\n        Some(details) =&amp;amp;gt; details.clone(),\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;gt; infer_scalar_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?,\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub MetricsCollector,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;dyn ScalarIndex&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let uuid_str = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\n    let index_store = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(index_details.as_ref())?;\\\\n\\\\n    let frag_reuse_index = dataset.open_frag_reuse_index(metrics).await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let index_cache = index_details = if let DataType::List(_) = col.data_type() {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;LabelListIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;bitmap_page_lookup).await? {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;BitmapIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else if || {\\\\n            let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index).ok()?;\\\\n            let reader = index_store.open_index_file(METADATA_FILE).await.ok()?;\\\\n parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\n        .object_store\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\n        .await?\\\\n    {\\\\n Result&amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n ScalarIndexParams};\\\\n        use lance_index::IndexType;\\\\n\\\\n        // Create dataset with 10 rows: alternating string values \\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\" and \\\\\\\"banana\\\\\\\"\\\\n        // Rows 0,2,4,6,8 have value=\\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\", rows 1,3,5,7,9 have value=\\\\\\\"banana\\\\\\\"\\\\n        let mut ds = lance_datagen::gen_batch()\\\\n            .col(\\\\\\\"id\\\\\\\", array::step::&amp;amp;lt;UInt64Type&amp;amp;gt;())\\\\n            .col(\\\\\\\"value\\\\\\\", array::cycle_utf8_literals(&amp;amp;amp;[\\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"banana\\\\\\\"]))\\\\n            .into_ram_dataset(FragmentCount::from(1), FragmentRowCount::from(10))\\\\n            .await\\\\n            .unwrap();\\\\n\\\\n        // Verify initial data: should have 10 rows\\\\n        let initial_data: Vec&amp;amp;lt;arrow_array::RecordBatch&amp;amp;gt; = ds\\\\n            .scan()\\\\n            .try_into_stream()\\\\n            .await\\\\n            .unwrap()\\\\n            .try_collect()\\\\n            .await\\\\n            .unwrap();\\\\n\\\\n        let initial_count: usize = initial_data.iter().map(|b| b.num_rows()).sum();\\\\n        assert_eq!(initial_count, 10, \\\\\\\"Should start with 10 rows\\\\\\\");\\\\n\\\\n        // CREATE INDEX FIRST (before deletion)\\\\n        #[derive(serde::Serialize)]\\\\n        struct BloomParams {\\\\n            number_of_items: u64,\\\\n            probability: f64,\\\\n        }\\\\n        let params = ScalarIndexParams::for_builtin(BuiltinIndexType::BloomFilter).with_params(\\\\n            &amp;amp;amp;BloomParams {\\\\n                number_of_items: 5, // Small zone size to ensure multiple zones\\\\n                probability: 0.01,\\\\n            },\\\\n        );\\\\n        ds.create_index(&amp;amp;amp;[\\\\\\\"value\\\\\\\"], IndexType::Scalar, None, &amp;amp;amp;params, false)\\\\n            .await\\\\n            .unwrap();\\\\n\\\\n        // Query with index before deletion - should return all 5 rows with value=\\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\"\\\\n        let before_deletion = ds\\\\n            .scan()\\\\n            .filter(\\\\\\\"value = 'apple'\\\\\\\")\\\\n            .unwrap()\\\\n            .try_into_batch()\\\\n            .await\\\\n            .unwrap();\\\\n\\\\n        let before_deletion_ids = before_deletion[\\\\\\\"id\\\\\\\"]\\\\n            .as_any()\\\\n            .downcast_ref::&amp;amp;lt;arrow_array::UInt64Array&amp;amp;gt;()\\\\n            .unwrap()\\\\n            .values();\\\\n\\\\n        assert_eq!(\\\\n            before_deletion_ids,\\\\n            &amp;amp;amp;[0, 2, 4, 6, 8],\\\\n            \\\\\\\"Before deletion: should return 5 rows with value='apple'\\\\\\\"\\\\n        );\\\\n\\\\n        // NOW DELETE rows where value=\\\\\\\"banana\\\\\\\" (rows 1, 3, 5, 7, 9)\\\\n        ds.delete(\\\\\\\"value = 'banana'\\\\\\\").await.unwrap();\\\\n\\\\n        // Query after deletion - should still return 5 rows with value=\\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\"\\\\n        let after_deletion = ds\\\\n            .scan()\\\\n            .filter(\\\\\\\"value = 'apple'\\\\\\\")\\\\n            .unwrap()\\\\n            .try_into_batch()\\\\n            .await\\\\n            .unwrap();\\\\n\\\\n        let after_deletion_ids = after_deletion[\\\\\\\"id\\\\\\\"]\\\\n            .as_any()\\\\n            .downcast_ref::&amp;amp;lt;arrow_array::UInt64Array&amp;amp;gt;()\\\\n            .unwrap()\\\\n            .values();\\\\n\\\\n        // Verify we get the correct data after deletion\\\\n        assert_eq!(\\\\n            after_deletion_ids.len(),\\\\n            5,\\\\n            \\\\\\\"After deletion: Expected 5 rows, got {}\\\\\\\",\\\\n            after_deletion_ids.len()\\\\n        );\\\\n        assert_eq!(\\\\n            after_deletion_ids,\\\\n            &amp;amp;amp;[0, 2, 4, 6, 8],\\\\n            \\\\\\\"After deletion: Should return rows [0, 2, 4, 6, 8] with value='apple'\\\\\\\"\\\\n        );\\\\n\\\\n        // Verify the actual values are correct\\\\n        let after_deletion_values: Vec&amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;str&amp;amp;gt; = after_deletion[\\\\\\\"value\\\\\\\"]\\\\n            .as_any()\\\\n            .downcast_ref::&amp;amp;lt;arrow_array::StringArray&amp;amp;gt;()\\\\n            .unwrap()\\\\n            .iter()\\\\n            .flatten()\\\\n            .collect();\\\\n\\\\n        assert_eq!(\\\\n            after_deletion_values,\\\\n            vec![\\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\"],\\\\n            \\\\\\\"All returned rows should have value='apple'\\\\\\\"\\\\n        );\\\\n\\\\n        // Count rows matching \\\\\\\"value = 'apple'\\\\\\\"\\\\n        let count_apple: Vec&amp;amp;lt;arrow_array::RecordBatch&amp;amp;gt; = ds\\\\n            .scan()\\\\n            .filter(\\\\\\\"value = 'apple'\\\\\\\")\\\\n            .unwrap()\\\\n            .try_into_stream()\\\\n            .await\\\\n            .unwrap()\\\\n            .try_collect()\\\\n            .await\\\\n            .unwrap();\\\\n        let count_apple_rows: usize = count_apple.iter().map(|b| b.num_rows()).sum();\\\\n\\\\n        // Count rows matching \\\\\\\"value = 'banana'\\\\\\\" (should be 0 after deletion)\\\\n        let count_banana: Vec&amp;amp;lt;arrow_array::RecordBatch&amp;amp;gt; = ds\\\\n            .scan()\\\\n            .filter(\\\\\\\"value = 'banana'\\\\\\\")\\\\n            .unwrap()\\\\n            .try_into_stream()\\\\n            .await\\\\n            .unwrap()\\\\n            .try_collect()\\\\n            .await\\\\n            .unwrap();\\\\n        let count_banana_rows: usize = count_banana.iter().map(|b| b.num_rows()).sum();\\\\n\\\\n        // The key assertions: filtered queries should return correct data\\\\n        assert_eq!(\\\\n            count_apple_rows, 5,\\\\n            \\\\\\\"Should have exactly 5 rows with value='apple'\\\\\\\"\\\\n        );\\\\n        assert_eq!(\\\\n            count_banana_rows, 0,\\\\n            \\\\\\\"Should have 0 rows with value='banana' after deletion\\\\\\\"\\\\n        );\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\"\""

fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n            VALUE_COLUMN_NAME,\\\\n            column_field.data_type(),\\\\n            true,\\\\n        ));\\\\n        if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n            fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n                ROW_ADDR,\\\\n                arrow_schema::DataType::UInt64,\\\\n                false,\\\\n            ));\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        // Create schema with the column and row_id field (matching scan_chunks behavior)\\\\n        let schema = Arc::new(arrow_schema::Schema::new(fields));\\\\n\\\\n        // Create empty stream\\\\n        let empty_stream = futures::stream::empty();\\\\n -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\n\\\\n    // Fragment filtering is now handled in load_training_data function\\\\n    // This function just processes the fragments passed to it\\\\n\\\\n    let column_field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n    // Datafusion currently has bugs with spilling on string columns\\\\n    // See https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/10073\\\\n    //\\\\n    // One we upgrade we can remove this\\\\n    let use_spilling = !matches!(\\\\n        column_field.data_type(),\\\\n        DataType::Utf8 | DataType::LargeUtf8\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // Note: we don't need to sort for TrainingOrdering::Addresses because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n        scan.order_by(Some(vec![ColumnOrdering::asc_nulls_first(\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n        )]))?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n        scan.with_row_id();\\\\n    }\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\n            use_spilling,\\\\n            ..Default::default()\\\\n        })\\\\n        .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let schema = batches.schema();\\\\n    let mut rows_processed = 0;\\\\n    let mut next_update = TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n    let training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\\\n    info!(\\\\n        \\\\\\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\\\\\",\\\\n        training_uuid, column\\\\n    );\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\n        rows_processed += batch.num_rows();\\\\n        if rows_processed &amp;amp;gt;= next_update {\\\\n            next_update += TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n            info!(\\\\n                \\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\\\\\",\\\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\\\n            );\\\\n        }\\\\n        batch\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n {\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\n        }\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\n }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\n Some(details) =&amp;amp;gt; details.clone(),\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;gt; infer_scalar_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?,\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\n        .object_store\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\n        .await?\\\\n    {\\\\n };\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\n\\\\n    dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n Result&amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n   };\\\\n        if for_column != field_path {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = index.index_details.clone().map(IndexDetails);\\\\n    let Some(index_details) = index_details else {\\\\n        if has_multiple_indices {\\\\n            return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n                                source: format!(\\\\n return 5 rows with value=\\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\"\\\\n        let after_deletion = ds\\\\n            .scan()\\\\n            .filter(\\\\\\\"value = 'apple'\\\\\\\")\\\\n            .unwrap()\\\\n            .try_into_batch()\\\\n            .await\\\\n            .unwrap();\\\\n\\\\n        let after_deletion_ids = after_deletion[\\\\\\\"id\\\\\\\"]\\\\n            .as_any()\\\\n            .downcast_ref::&amp;amp;lt;arrow_array::UInt64Array&amp;amp;gt;()\\\\n            .unwrap()\\\\n            .values();\\\\n\\\\n        // Verify we get the correct data after deletion\\\\n        assert_eq!(\\\\n            after_deletion_ids.len(),\\\\n            5,\\\\n            \\\\\\\"After deletion: Expected 5 rows, got {}\\\\\\\",\\\\n            after_deletion_ids.len()\\\\n        );\\\\n        assert_eq!(\\\\n            after_deletion_ids,\\\\n            &amp;amp;amp;[0, 2, 4, 6, 8],\\\\n            \\\\\\\"After deletion: Should return rows [0, 2, 4, 6, 8] with value='apple'\\\\\\\"\\\\n        );\\\\n\\\\n        // Verify the actual values are correct\\\\n        let after_deletion_values: Vec&amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;str&amp;amp;gt; = after_deletion[\\\\\\\"value\\\\\\\"]\\\\n            .as_any()\\\\n            .downcast_ref::&amp;amp;lt;arrow_array::StringArray&amp;amp;gt;()\\\\n            .unwrap()\\\\n            .iter()\\\\n            .flatten()\\\\n            .collect();\\\\n\\\\n        assert_eq!(\\\\n            after_deletion_values,\\\\n            vec![\\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"apple\\\\\\\"],\\\\n            \\\\\\\"All returned rows should have value='apple'\\\\\\\"\\\\n        );\\\\n\\\\n        // Count rows matching \\\\\\\"value = 'apple'\\\\\\\"\\\\n        let count_apple: Vec&amp;amp;lt;arrow_array::RecordBatch&amp;amp;gt; = ds\\\\n            .scan()\\\\n            .filter(\\\\\\\"value = 'apple'\\\\\\\")\\\\n            .unwrap()\\\\n            .try_into_stream()\\\\n            .await\\\\n            .unwrap()\\\\n            .try_collect()\\\\n            .await\\\\n            .unwrap();\\\\n        let count_apple_rows: usize = count_apple.iter().map(|b| b.num_rows()).sum();\\\\n\\\\n        // Count rows matching \\\\\\\"value = 'banana'\\\\\\\" (should be 0 after deletion)\\\\n        let count_banana: Vec&amp;amp;lt;arrow_array::RecordBatch&amp;amp;gt; = ds\\\\n            .scan()\\\\n            .filter(\\\\\\\"value = 'banana'\\\\\\\")\\\\n            .unwrap()\\\\n            .try_into_stream()\\\\n            .await\\\\n            .unwrap()\\\\n            .try_collect()\\\\n            .await\\\\n            .unwrap();\\\\n        let count_banana_rows: usize = count_banana.iter().map(|b| b.num_rows()).sum();\\\\n\\\\n        // The key assertions: filtered queries should return correct data\\\\n        assert_eq!(\\\\n            count_apple_rows, 5,\\\\n            \\\\\\\"Should have exactly 5 rows with value='apple'\\\\\\\"\\\\n        );\\\\n        assert_eq!(\\\\n            count_banana_rows, 0,\\\\n            \\\\\\\"Should have 0 rows with value='banana' after deletion\\\\\\\"\\\\n        );\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\"\""

if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n            fields.push(arrow_schema::Field::new(\\\\n                ROW_ADDR,\\\\n                arrow_schema::DataType::UInt64,\\\\n                false,\\\\n            ));\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        // Create schema with the column and row_id field (matching scan_chunks behavior)\\\\n        let schema = -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\n\\\\n    // Fragment filtering is now handled in load_training_data function\\\\n    // This function just processes the fragments passed to it\\\\n\\\\n    let column_field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n    // Datafusion currently has bugs with spilling on string columns\\\\n    // See https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/10073\\\\n    //\\\\n    // One we upgrade we can remove this\\\\n    let use_spilling = !matches!(\\\\n        column_field.data_type(),\\\\n        DataType::Utf8 | DataType::LargeUtf8\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // Note: we don't need to sort for TrainingOrdering::Addresses because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n        scan.order_by(Some(vec![ColumnOrdering::asc_nulls_first(\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n        )]))?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n        scan.with_row_id();\\\\n    }\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\n            use_spilling,\\\\n            ..Default::default()\\\\n        })\\\\n        .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let schema = batches.schema();\\\\n    let mut rows_processed = 0;\\\\n    let mut next_update = TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n    let training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\\\n    info!(\\\\n        \\\\\\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\\\\\",\\\\n        training_uuid, column\\\\n    );\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\n        rows_processed += batch.num_rows();\\\\n        if rows_processed &amp;amp;gt;= next_update {\\\\n            next_update += TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n            info!(\\\\n                \\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\\\\\",\\\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\\\n            );\\\\n        }\\\\n        batch\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n Option&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // Create training request with fragment_ids if provided\\\\n    let training_request = Box::new(match fragment_ids.clone() {\\\\n        Some(fragment_ids) =&amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest::with_fragment_ids(\\\\n    if train {\\\\n        // Use the training request to scan data with fragment filtering\\\\n        if let Some(ref fragment_ids) = training_request.fragment_ids {\\\\n            let fragment_ids = fragment_ids\\\\n                .clone()\\\\n                .into_iter()\\\\n                .sorted()\\\\n                .dedup()\\\\n                .collect_vec();\\\\n            let frags = dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n                .zip(frags)\\\\n                .map(|(id, frag)| {\\\\n                    let Some(frag) = frag else {\\\\n                        return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n                            source: format!(\\\\\\\"No fragment with id {}\\\\\\\", id).into(),\\\\n                            location: location!(),\\\\n                        });\\\\n                    };\\\\n                    Ok(frag.metadata().clone())\\\\n                })\\\\n                .collect();\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, Some(frags?)).await\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\n        }\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// TODO: Allow users to register their own plugins\\\\nstatic SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY: LazyLock&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;ScalarIndexPluginRegistry&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; =\\\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\\\n\\\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;);\\\\n\\\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"VectorIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index supports FTS\\\\n    pub fn supports_fts(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        // In the future this may need to change if we want FTS indices to be pluggable\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"InvertedIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the plugin for the index\\\\n    pub fn get_plugin(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;dyn ScalarIndexPlugin&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(self.0.as_ref())\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\n &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    params: &amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexParams,\\\\n    train: bool,\\\\n    fragment_ids: Option&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; uuid)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_name(&amp;amp;amp;params.index_type)?;\\\\n    let training_request =\\\\n        plugin.new_training_request(params.params.as_deref().unwrap_or(\\\\\\\"{}\\\\\\\"), &amp;amp;amp;field)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let training_data = load_training_data(\\\\n        dataset,\\\\n        column,\\\\n        training_request.criteria(),\\\\n        None,\\\\n        train,\\\\n        fragment_ids.clone(),\\\\n    )\\\\n    .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    plugin\\\\n &amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let index_details = match index.index_details.as_ref() {\\\\n        Some(details) =&amp;amp;gt; details.clone(),\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;gt; infer_scalar_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?,\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub async fn open_scalar_index(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\n    metrics: &amp;amp;amp;dyn MetricsCollector,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;lt;dyn ScalarIndex&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let uuid_str = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\n    let index_store = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(index_details.as_ref())?;\\\\n\\\\n    let frag_reuse_index = dataset.open_frag_reuse_index(metrics).await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let index_cache = &amp;amp;amp;index_details, frag_reuse_index, &amp;amp;amp;index_cache)\\\\n        .await\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub(crate) async fn infer_scalar_index_details(\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n index_dir.child(BITMAP_LOOKUP_NAME);\\\\n    let inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(METADATA_FILE);\\\\n    let legacy_inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(INVERT_LIST_FILE);\\\\n    let index_details = if let DataType::List(_) = col.data_type() {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;LabelListIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;bitmap_page_lookup).await? {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;BitmapIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;inverted_list_lookup).await? {\\\\n        // Try to infer inverted index details from metadata file to capture with_position and other params\\\\n        // Fall back to defaults if anything goes wrong\\\\n        let default_details = prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap();\\\\n        let parse_params = async || {\\\\n            let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index).ok()?;\\\\n            let reader = index_store.open_index_file(METADATA_FILE).await.ok()?;\\\\n            let params_str = reader.schema().metadata.get(\\\\\\\"params\\\\\\\")?;\\\\n            let params = ::serde_json::from_str::&amp;amp;lt;InvertedIndexParams&amp;amp;gt;(params_str).ok()?;\\\\n            let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\n        };\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\n        .object_store\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\n        .await?\\\\n    {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;BTreeIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\n\\\\n    dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n        .insert_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;type_key, prost_any)\\\\n        .await;\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub fn index_matches_criteria(\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexCriteria,\\\\n    field: &amp;amp;amp;Field,\\\\n    has_multiple_indices: bool,\\\\n    schema: &amp;amp;amp;lance_core::datatypes::Schema,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(for_column) = criteria.for_column {\\\\n        if index.fields.len() != 1 {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n        // Build the full field path for nested fields\\\\n        let field_path = if let Some(ancestors) = schema.field_ancestry_by_id(field.id) {\\\\n            let field_refs: Vec&amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;str&amp;amp;gt; = ancestors.iter().map(|f| f.name.as_str()).collect();\\\\n            lance_core::datatypes::format_field_path(&amp;amp;amp;field_refs)\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            field.name.clone()\\\\n        };\\\\n        if for_column != field_path {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = index.index_details.clone().map(IndexDetails);\\\\n    let Some(index_details) = index_details else {\\\\n        if has_multiple_indices {\\\\n            return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n                                source: format!(\\\\n                                    \\\\\\\"An index {} on the field with id {} co-exists with other indices on the same column but was written with an older Lance version, and this is not supported.  Please retrain this index.\\\\\\\",\\\\n                                    index.name,\\\\n                                    index.fields.first().unwrap_or(&amp;amp;amp;0),\\\\n                                ).into(),\\\\n                                location: location!(),\\\\n                            });\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        // If we don't have details then allow it for backwards compatibility\\\\n        return Ok(true);\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    if index_details.is_vector() {\\\\n        // This method is only for finding matching scalar indexes today so reject any vector indexes\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_fts &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; !index_details.supports_fts() {\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // We should not use FTS / NGram indices for exact equality queries\\\\n    // (i.e. merge insert with a join on the indexed column)\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_exact_equality {\\\\n        let plugin = index_details.get_plugin()?;\\\\n        if !plugin.provides_exact_answer() {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n    Ok(true)\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n/// Initialize a scalar index from a source dataset\\\\npub async fn initialize_scalar_index(\\\\n    target_dataset: &amp;amp;amp;mut Dataset,\\\\n    source_dataset: &amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\n    source_index: &amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\n    field_names: &amp;amp;amp;[&amp;amp;amp;str],\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;()&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if field_names.is_empty() || field_names.len() &amp;amp;gt; 1 {\\\\n        return Err(Error::Index {\\\\n            message: format!(\\\\\\\"Unsupported fields for scalar index: {:?}\\\\\\\", field_names),\\\\n            location: location!(),\\\\n        });\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Scalar indices currently support only single fields, use the first one\\\\n    let column_name = field_names[0];\\\\n\\\\n    let source_scalar_index = source_dataset\\\\n        .open_scalar_index(\\\\n            column_name,\\\\n            &amp;amp;amp;source_index.uuid.to_string(),\\\\n            &amp;amp;amp;NoOpMetricsCollector,\\\\n        )\\\\n        .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let params = source_scalar_index.derive_index_params()?;\\\\n    let index_type = source_scalar_index.index_type();\\\\n\\\\n    // For Inverted index, we need to parse the params JSON and create InvertedIndexParams\\\\n    if index_type == IndexType::Inverted {\\\\n        // Extract the JSON string from ScalarIndexParams\\\\n        let params_json = params.params.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| Error::Index {\\\\n            message: \\\\\\\"Inverted index params missing\\\\\\\".to_string(),\\\\n            location: location!(),\\\\n        })?;\\\\n\\\\n        // Parse the JSON into InvertedIndexParams\\\\n        let inverted_params: InvertedIndexParams = count_banana_rows: usize = count_banana.iter().map(|b| b.num_rows()).sum();\\\\n\\\\n        // The key assertions: filtered queries should return correct data\\\\n        assert_eq!(\\\\n            count_apple_rows, 5,\\\\n            \\\\\\\"Should have exactly 5 rows with value='apple'\\\\\\\"\\\\n        );\\\\n        assert_eq!(\\\\n            count_banana_rows, 0,\\\\n            \\\\\\\"Should have 0 rows with value='banana' after deletion\\\\\\\"\\\\n        );\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\"\""

        ));\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        // Create schema with the column and row_id field (matching scan_chunks behavior)\\\\n        let schema = -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\n\\\\n    // Fragment filtering is now handled in load_training_data function\\\\n    // This function just processes the fragments passed to it\\\\n\\\\n    let column_field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\n    })?;\\\\n\\\\n    // Datafusion currently has bugs with spilling on string columns\\\\n    // See https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/10073\\\\n    //\\\\n    // One we upgrade we can remove this\\\\n    let use_spilling = !matches!(\\\\n        column_field.data_type(),\\\\n        DataType::Utf8 | DataType::LargeUtf8\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // Note: we don't need to sort for TrainingOrdering::Addresses because\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\n        scan.order_by(Some(vec![ColumnOrdering::asc_nulls_first(\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n        )]))?;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\n        scan.with_row_id();\\\\n    }\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\n\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\n            use_spilling,\\\\n            ..Default::default()\\\\n        })\\\\n        .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let schema = batches.schema();\\\\n    let mut rows_processed = 0;\\\\n    let mut next_update = TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n    let training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\\\n    info!(\\\\n        \\\\\\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\\\\\",\\\\n        training_uuid, column\\\\n    );\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\n        rows_processed += batch.num_rows();\\\\n        if rows_processed &amp;amp;gt;= next_update {\\\\n            next_update += TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\n            info!(\\\\n                \\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\\\\\",\\\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\\\n            );\\\\n        }\\\\n        batch\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n Option&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt;,\\\\n) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // Create training request with fragment_ids if provided\\\\n    let training_request = Box::new(match fragment_ids.clone() {\\\\n        Some(fragment_ids) =&amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest::with_fragment_ids(\\\\n            Arc::new(dataset.clone()),\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\n            fragment_ids,\\\\n        ),\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest { fragment_ids: None },\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    if train {\\\\n        // Use the training request to scan data with fragment filtering\\\\n        if let Some(ref fragment_ids) = training_request.fragment_ids {\\\\n            let fragment_ids = fragment_ids\\\\n                .clone()\\\\n                .into_iter()\\\\n                .sorted()\\\\n                .dedup()\\\\n                .collect_vec();\\\\n            let frags = dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n                .zip(frags)\\\\n                .map(|(id, frag)| {\\\\n                    let Some(frag) = frag else {\\\\n                        return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\n                            source: format!(\\\\\\\"No fragment with id {}\\\\\\\", id).into(),\\\\n                            location: location!(),\\\\n                        });\\\\n                    };\\\\n                    Ok(frag.metadata().clone())\\\\n                })\\\\n                .collect();\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, Some(frags?)).await\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\n        }\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\n =\\\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\\\n\\\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;);\\\\n\\\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\"VectorIndexDetails\\\\\\\")\\\\n }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\n uuid)?;\\\\n\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_name(&amp;amp;amp;params.index_type)?;\\\\n    let training_request =\\\\n column,\\\\n        training_request.criteria(),\\\\n        None,\\\\n        train,\\\\n        fragment_ids.clone(),\\\\n    )\\\\n    .await?;\\\\n\\\\n    plugin\\\\n Some(details) =&amp;amp;gt; details.clone(),\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;gt; infer_scalar_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?,\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\npub         let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\n        };\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\n        .object_store\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\n        .await?\\\\n    {\\\\n };\\\\n\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\n\\\\n    dataset\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\n Result&amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\n        }\\\\n -&amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\n\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\n\\\\n    // Fragment \\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\\\\\",\\\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\\\n            );\\\\n        }\\\\n        batch\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n {\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\n        }\\\\n    } else {\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\n =\\\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\\\n\\\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;gt;);\\\\n\\\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\\\n    ///            .iter()\\\\\\\\n                .zip(frags)\\\\\\\\n                .map(|(id, frag)| {\\\\\\\\n                    let Some(frag) = frag else {\\\\\\\\n                        return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\\\\\n                            source: format!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"No fragment with id {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", id).into(),\\\\\\\\n                            location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n                        });\\\\\\\\n                    };\\\\\\\\n                    Ok(frag.metadata().clone())\\\\\\\\n                })\\\\\\\\n                .collect();\\\\\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, Some(frags?)).await\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    } else {\\\\\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n// TODO: Allow users to register their own plugins\\\\\\\\nstatic SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY: LazyLock&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;ScalarIndexPluginRegistry&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; =\\\\\\\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"VectorIndexDetails\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index supports FTS\\\\\\\\n    pub fn supports_fts(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\\\\\n        // In the future this may need to change if we want FTS indices to be pluggable\\\\\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"InvertedIndexDetails\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns the plugin for the index\\\\\\\\n    pub fn get_plugin(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;dyn ScalarIndexPlugin&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n        SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(self.0.as_ref())\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\\\\\n            Ok(VECTOR_INDEX_VERSION)\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            self.get_plugin().map(|p| p.version())\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Build a Scalar Index (returns details to store in the manifest)\\\\\\\\n#[instrument(level = \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"debug\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", skip_all)]\\\\\\\\npub(super) async fn build_scalar_index(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    uuid: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    params: &amp;amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexParams,\\\\\\\\n    train: bool,\\\\\\\\n    fragment_ids: Option&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt;,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;CreatedIndex&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n    })?;\\\\\\\\n    let field: arrow_schema::Field = field.into();\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_new(dataset, uuid)?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_name(&amp;amp;amp;amp;params.index_type)?;\\\\\\\\n    let training_request =\\\\\\\\n        plugin.new_training_request(params.params.as_deref().unwrap_or(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"), &amp;amp;amp;amp;field)?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let training_data = load_training_data(\\\\\\\\n        dataset,\\\\\\\\n        column,\\\\\\\\n        training_request.criteria(),\\\\\\\\n        None,\\\\\\\\n        train,\\\\\\\\n        fragment_ids.clone(),\\\\\\\\n    )\\\\\\\\n    .await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    plugin\\\\\\\\n        .train_index(training_data, &amp;amp;amp;amp;index_store, training_request, fragment_ids)\\\\\\\\n        .await\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Fetches the scalar index plugin for a given index metadata\\\\\\\\n///\\\\\\\\n/// The fast path, on newer datasets, is just a plugin lookup by the type URL of the index details.\\\\\\\\n///\\\\\\\\n/// If the index details are missing (older dataset) then we need to look at the files present in the\\\\\\\\n/// index directory to guess the index type.\\\\\\\\npub async fn fetch_index_details(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = match index.index_details.as_ref() {\\\\\\\\n        Some(details) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; details.clone(),\\\\\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;amp;gt; infer_scalar_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?,\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub async fn open_scalar_index(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n    metrics: &amp;amp;amp;amp;dyn MetricsCollector,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;dyn ScalarIndex&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let uuid_str = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\\\\\n    let index_store = Arc::new(LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index)?);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = fetch_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?;\\\\\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(index_details.as_ref())?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let frag_reuse_index = dataset.open_frag_reuse_index(metrics).await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_cache = dataset\\\\\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\\\\\n        .for_index(&amp;amp;amp;amp;uuid_str, frag_reuse_index.as_ref().map(|f| &amp;amp;amp;amp;f.uuid));\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    plugin\\\\\\\\n        .load_index(index_store, &amp;amp;amp;amp;index_details, frag_reuse_index, &amp;amp;amp;amp;index_cache)\\\\\\\\n        .await\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub(crate) async fn infer_scalar_index_details(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let uuid = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\\\\\n    let type_key = crate::session::index_caches::ScalarIndexDetailsKey { uuid: &amp;amp;amp;amp;uuid };\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(index_details) = dataset.index_cache.get_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;amp;type_key).await {\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(index_details.0.clone());\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_dir = dataset.indice_files_dir(index)?.child(uuid.clone());\\\\\\\\n    let col = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::Internal {\\\\\\\\n        message: format!(\\\\\\\\n            \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Index refers to column {} which does not exist in dataset schema\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n            column\\\\\\\\n        ),\\\\\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n    })?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let bitmap_page_lookup = index_dir.child(BITMAP_LOOKUP_NAME);\\\\\\\\n    let inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(METADATA_FILE);\\\\\\\\n    let legacy_inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(INVERT_LIST_FILE);\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = if let DataType::List(_) = col.data_type() {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;LabelListIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;amp;bitmap_page_lookup).await? {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;BitmapIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;amp;inverted_list_lookup).await? {\\\\\\\\n        // Try to infer inverted index details from metadata file to capture with_position and other params\\\\\\\\n        // Fall back to defaults if anything goes wrong\\\\\\\\n        let default_details = prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap();\\\\\\\\n        let parse_params = async || {\\\\\\\\n            let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index).ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            let reader = index_store.open_index_file(METADATA_FILE).await.ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            let params_str = reader.schema().metadata.get(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"params\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n            let params = ::serde_json::from_str::&amp;amp;amp;lt;InvertedIndexParams&amp;amp;amp;gt;(params_str).ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\\\\\n        .object_store\\\\\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\\\\\n        .await?\\\\\\\\n    {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;BTreeIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    dataset\\\\\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\\\\\n        .insert_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;amp;type_key, prost_any)\\\\\\\\n        .await;\\\\\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub fn index_matches_criteria(\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexCriteria,\\\\\\\\n    field: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Field,\\\\\\\\n    has_multiple_indices: bool,\\\\\\\\n    schema: &amp;amp;amp;amp;lance_core::datatypes::Schema,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(for_column) = criteria.for_column {\\\\\\\\n        if index.fields.len() != 1 {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        // Build the full field path for nested fields\\\\\\\\n        let field_path = if let Some(ancestors) = schema.field_ancestry_by_id(field.id) {\\\\\\\\n lance_core::datatypes::format_field_path(&amp;amp;amp;amp;field_refs)\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            field.name.clone()\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n        if for_column != field_path {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = index.index_details.clone().map(IndexDetails);\\\\\\\\n    let Some(index_details) = index_details else {\\\\\\\\n        if has_multiple_indices {\\\\\\\\n            return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\\\\\n                                source: format!(\\\\\\\\n
