Please retrain this index.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n                                    index.name,\\\\\\\\n                                    index.fields.first().unwrap_or(&amp;amp;amp;amp;0),\\\\\\\\n                                ).into(),\\\\\\\\n                                location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n                            });\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n        // If we don't have details then allow it for backwards compatibility\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(true);\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if index_details.is_vector() {\\\\\\\\n        // This method is only for finding matching scalar indexes today so reject any vector indexes\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_fts &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; !index_details.supports_fts() {\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // We should not use FTS / NGram indices for exact equality queries\\\\\\\\n    // (i.e. merge insert with a join on the indexed column)\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_exact_equality {\\\\\\\\n        let plugin = index_details.get_plugin()?;\\\\\\\\n        if !plugin.provides_exact_answer() {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;()&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if field_names.is_empty() || field_names.len() &amp;amp;amp;gt; 1 {\\\\\\\\n        return Err(Error::Index {\\\\\\\\n            message: Scalar indices currently support only single fields, use the first one\\\\\\\\n    let column_name = field_names[0];\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let source_scalar_index = source_dataset\\\\\\\\n false,\\\\\\\\n            )\\\\\\\\n            .await?;\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(())\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod tests {\\\\\\\\n    use -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let mut scan = Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\\\\\n scan.with_row_id();\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\\\\\n            use_spilling,\\\\\\\\n            ..Default::default()\\\\\\\\n        })\\\\\\\\n        .await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let schema = batches.schema();\\\\\\\\n    let mut rows_processed = 0;\\\\\\\\n    let mut next_update = TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\\\\\n    let training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\\\\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\\n        \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n        training_uuid, column\\\\\\\\n    );\\\\\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\\\\\n batch\\\\\\\\n    });\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(schema, batches)))\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub(crate) async fn load_training_data(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: Option&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt;,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    // Create =&amp;amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest { fragment_ids: None },\\\\\\\\n    });\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if train {\\\\\\\\n        // Use the training request to scan data with fragment filtering\\\\\\\\n {\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\\\\\n SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(self.0.as_ref())\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\\\\\n            Ok(VECTOR_INDEX_VERSION)\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            self.get_plugin().map(|p| p.version())\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Build a Scalar Index (returns details to store in the manifest)\\\\\\\\n#[instrument(level = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n    })?;\\\\\\\\n    let field: arrow_schema::Field = field.into();\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_new(dataset, uuid)?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n plugin.new_training_request(params.params.as_deref().unwrap_or(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"), &amp;amp;amp;amp;field)?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let training_data = load_training_data(\\\\\\\\n details.\\\\\\\\n///\\\\\\\\n/// If the index details are missing (older dataset) then we need to look at the files present in the\\\\\\\\n/// index directory to guess the index type.\\\\\\\\npub Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = match index.index_details.as_ref() {\\\\\\\\n        Some(details) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; details.clone(),\\\\\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;amp;gt; infer_scalar_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?,\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub async fn open_scalar_index(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    index: index_cache = dataset\\\\\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\\\\\n        .for_index(&amp;amp;amp;amp;uuid_str, frag_reuse_index.as_ref().map(|f| &amp;amp;amp;amp;f.uuid));\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    plugin\\\\\\\\n        .load_index(index_store, &amp;amp;amp;amp;index_details, frag_reuse_index, &amp;amp;amp;amp;index_cache)\\\\\\\\n        .await\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub(crate) async fn infer_scalar_index_details(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let uuid = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\\\\\n    let type_key = crate::session::index_caches::ScalarIndexDetailsKey { uuid: &amp;amp;amp;amp;uuid };\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(index_details) = dataset.index_cache.get_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;amp;type_key).await {\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(index_details.0.clone());\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_dir = dataset.indice_files_dir(index)?.child(uuid.clone());\\\\\\\\n    let col = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::Internal {\\\\\\\\n        message: format!(\\\\\\\\n            \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Index refers to column {} which does not exist in dataset schema\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n            column\\\\\\\\n        ),\\\\\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n    })?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let bitmap_page_lookup = let index_details = if let DataType::List(_) = col.data_type() {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;LabelListIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;amp;bitmap_page_lookup).await? {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;BitmapIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;amp;inverted_list_lookup).await? {\\\\\\\\n        // Try to infer inverted index details from metadata file to capture with_position and other params\\\\\\\\n index_store.open_index_file(METADATA_FILE).await.ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            let params_str = reader.schema().metadata.get(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"params\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n            let params = ::serde_json::from_str::&amp;amp;amp;lt;InvertedIndexParams&amp;amp;amp;gt;(params_str).ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\\\\\n        .object_store\\\\\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\\\\\n        .await?\\\\\\\\n    {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;BTreeIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    dataset\\\\\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\\\\\n        .insert_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;amp;type_key, prost_any)\\\\\\\\n        .await;\\\\\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub fn index_matches_criteria(\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexCriteria,\\\\\\\\n    field: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Field,\\\\\\\\n    has_multiple_indices: bool,\\\\\\\\n    schema: &amp;amp;amp;amp;lance_core::datatypes::Schema,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(for_column) = criteria.for_column {\\\\\\\\n        if index.fields.len() != 1 {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        // Build the full field path for nested fields\\\\\\\\n        let field_path = if let Some(ancestors) = schema.field_ancestry_by_id(field.id) {\\\\\\\\n index_details.is_vector() {\\\\\\\\n        // This method is only for finding matching scalar indexes today so reject any vector indexes\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_fts &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; !index_details.supports_fts() {\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // We should not use FTS / NGram indices for exact equality queries\\\\\\\\n    // (i.e. merge insert with a join on the indexed column)\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_exact_equality {\\\\\\\\n        let &amp;amp;amp;amp;[column_name],\\\\\\\\n                index_type,\\\\\\\\n                Some(source_index.name.clone()),\\\\\\\\n                &amp;amp;amp;amp;params,\\\\\\\\n                false,\\\\\\\\n            )\\\\\\\\n            .await?;\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(())\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod tests {\\\\\\\\n    use -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let mut scan = column_field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\\\\\n Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\\\\\n        scan.order_by(Some(vec![ColumnOrdering::asc_nulls_first(\\\\\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\\\\\n        )]))?;\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_row_id();\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\\\\\n            use_spilling,\\\\\\\\n            ..Default::default()\\\\\\\\n        })\\\\\\\\n        .await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let schema = batches.schema();\\\\\\\\n    let mut rows_processed = 0;\\\\\\\\n    let mut next_update = TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\\\\\n    let training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\\\\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\\n        \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n        training_uuid, column\\\\\\\\n    );\\\\\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\\\\\n        rows_processed += batch.num_rows();\\\\\\\\n        if rows_processed &amp;amp;amp;gt;= next_update {\\\\\\\\n            next_update += TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\\\\\n            info!(\\\\\\\\n                \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\\\\\\\n            );\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        batch\\\\\\\\n    });\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(schema, batches)))\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub(crate) async fn load_training_data(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;amp;TrainingCriteria,\\\\\\\\n    fragments: Option&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;Fragment&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt;,\\\\\\\\n    train: bool,\\\\\\\\n    fragment_ids: Option&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt;,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    // Create training request with fragment_ids if provided\\\\\\\\n    let training_request = Box::new(match fragment_ids.clone() {\\\\\\\\n        Some(fragment_ids) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest::with_fragment_ids(\\\\\\\\n            Arc::new(dataset.clone()),\\\\\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\\\\\n            fragment_ids,\\\\\\\\n        ),\\\\\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest { fragment_ids: None },\\\\\\\\n    });\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if train {\\\\\\\\n        // Use the training request to scan data with fragment filtering\\\\\\\\n            .sorted()\\\\\\\\n                .dedup()\\\\\\\\n                .collect_vec();\\\\\\\\n            let frags = dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\\\\\n                .iter()\\\\\\\\n                .zip(frags)\\\\\\\\n                .map(|(id, frag)| {\\\\\\\\n                    let Some(frag) = frag else {\\\\\\\\n                        return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\\\\\n                            source: format!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"No fragment with id {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", id).into(),\\\\\\\\n                            location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n                        });\\\\\\\\n                    };\\\\\\\\n                    Ok(frag.metadata().clone())\\\\\\\\n                })\\\\\\\\n                .collect();\\\\\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, Some(frags?)).await\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    } else {\\\\\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n// TODO: Allow users to register their own plugins\\\\\\\\nstatic SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY: LazyLock&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;ScalarIndexPluginRegistry&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; =\\\\\\\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"VectorIndexDetails\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index supports FTS\\\\\\\\n    pub fn supports_fts(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\\\\\n        // In the future this may need to change if we want FTS indices to be pluggable\\\\\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"InvertedIndexDetails\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns the plugin for the index\\\\\\\\n    pub fn get_plugin(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;dyn ScalarIndexPlugin&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n        SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(self.0.as_ref())\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\\\\\n            Ok(VECTOR_INDEX_VERSION)\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            self.get_plugin().map(|p| p.version())\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Build a Scalar Index (returns details to store in the manifest)\\\\\\\\n#[instrument(level = \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"debug\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", skip_all)]\\\\\\\\npub(super) async fn build_scalar_index(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n Option&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt;,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;CreatedIndex&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n    })?;\\\\\\\\n    let field: arrow_schema::Field = field.into();\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_new(dataset, uuid)?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_name(&amp;amp;amp;amp;params.index_type)?;\\\\\\\\n    let training_request =\\\\\\\\n        plugin.new_training_request(params.params.as_deref().unwrap_or(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"), &amp;amp;amp;amp;field)?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let training_data = load_training_data(\\\\\\\\n .await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    plugin\\\\\\\\n        .train_index(training_data, &amp;amp;amp;amp;index_store, training_request, fragment_ids)\\\\\\\\n        .await\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// details.\\\\\\\\n///\\\\\\\\n/// If the index details are missing (older dataset) then we need to look at the files present in the\\\\\\\\n/// index directory to guess the index type.\\\\\\\\npub Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = match index.index_details.as_ref() {\\\\\\\\n        Some(details) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; details.clone(),\\\\\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;amp;gt; infer_scalar_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?,\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub async fn open_scalar_index(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n    metrics: &amp;amp;amp;amp;dyn MetricsCollector,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;dyn ScalarIndex&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let uuid_str = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\\\\\n    let index_store = Arc::new(LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index)?);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = fetch_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?;\\\\\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(index_details.as_ref())?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let frag_reuse_index = dataset.open_frag_reuse_index(metrics).await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_cache = dataset\\\\\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\\\\\n        .for_index(&amp;amp;amp;amp;uuid_str, frag_reuse_index.as_ref().map(|f| &amp;amp;amp;amp;f.uuid));\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    plugin\\\\\\\\n        .load_index(index_store, &amp;amp;amp;amp;index_details, frag_reuse_index, &amp;amp;amp;amp;index_cache)\\\\\\\\n        .await\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub(crate) async fn infer_scalar_index_details(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let uuid = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\\\\\n    let type_key = crate::session::index_caches::ScalarIndexDetailsKey { uuid: &amp;amp;amp;amp;uuid };\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(index_details) = dataset.index_cache.get_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;amp;type_key).await {\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(index_details.0.clone());\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_dir = dataset.indice_files_dir(index)?.child(uuid.clone());\\\\\\\\n    let col = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::Internal {\\\\\\\\n        message: format!(\\\\\\\\n            \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Index refers to column {} which does not exist in dataset schema\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n            column\\\\\\\\n        ),\\\\\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n    })?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let bitmap_page_lookup = index_dir.child(BITMAP_LOOKUP_NAME);\\\\\\\\n    let inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(METADATA_FILE);\\\\\\\\n    let legacy_inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(INVERT_LIST_FILE);\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = if let DataType::List(_) = col.data_type() {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;LabelListIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;amp;bitmap_page_lookup).await? {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;BitmapIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;amp;inverted_list_lookup).await? {\\\\\\\\n        // Try to infer inverted index details from metadata file to capture with_position and other params\\\\\\\\n        // Fall back to defaults if anything goes wrong\\\\\\\\n        let default_details = prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap();\\\\\\\\n        let parse_params = async || {\\\\\\\\n            let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index).ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            let reader = index_store.open_index_file(METADATA_FILE).await.ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            let params_str = reader.schema().metadata.get(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"params\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n            let params = ::serde_json::from_str::&amp;amp;amp;lt;InvertedIndexParams&amp;amp;amp;gt;(params_str).ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\\\\\n        .object_store\\\\\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\\\\\n        .await?\\\\\\\\n    {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;BTreeIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    dataset\\\\\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\\\\\n        .insert_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;amp;type_key, prost_any)\\\\\\\\n        .await;\\\\\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub fn index_matches_criteria(\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexCriteria,\\\\\\\\n    field: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Field,\\\\\\\\n    has_multiple_indices: bool,\\\\\\\\n    schema: &amp;amp;amp;amp;lance_core::datatypes::Schema,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(for_column) = criteria.for_column {\\\\\\\\n        if index.fields.len() != 1 {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        // Build the full field path for nested fields\\\\\\\\n        let field_path = if let Some(ancestors) = schema.field_ancestry_by_id(field.id) {\\\\\\\\n            let field_refs: Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;str&amp;amp;amp;gt; = ancestors.iter().map(|f| f.name.as_str()).collect();\\\\\\\\n            lance_core::datatypes::format_field_path(&amp;amp;amp;amp;field_refs)\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            field.name.clone()\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n        if for_column != field_path {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = index.index_details.clone().map(IndexDetails);\\\\\\\\n    let Some(index_details) = index_details else {\\\\\\\\n        if has_multiple_indices {\\\\\\\\n            return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\\\\\n                                source: format!(\\\\\\\\n                                    \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"An index {} on the field with id {} co-exists with other indices on the same column but was written with an older Lance version, and this is not supported.  Please retrain this index.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n                                    index.name,\\\\\\\\n                                    index.fields.first().unwrap_or(&amp;amp;amp;amp;0),\\\\\\\\n                                ).into(),\\\\\\\\n                                location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n                            });\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n        // If we don't have details then allow it for backwards compatibility\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(true);\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if index_details.is_vector() {\\\\\\\\n        // This method is only for finding matching scalar indexes today so reject any vector indexes\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_fts &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; !index_details.supports_fts() {\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // We should not use FTS / NGram indices for exact equality queries\\\\\\\\n    // (i.e. merge insert with a join on the indexed column)\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_exact_equality {\\\\\\\\n        let plugin = index_details.get_plugin()?;\\\\\\\\n        if !plugin.provides_exact_answer() {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    Ok(true)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Initialize a scalar index from a source dataset\\\\\\\\npub async fn initialize_scalar_index(\\\\\\\\n    target_dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;mut Dataset,\\\\\\\\n Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;()&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if field_names.is_empty() || field_names.len() &amp;amp;amp;gt; 1 {\\\\\\\\n        return Err(Error::Index {\\\\\\\\n            message: format!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Unsupported fields for scalar index: {:?}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", field_names),\\\\\\\\n            location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n        });\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // Scalar indices currently support only single fields, use the first one\\\\\\\\n    let column_name = field_names[0];\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let source_scalar_index = source_dataset\\\\\\\\n &amp;amp;amp;amp;[column_name],\\\\\\\\n                index_type,\\\\\\\\n                Some(source_index.name.clone()),\\\\\\\\n                &amp;amp;amp;amp;inverted_params,\\\\\\\\n                false,\\\\\\\\n            )\\\\\\\\n            .await?;\\\\\\\\n    } else {\\\\\\\\n        target_dataset\\\\\\\\n            .create_index(\\\\\\\\n                &amp;amp;amp;amp;[column_name],\\\\\\\\n                index_type,\\\\\\\\n                Some(source_index.name.clone()),\\\\\\\\n                &amp;amp;amp;amp;params,\\\\\\\\n                false,\\\\\\\\n            )\\\\\\\\n            .await?;\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(())\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod tests {\\\\\\\\n    use arrow_schema::DataType::UInt64,\\\\\\\\n                false,\\\\\\\\n            ));\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\\\\\n }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n        // Create schema with the column and row_id field (matching scan_chunks behavior)\\\\\\\\n        let schema = Arc::new(arrow_schema::Schema::new(fields));\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\\\\\n        scan.order_by(Some(vec![ColumnOrdering::asc_nulls_first(\\\\\\\\n            column.to_string(),\\\\\\\\n        )]))?;\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_ids {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_row_id();\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\\\\\n            use_spilling,\\\\\\\\n            ..Default::default()\\\\\\\\n column\\\\\\\\n    );\\\\\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\\\\\n             \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\\\\\\\n            );\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        batch\\\\\\\\n    });\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(schema, batches)))\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub(crate) async fn load_training_data(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;amp;TrainingCriteria,\\\\\\\\n    fragments: Option&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;Fragment&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt;,\\\\\\\\n    train: bool,\\\\\\\\n    fragment_ids: Option&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt;,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    // Create training request with fragment_ids if provided\\\\\\\\n    let training_request = Box::new(match fragment_ids.clone() {\\\\\\\\n        Some(fragment_ids) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest { fragment_ids: None },\\\\\\\\n    });\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if train {\\\\\\\\n        // Use the training request to scan data with fragment filtering\\\\\\\\n        if let Some(ref fragment_ids) = training_request.fragment_ids {\\\\\\\\n            let fragment_ids = fragment_ids\\\\\\\\n                .clone()\\\\\\\\n                .into_iter()\\\\\\\\n                .sorted()\\\\\\\\n                .dedup()\\\\\\\\n                .collect_vec();\\\\\\\\n            let frags = dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\\\\\n                .iter()\\\\\\\\n                .zip(frags)\\\\\\\\n                .map(|(id, frag)| {\\\\\\\\n                    let Some(frag) = frag else {\\\\\\\\n                        return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\\\\\n                            source: format!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"No fragment with id {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", id).into(),\\\\\\\\n                            location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n                        });\\\\\\\\n                    };\\\\\\\\n                    Ok(frag.metadata().clone())\\\\\\\\n                })\\\\\\\\n                .collect();\\\\\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, Some(frags?)).await\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            scan_training_data(dataset, column, criteria, fragments).await\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    } else {\\\\\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n// TODO: Allow users to register their own plugins\\\\\\\\nstatic SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY: LazyLock&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;ScalarIndexPluginRegistry&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; =\\\\\\\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"VectorIndexDetails\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index supports FTS\\\\\\\\n    pub fn supports_fts(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\\\\\n        // In the future this may need to change if we want FTS indices to be pluggable\\\\\\\\n        self.0.type_url.ends_with(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"InvertedIndexDetails\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns the plugin for the index\\\\\\\\n    pub fn get_plugin(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;dyn ScalarIndexPlugin&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n        SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(self.0.as_ref())\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns the index version\\\\\\\\n    pub fn index_version(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\\\\\n            Ok(VECTOR_INDEX_VERSION)\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            self.get_plugin().map(|p| p.version())\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Build a Scalar Index (returns details to store in the manifest)\\\\\\\\n#[instrument(level = \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"debug\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", skip_all)]\\\\\\\\npub(super) async fn build_scalar_index(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    uuid: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    params: &amp;amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexParams,\\\\\\\\n    train: bool,\\\\\\\\n    fragment_ids: Option&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt;,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;CreatedIndex&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n    })?;\\\\\\\\n    let field: arrow_schema::Field = field.into();\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_new(dataset, uuid)?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_name(&amp;amp;amp;amp;params.index_type)?;\\\\\\\\n    let training_request =\\\\\\\\n        plugin.new_training_request(params.params.as_deref().unwrap_or(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"), &amp;amp;amp;amp;field)?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let training_data = load_training_data(\\\\\\\\n        dataset,\\\\\\\\n        column,\\\\\\\\n        training_request.criteria(),\\\\\\\\n        None,\\\\\\\\n        train,\\\\\\\\n        fragment_ids.clone(),\\\\\\\\n    )\\\\\\\\n    .await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    plugin\\\\\\\\n        .train_index(training_data, &amp;amp;amp;amp;index_store, training_request, fragment_ids)\\\\\\\\n        .await\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Fetches the scalar index plugin for a given index metadata\\\\\\\\n///\\\\\\\\n/// The fast path, on newer datasets, is just a plugin lookup by the type URL of the index details.\\\\\\\\n///\\\\\\\\n/// If the index details are missing (older dataset) then we need to look at the files present in the\\\\\\\\n/// index directory to guess the index type.\\\\\\\\npub async fn fetch_index_details(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = match index.index_details.as_ref() {\\\\\\\\n        Some(details) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; details.clone(),\\\\\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;amp;gt; infer_scalar_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?,\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub async fn open_scalar_index(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n    metrics: &amp;amp;amp;amp;dyn MetricsCollector,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;dyn ScalarIndex&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let uuid_str = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\\\\\n    let index_store = Arc::new(LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index)?);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = fetch_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?;\\\\\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(index_details.as_ref())?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let frag_reuse_index = dataset.open_frag_reuse_index(metrics).await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_cache = dataset\\\\\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\\\\\n        .for_index(&amp;amp;amp;amp;uuid_str, frag_reuse_index.as_ref().map(|f| &amp;amp;amp;amp;f.uuid));\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    plugin\\\\\\\\n        .load_index(index_store, &amp;amp;amp;amp;index_details, frag_reuse_index, &amp;amp;amp;amp;index_cache)\\\\\\\\n        .await\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub(crate) async fn infer_scalar_index_details(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let uuid = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\\\\\n    let type_key = crate::session::index_caches::ScalarIndexDetailsKey { uuid: &amp;amp;amp;amp;uuid };\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(index_details) = dataset.index_cache.get_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;amp;type_key).await {\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(index_details.0.clone());\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_dir = dataset.indice_files_dir(index)?.child(uuid.clone());\\\\\\\\n    let col = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::Internal {\\\\\\\\n        message: format!(\\\\\\\\n            \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Index refers to column {} which does not exist in dataset schema\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n            column\\\\\\\\n        ),\\\\\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n    })?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let bitmap_page_lookup = index_dir.child(BITMAP_LOOKUP_NAME);\\\\\\\\n    let inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(METADATA_FILE);\\\\\\\\n    let legacy_inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(INVERT_LIST_FILE);\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = if let DataType::List(_) = col.data_type() {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;LabelListIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;amp;bitmap_page_lookup).await? {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;BitmapIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;amp;inverted_list_lookup).await? {\\\\\\\\n        // Try to infer inverted index details from metadata file to capture with_position and other params\\\\\\\\n        // Fall back to defaults if anything goes wrong\\\\\\\\n        let default_details = prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap();\\\\\\\\n        let parse_params = async || {\\\\\\\\n            let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index).ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            let reader = index_store.open_index_file(METADATA_FILE).await.ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            let params_str = reader.schema().metadata.get(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"params\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n            let params = ::serde_json::from_str::&amp;amp;amp;lt;InvertedIndexParams&amp;amp;amp;gt;(params_str).ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\\\\\n        .object_store\\\\\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\\\\\n        .await?\\\\\\\\n    {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;BTreeIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    dataset\\\\\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\\\\\n        .insert_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;amp;type_key, prost_any)\\\\\\\\n        .await;\\\\\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub fn index_matches_criteria(\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexCriteria,\\\\\\\\n    field: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Field,\\\\\\\\n    has_multiple_indices: bool,\\\\\\\\n    schema: &amp;amp;amp;amp;lance_core::datatypes::Schema,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(for_column) = criteria.for_column {\\\\\\\\n        if index.fields.len() != 1 {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        // Build the full field path for nested fields\\\\\\\\n        let field_path = if let Some(ancestors) = schema.field_ancestry_by_id(field.id) {\\\\\\\\n lance_core::datatypes::format_field_path(&amp;amp;amp;amp;field_refs)\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            field.name.clone()\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n        if for_column != field_path {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = index.index_details.clone().map(IndexDetails);\\\\\\\\n    let Some(index_details) = index_details else {\\\\\\\\n        if has_multiple_indices {\\\\\\\\n            return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\\\\\n                                source: format!(\\\\\\\\n Please retrain this index.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n                                    index.name,\\\\\\\\n                                    index.fields.first().unwrap_or(&amp;amp;amp;amp;0),\\\\\\\\n                                ).into(),\\\\\\\\n                                location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n                            });\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n        // If we don't have details then allow it for backwards compatibility\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(true);\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if index_details.is_vector() {\\\\\\\\n        // This method is only for finding matching scalar indexes today so reject any vector indexes\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_fts &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; !index_details.supports_fts() {\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // We should not use FTS / NGram indices for exact equality queries\\\\\\\\n    // (i.e. merge insert with a join on the indexed column)\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_exact_equality {\\\\\\\\n        let plugin = index_details.get_plugin()?;\\\\\\\\n        if !plugin.provides_exact_answer() {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;()&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if field_names.is_empty() || field_names.len() &amp;amp;amp;gt; 1 {\\\\\\\\n        return Err(Error::Index {\\\\\\\\n            message: Scalar indices currently support only single fields, use the first one\\\\\\\\n    let column_name = field_names[0];\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let source_scalar_index = source_dataset\\\\\\\\n &amp;amp;amp;amp;[column_name],\\\\\\\\n                index_type,\\\\\\\\n                Some(source_index.name.clone()),\\\\\\\\n                &amp;amp;amp;amp;inverted_params,\\\\\\\\n &amp;amp;amp;amp;[column_name],\\\\\\\\n                index_type,\\\\\\\\n                Some(source_index.name.clone()),\\\\\\\\n                &amp;amp;amp;amp;params,\\\\\\\\n                false,\\\\\\\\n            )\\\\\\\\n            .await?;\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(())\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod tests {\\\\\\\\n    use {\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\\\\\n self.get_plugin().map(|p| p.version())\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Build a Scalar Index (returns details to store in the manifest)\\\\\\\\n#[instrument(level = .await;\\\\\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub fn index_matches_criteria(\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n    criteria: -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\\\\\n {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = index.index_details.clone().map(IndexDetails);\\\\\\\\n    let Some(index_details) = Please retrain this index.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n                                    index.name,\\\\\\\\n                                    index.fields.first().unwrap_or(&amp;amp;amp;amp;0),\\\\\\\\n                                ).into(),\\\\\\\\n                                location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n                            });\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n        // If we don't have details then allow it for backwards compatibility\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(true);\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if index_details.is_vector() {\\\\\\\\n        // This method is only for finding matching scalar indexes today so reject any vector indexes\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n not use FTS / NGram indices for exact equality queries\\\\\\\\n    // (i.e. merge insert with a join on the indexed column)\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_exact_equality {\\\\\\\\n        let plugin = index_details.get_plugin()?;\\\\\\\\n        if !plugin.provides_exact_answer() {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;BTreeIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    dataset\\\\\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\\\\\n        .insert_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;amp;type_key, prost_any)\\\\\\\\n        .await;\\\\\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub fn index_matches_criteria(\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexCriteria,\\\\\\\\n    field: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Field,\\\\\\\\n    has_multiple_indices: bool,\\\\\\\\n    schema: &amp;amp;amp;amp;lance_core::datatypes::Schema,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(for_column) = criteria.for_column {\\\\\\\\n        if index.fields.len() != 1 {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        // Build the full field path for nested fields\\\\\\\\n        let field_path = if let Some(ancestors) = schema.field_ancestry_by_id(field.id) {\\\\\\\\n            let field_refs: Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;str&amp;amp;amp;gt; = ancestors.iter().map(|f| f.name.as_str()).collect();\\\\\\\\n            lance_core::datatypes::format_field_path(&amp;amp;amp;amp;field_refs)\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            field.name.clone()\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n        if for_column != field_path {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = index.index_details.clone().map(IndexDetails);\\\\\\\\n    let Some(index_details) = index_details else {\\\\\\\\n        if has_multiple_indices {\\\\\\\\n            return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\\\\\n                                source: format!(\\\\\\\\n                                    \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"An index {} on the field with id {} co-exists with other indices on the same column but was written with an older Lance version, and this is not supported.  Please retrain this index.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n                                    index.name,\\\\\\\\n                                    index.fields.first().unwrap_or(&amp;amp;amp;amp;0),\\\\\\\\n                                ).into(),\\\\\\\\n                                location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n                            });\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n        // If we don't have details then allow it for backwards compatibility\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(true);\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if index_details.is_vector() {\\\\\\\\n        // This method is only for finding matching scalar indexes today so reject any vector indexes\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_fts &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; !index_details.supports_fts() {\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // We should not use FTS / NGram indices for exact equality queries\\\\\\\\n    // (i.e. merge insert with a join on the indexed column)\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_exact_equality {\\\\\\\\n        let plugin = index_details.get_plugin()?;\\\\\\\\n        if !plugin.provides_exact_answer() {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n &amp;amp;amp;amp;[column_name],\\\\\\\\n                index_type,\\\\\\\\n                Some(source_index.name.clone()),\\\\\\\\n                &amp;amp;amp;amp;params,\\\\\\\\n                false,\\\\\\\\n            )\\\\\\\\n            .await?;\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(())\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod tests {\\\\\\\\n    use -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let mut scan = location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n    })?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // Datafusion currently has bugs with spilling on string columns\\\\\\\\n    // See column_field.data_type(),\\\\\\\\n        DataType::Utf8 | DataType::LargeUtf8\\\\\\\\n    );\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // Note: we don't need to sort for TrainingOrdering::Addresses because\\\\\\\\n    // Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\\\\\n scan.with_row_id();\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\\\\\n            use_spilling,\\\\\\\\n            ..Default::default()\\\\\\\\n        })\\\\\\\\n        .await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let schema = batches.schema();\\\\\\\\n    let mut rows_processed = 0;\\\\\\\\n    let mut next_update = TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\\\\\n    let training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\\\\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\\n        \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n        training_uuid, column\\\\\\\\n    );\\\\\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\\\\\n             \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): {}/{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n                training_uuid, rows_processed, num_rows\\\\\\\\n            );\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        batch\\\\\\\\n    });\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(schema, batches)))\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub(crate) async fn load_training_data(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;amp;TrainingCriteria,\\\\\\\\n    fragments: Option&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;Fragment&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt;,\\\\\\\\n    train: bool,\\\\\\\\n    fragment_ids: Option&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt;,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    // Create {\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\\\\\n -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\\\\\n            Ok(VECTOR_INDEX_VERSION)\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n plugin.new_training_request(params.params.as_deref().unwrap_or(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"), &amp;amp;amp;amp;field)?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let training_data = load_training_data(\\\\\\\\n .await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    plugin\\\\\\\\n        .train_index(training_data, &amp;amp;amp;amp;index_store, training_request, fragment_ids)\\\\\\\\n        .await\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Fetches the scalar index plugin for a given index metadata\\\\\\\\n///\\\\\\\\n/// The fast path, on newer datasets, is just a plugin lookup by the type URL of the index details.\\\\\\\\n///\\\\\\\\n/// If the index details are missing (older dataset) then we need to look at the files present in the\\\\\\\\n/// index directory to guess the index type.\\\\\\\\npub async fn fetch_index_details(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = match index.index_details.as_ref() {\\\\\\\\n        Some(details) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; details.clone(),\\\\\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;amp;gt; infer_scalar_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?,\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub async fn open_scalar_index(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    index: index)?);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = fetch_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?;\\\\\\\\n    let plugin = SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY.get_plugin_by_details(index_details.as_ref())?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let frag_reuse_index = dataset.open_frag_reuse_index(metrics).await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_cache = dataset\\\\\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\\\\\n        .for_index(&amp;amp;amp;amp;uuid_str, frag_reuse_index.as_ref().map(|f| &amp;amp;amp;amp;f.uuid));\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    plugin\\\\\\\\n        .load_index(index_store, &amp;amp;amp;amp;index_details, frag_reuse_index, &amp;amp;amp;amp;index_cache)\\\\\\\\n        .await\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub(crate) async fn infer_scalar_index_details(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let uuid = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\\\\\n    let type_key = crate::session::index_caches::ScalarIndexDetailsKey { uuid: &amp;amp;amp;amp;uuid };\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(index_details) = dataset.index_cache.get_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;amp;type_key).await {\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(index_details.0.clone());\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_dir = dataset.indice_files_dir(index)?.child(uuid.clone());\\\\\\\\n    let col = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::Internal {\\\\\\\\n        message: format!(\\\\\\\\n            \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Index refers to column {} which does not exist in dataset schema\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n            column\\\\\\\\n        ),\\\\\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n    })?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let bitmap_page_lookup = index_dir.child(BITMAP_LOOKUP_NAME);\\\\\\\\n    let inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(METADATA_FILE);\\\\\\\\n    let legacy_inverted_list_lookup = index_dir.child(INVERT_LIST_FILE);\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = if let DataType::List(_) = col.data_type() {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;LabelListIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;amp;bitmap_page_lookup).await? {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;BitmapIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;amp;inverted_list_lookup).await? {\\\\\\\\n        // Try to infer inverted index details from metadata file to capture with_position and other params\\\\\\\\n        // Fall back to defaults if anything goes wrong\\\\\\\\n        let default_details = prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap();\\\\\\\\n        let parse_params = async || {\\\\\\\\n            let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_existing(dataset, index).ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            let reader = index_store.open_index_file(METADATA_FILE).await.ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            let params_str = reader.schema().metadata.get(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"params\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n            let params = ::serde_json::from_str::&amp;amp;amp;lt;InvertedIndexParams&amp;amp;amp;gt;(params_str).ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\\\\\n        .object_store\\\\\\\\n        .exists(&amp;amp;amp;amp;legacy_inverted_list_lookup)\\\\\\\\n        .await?\\\\\\\\n    {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;BTreeIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    dataset\\\\\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\\\\\n        .insert_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;amp;type_key, prost_any)\\\\\\\\n        .await;\\\\\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub fn index_matches_criteria(\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexCriteria,\\\\\\\\n    field: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Field,\\\\\\\\n    has_multiple_indices: bool,\\\\\\\\n    schema: &amp;amp;amp;amp;lance_core::datatypes::Schema,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(for_column) = criteria.for_column {\\\\\\\\n        if index.fields.len() != 1 {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        // Build the full field path for nested fields\\\\\\\\n        let field_path = if let Some(ancestors) = schema.field_ancestry_by_id(field.id) {\\\\\\\\n lance_core::datatypes::format_field_path(&amp;amp;amp;amp;field_refs)\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            field.name.clone()\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n        if for_column != field_path {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = index.index_details.clone().map(IndexDetails);\\\\\\\\n    let Some(index_details) = index_details else {\\\\\\\\n        if has_multiple_indices {\\\\\\\\n            return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\\\\\n                                source: format!(\\\\\\\\n Please retrain this index.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n                                    index.name,\\\\\\\\n                                    index.fields.first().unwrap_or(&amp;amp;amp;amp;0),\\\\\\\\n                                ).into(),\\\\\\\\n                                location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n                            });\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n        // If we don't have details then allow it for backwards compatibility\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(true);\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if index_details.is_vector() {\\\\\\\\n        // This method is only for finding matching scalar indexes today so reject any vector indexes\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_fts &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; !index_details.supports_fts() {\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // We should not use FTS / NGram indices for exact equality queries\\\\\\\\n    // (i.e. merge insert with a join on the indexed column)\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.must_support_exact_equality {\\\\\\\\n        let }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n        // Create schema with the column and row_id field (matching scan_chunks behavior)\\\\\\\\n        let schema = Arc::new(arrow_schema::Schema::new(fields));\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n        // Create empty stream\\\\\\\\n        let empty_stream = futures::stream::empty();\\\\\\\\n        Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(\\\\\\\\n            schema,\\\\\\\\n            empty_stream,\\\\\\\\n        )))\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub(crate) async fn scan_training_data(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;amp;TrainingCriteria,\\\\\\\\n    fragments: Option&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;Fragment&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt;,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let mut scan = dataset.scan();\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // Fragment filtering is now handled in load_training_data function\\\\\\\\n    // This function just processes the fragments passed to it\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let column_field = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n    })?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // Datafusion currently has bugs with spilling on string columns\\\\\\\\n    // See https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/10073\\\\\\\\n    //\\\\\\\\n    // One we upgrade we can remove this\\\\\\\\n    let use_spilling = !matches!(\\\\\\\\n Lance will return data in the order of the row_address by default.\\\\\\\\n    if TrainingOrdering::Values == criteria.ordering {\\\\\\\\n scan.with_row_id();\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\\\\\n            use_spilling,\\\\\\\\n            ..Default::default()\\\\\\\\n        })\\\\\\\\n        .await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let schema = batches.schema();\\\\\\\\n    let mut rows_processed = 0;\\\\\\\\n    let mut next_update = TRAINING_UPDATE_FREQ;\\\\\\\\n    let training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\\\\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\\n        \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n        training_uuid, column\\\\\\\\n    );\\\\\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\\\\\n batch\\\\\\\\n    });\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(schema, batches)))\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub(crate) async fn load_training_data(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;amp;TrainingCriteria,\\\\\\\\n    fragments: Option&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt;,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    // Create training request with fragment_ids if provided\\\\\\\\n    let training_request = Box::new(match fragment_ids.clone() {\\\\\\\\n        Some(fragment_ids) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest { fragment_ids: None },\\\\\\\\n    });\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if train {\\\\\\\\n        // Use the training request to scan data with fragment filtering\\\\\\\\n dataset.get_frags_from_ordered_ids(&amp;amp;amp;amp;fragment_ids);\\\\\\\\n            let frags: Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;_&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; = fragment_ids\\\\\\\\n                .iter()\\\\\\\\n                .zip(frags)\\\\\\\\n                .map(|(id, frag)| {\\\\\\\\n                    let Some(frag) = frag else {\\\\\\\\n                        return Err(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\\\\\n                            source: format!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"No fragment with id {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", id).into(),\\\\\\\\n                            location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n                        });\\\\\\\\n                    };\\\\\\\\n                    Ok(frag.metadata().clone())\\\\\\\\n                })\\\\\\\\n fragments).await\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    } else {\\\\\\\\n        TrainingRequest::create_empty_stream(dataset, column, criteria).await\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n// TODO: Allow users to register their own plugins\\\\\\\\nstatic SCALAR_INDEX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY: LazyLock&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;ScalarIndexPluginRegistry&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; =\\\\\\\\n    LazyLock::new(ScalarIndexPluginRegistry::with_default_plugins);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub struct IndexDetails(pub Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nimpl IndexDetails {\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\\\\\n -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\\\\\n            Ok(VECTOR_INDEX_VERSION)\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            self.get_plugin().map(|p| p.version())\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Build a Scalar Index (returns details to store in the manifest)\\\\\\\\n#[instrument(level = \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"debug\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", skip_all)]\\\\\\\\npub(super) async fn build_scalar_index(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Dataset,\\\\\\\\n    column: &amp;amp;amp;amp;str,\\\\\\\\n location!(),\\\\\\\\n    })?;\\\\\\\\n    let field: arrow_schema::Field = field.into();\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_new(dataset, uuid)?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n Fetches the scalar index plugin for a given index metadata\\\\\\\\n///\\\\\\\\n/// The fast path, on newer datasets, is just a plugin lookup by the type URL of the index Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = match index.index_details.as_ref() {\\\\\\\\n        Some(details) .await;\\\\\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub fn index_matches_criteria(\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n    criteria: -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\\\\\n -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let mut scan = scan.with_row_id();\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    if criteria.needs_row_addrs {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_row_address();\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let batches = scan\\\\\\\\n        .try_into_dfstream(LanceExecutionOptions {\\\\\\\\n            use_spilling,\\\\\\\\n            ..Default::default()\\\\\\\\n training_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();\\\\\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\\n        \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Starting index training job with id {} on column {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n        training_uuid, column\\\\\\\\n    );\\\\\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\\\\\n =&amp;amp;amp;gt; TrainingRequest { fragment_ids: None },\\\\\\\\n    });\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if train {\\\\\\\\n        // Use the training request to scan data with fragment filtering\\\\\\\\n {\\\\\\\\n    /// Returns true if the index is a vector index\\\\\\\\n    pub fn is_vector(&amp;amp;amp;amp;self) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; bool {\\\\\\\\n -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n        if self.is_vector() {\\\\\\\\n            Ok(VECTOR_INDEX_VERSION)\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            self.get_plugin().map(|p| p.version())\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Build a Scalar Index (returns details to store in the manifest)\\\\\\\\n#[instrument(level = dataset.schema().field(column).ok_or(Error::InvalidInput {\\\\\\\\n        source: format!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"No column with name {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", column).into(),\\\\\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n    })?;\\\\\\\\n    let field: arrow_schema::Field = field.into();\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_store = LanceIndexStore::from_dataset_for_new(dataset, uuid)?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = match index.index_details.as_ref() {\\\\\\\\n        Some(details) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; details.clone(),\\\\\\\\n        None =&amp;amp;amp;gt; infer_scalar_index_details(dataset, column, index).await?,\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n index_cache = dataset\\\\\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\\\\\n        .for_index(&amp;amp;amp;amp;uuid_str, frag_reuse_index.as_ref().map(|f| &amp;amp;amp;amp;f.uuid));\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    plugin\\\\\\\\n        .load_index(index_store, &amp;amp;amp;amp;index_details, frag_reuse_index, &amp;amp;amp;amp;index_cache)\\\\\\\\n        .await\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub(crate) async fn Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;Arc&amp;amp;amp;lt;prost_types::Any&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let uuid = index.uuid.to_string();\\\\\\\\n    let type_key = crate::session::index_caches::ScalarIndexDetailsKey { uuid: &amp;amp;amp;amp;uuid };\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(index_details) = dataset.index_cache.get_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;amp;type_key).await {\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(index_details.0.clone());\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_dir = dataset.indice_files_dir(index)?.child(uuid.clone());\\\\\\\\n    let col = schema\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n            column\\\\\\\\n        ),\\\\\\\\n        location: location!(),\\\\\\\\n    })?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let bitmap_page_lookup = let index_details = if let DataType::List(_) = col.data_type() {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;LabelListIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;amp;bitmap_page_lookup).await? {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;BitmapIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset.object_store.exists(&amp;amp;amp;amp;inverted_list_lookup).await? {\\\\\\\\n        // Try to infer inverted index details from metadata file to capture with_position and other params\\\\\\\\n index_store.open_index_file(METADATA_FILE).await.ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            let params_str = reader.schema().metadata.get(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"params\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n            let params = ::serde_json::from_str::&amp;amp;amp;lt;InvertedIndexParams&amp;amp;amp;gt;(params_str).ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            let details = InvertedIndexDetails::try_from(&amp;amp;amp;amp;params).ok()?;\\\\\\\\n            Some(prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;details).unwrap())\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n        parse_params().await.unwrap_or(default_details)\\\\\\\\n    } else if dataset\\\\\\\\n prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;InvertedIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    } else {\\\\\\\\n        prost_types::Any::from_msg(&amp;amp;amp;amp;BTreeIndexDetails::default()).unwrap()\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let index_details = Arc::new(index_details);\\\\\\\\n    let prost_any = Arc::new(ProstAny(index_details.clone()));\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    dataset\\\\\\\\n        .index_cache\\\\\\\\n        .insert_with_key(&amp;amp;amp;amp;type_key, prost_any)\\\\\\\\n        .await;\\\\\\\\n    Ok(index_details)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub fn index_matches_criteria(\\\\\\\\n    index: &amp;amp;amp;amp;IndexMetadata,\\\\\\\\n    criteria: &amp;amp;amp;amp;ScalarIndexCriteria,\\\\\\\\n    field: &amp;amp;amp;amp;Field,\\\\\\\\n    has_multiple_indices: bool,\\\\\\\\n    schema: &amp;amp;amp;amp;lance_core::datatypes::Schema,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;bool&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(name) = &amp;amp;amp;amp;criteria.has_name {\\\\\\\\n        if &amp;amp;amp;amp;index.name != name {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(for_column) = criteria.for_column {\\\\\\\\n        if index.fields.len() != 1 {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        // Build the full field path for nested fields\\\\\\\\n        let field_path = if let Some(ancestors) = schema.field_ancestry_by_id(field.id) {\\\\\\\\n -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    let num_rows = dataset.count_all_rows().await?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let mut scan = scan.project_with_transform(&amp;amp;amp;amp;[(VALUE_COLUMN_NAME, column)])?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if let Some(fragments) = fragments {\\\\\\\\n        scan.with_fragments(fragments);\\\\\\\\n column\\\\\\\\n    );\\\\\\\\n    info!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Training index (job_id={}): 0/{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", training_uuid, num_rows);\\\\\\\\n    let batches = batches.map_ok(move |batch| {\\\\\\\\n batch\\\\\\\\n    });\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    Ok(Box::pin(RecordBatchStreamAdapter::new(schema, batches)))\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\npub(crate) async fn load_training_data(\\\\\\\\n    dataset: Option&amp;amp;amp;lt;Vec&amp;amp;amp;lt;u32&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;gt;,\\\\\\\\n) -&amp;amp;amp;gt; Result&amp;amp;amp;lt;SendableRecordBatchStream&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    // Create plugin.new_training_request(params.params.as_deref().unwrap_or(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"{}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"), &amp;amp;amp;amp;field)?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let training_data = load_training_data(\\\\\\\\n
